name: Enoxarin 40mg Injection 0.4ml
introduction:
Introduction About ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION

ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION contains Enoxaparin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used to manage blood clot formation in the body.

ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION works by stopping the blood clots formation. It also manages the existing blood clots from growing bigger in size. Due to this property, it is highly used as a prophylactic therapy for managing blood clot formation during risky conditions that involves clot formation such as before or after a surgery, during dialysis or after a heart attack or a severe chest pain (angina).

It can also be used to reduce the risk of blood clot formation caused due to prolong period of immobility or due to cancer therapy.

Before receiving ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure or a history of stomach ulcer.

ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients who are bleeding heavily or have any pre-existing conditions (such as stomach ulcer or stroke) that can increase the risk of internal bleeding. It is also not suitable for use in patients scheduled for spinal anesthesia or lumbar puncture.

Inform your doctor before receiving ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of receiving ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION are injection site reactions (such as pain or irritation), skin rashes, low platelet count, bleeding or bruising and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage and manages blood clots in the body
usesDetails:
Uses Of ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION
Manage and manages blood clots in the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION Works

ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION is an anticoagulant medicine. It inactivates certain proteins (such as coagulation factor II a and X a) in the blood that causes blood clotting. This reduces the chances of blood clot formation within the body which therefore manages blockage of blood vessels.
usageDetails:
How to use ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION

ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or under the skin (subcutaneously).

It can also be self-administered by the patients if advised by the physician. Carefully, follow the instructions given by the doctor in case of self-administration.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION does not affect your ability to drive or operate machinery. However, do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION.
Avoid consumption of alcohol before receiving ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION.
ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
Talk to your doctor before receiving ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Enoxaparin or to any other low molecular weight heparins (such as nadroparin, tinzaparin or dalteparin).

ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients fitted with heart valves and in patients with heart problems (such as heart infections or high blood pressure). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

Others

ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have a previous history of heparin-induced thrombocytopenia (low platelet count in blood)
Have antibodies against enoxaparin in your blood
Are bleeding heavily
Have any internal condition that can increase the risk of heavy bleeding (such as stomach ulcer, stroke, surgery)
Are scheduled for any spinal procedures (such as spinal anesthesia or lumbar puncture)

Before receiving ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a history of stomach ulcers
Recently had stroke
Have diabetes
Have diabetic retinopathy (eye damage caused due to diabetes)
Recently had surgery on your brain or eyes
Are underweight or overweight
Have hyperkalemia (high blood potassium levels)

Use in pediatrics:

The safety and effectiveness of ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION have not been established in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Your doctor will decide about administering ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION to your child after evaluating the risks and benefits of the therapy.

Use in geriatrics:

ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before receiving ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Warfarin (a medicine used for blood thinning)
Other medicines used to stop blood clots from forming (Ex. aspirin, clopidogrel, dipyridamole)
Dextran injection (used to replace blood)
Medicines used to relieve pain and swelling (Ex. ibuprofen, diclofenac, ketorolac, tromethamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma, rheumatoid arthritis, and other conditions (Ex. prednisolone, dexamethasone)
Medicines that increase blood potassium levels (Ex. spironolactone, triamterene, amiloride)
Sulfinpyrazone (used to manage gout)

Overdosage:

ENOXARIN 40MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor or nurse if you experience any unusual symptoms.

name: Ecosprin AV 75mg Capsule 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About ECOSPRIN AV 75MG CAPSULE

Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule is a combination of Aspirin and Atorvastatin. It is prescribed for the management of heart attacks and strokes in patients with cardiovascular risk factors. It is also suggested as a maintenance therapy following angioplasty or bypass therapy or protecting from further risk of heart attacks.

Take this medicine as advised by your doctor. It is preferably taken with meals to avoid stomach discomfort. Try to take the medicine at the same time, which will make you easily remember for taking it daily. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

While taking Ecosprin AV, it is important to follow a low-fat, low-carb diet with high protein and lots of water vegetables to help you manage cholesterol levels. Consult a suitable dietician and fitness trainer who can guide you with regular exercises and track your caloric intake.

Before taking Ecosprin AV, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing kidney and liver conditions. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe ulcers in the stomach or intestines, have bloody stools or vomits or scheduled for any upcoming surgeries or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

If you are pregnant, ecosprin AV is not suitable for use especially during the last trimester due to possibility of side effects.

Ecosprin AV 75 may make you bleed easily. Therefore, be cautious while you drive, shave or get prone to injuries very easily, as any accidental injuries may make you bleed more.

Other common side effects of Ecosprin AV are stomach upset, dizziness, nausea, vomiting or indigestion. Inform your doctor if any of these side effect worsens or trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How ECOSPRIN AV 75MG CAPSULE Works

Ecosprin AV 75 contains two active ingredients namely, Atorvastatin and Aspirin. Aspirin at the dose of 75mg contains blood thinning properties. It causes blood thinning which helps the heart to pump blood easily across the body in less pressure and also reduces the chance for platelets accumulation within the blood vessels which leads to atherosclerosis or other blood vessel complications.

Atorvastatin is a lipid lowering medicine which reduces bad cholesterol levels in the body. It works by inhibiting cholesterol production within the body. Together, they help in lowering blood cholesterol levels, reduces the risk of heart attack or stroke and other heart complications.

How Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule Aids in Post-Heart Surgery Recovery?
Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule works by reducing the risk of further blood clot formation by thinning the blood, which is essential in the recovery process after heart surgery.
It improves blood circulation and reduces the risk of complications like heart attacks or strokes.
Doctors often prescribe it as part of a post-surgery care plan to enhance recovery and reduce the risk of future cardiovascular events.
How Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule Supports Overall Heart Health?
Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule supports heart health by reducing the risk of formation of harmful blood clots, which can lead to heart attacks or strokes.
The aspirin in the capsule helps reduce inflammation, while the atorvastatin lowers cholesterol levels, promoting better cardiovascular health and reducing the risk of heart disease.
How Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule Helps in Heart Attack Risk Reduction?

Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule helps in preventing heart attacks by reducing the likelihood of blood clot formation, which can block arteries and disrupt blood flow to the heart. The capsule's combination of aspirin and atorvastatin helps lower cholesterol levels, further protecting against heart attack risks.

How to use ECOSPRIN AV 75MG CAPSULE
Take Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule as prescribed by your doctor.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water, preferably after meals to reduce stomach discomfort.

Recommended dosage for Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule:

Discover the recommended dosing schedule for Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule to ensure safe and effective use for cardiovascular health.

The typical dosing schedule for Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule is as follows:

Frequency: One capsule per day.
Time of Day: Ideally taken once daily after a meal to minimize stomach irritation.
Timing: Take the capsule at the same time each day for consistency, such as with breakfast or dinner.
Duration: Follow the prescribed duration based on your doctor’s recommendations. This could be long-term, depending on your health condition.

Always follow your healthcare provider’s instructions regarding dosage adjustments. Do not take more than the prescribed dose to avoid potential side effects.

If you have any doubts or experience side effects, contact your doctor for advice.

Why You Should Take Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule on an Empty Stomach?

Ecosprin AV 75 is best taken after meals to reduce the risk of stomach irritation, as the aspirin component may cause discomfort if consumed on an empty stomach.

What to Do if You Miss a Dose of Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule?

If you miss a dose of Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it's close to the time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue your regular schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up, as this increases the risk of side effects. Speak to your healthcare provider for personalized advice.

Daily Use of Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule – Is It Safe?

Daily use of Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule is generally safe when prescribed by a doctor for conditions like heart attack or stroke prevention. However, prolonged use can lead to side effects such as gastrointestinal irritation or bleeding. Regular follow-ups with your doctor are crucial to monitor your health and adjust the therapy if necessary.

Overdose of Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule:

An overdose of Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule can cause symptoms like nausea, dizziness, ringing in the ears, or difficulty breathing. If you suspect an overdose, seek medical attention immediately. While waiting for help, avoid taking more medication or attempting self-treatment. Keep the packaging handy to inform healthcare providers about the exact dosage taken.

Adjusting the Dosage of Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule – What You Need to Know

Adjusting the dosage of Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule is a decision best left to your doctor. Factors such as your age, medical history, and current health condition play a significant role. Never alter your dosage without consulting your healthcare provider, as this can compromise treatment effectiveness or increase the risk of side effects.

sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of ECOSPRIN AV 75MG CAPSULE

Like all medicines, Ecosprin AV 75 may cause certain side effects in some individuals, although not everybody gets them.

Common side effects of Ecosprin AV 75:
Stomach pain or discomfort
Indigestion or heartburn
Nausea or vomiting
Dizziness or light-headedness
Headache
Rashes or itching
Increased bleeding or bruising
Elevated liver enzymes (may be detected in blood tests)

If any of these side effects persist or worsen, it is advisable to consult with a healthcare professional.

Ecosprin AV 75 and Risk of bleeding:

Aspirin, the active ingredient in Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule, works by inhibiting the function of platelets, which are responsible for blood clotting. While this is beneficial for reducing the risk for blood clot formation that may lead to heart attacks or strokes, it also increases the risk of excessive bleeding, especially in the gastrointestinal tract or during injuries.

Precautions to Reduce the Risk of Bleeding while taking Ecosprin AV:
Consult with Your Doctor: Before starting Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule, discuss your medical history with your healthcare provider, especially if you have conditions such as gastric ulcers, liver disease, or bleeding disorders.
Take with Food: Always take Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule after meals to minimize stomach irritation and reduce the risk of gastrointestinal bleeding.
Monitor for Symptoms of Bleeding: Be vigilant for any signs of unusual bruising, prolonged bleeding from cuts, blood in the stool, or black tarry stools, and report them to your doctor immediately.
Avoid Combining with Other Blood Thinners: Do not take Ecosprin AV 75 Capsule with other anticoagulants (e.g., warfarin) or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) unless directed by your doctor, as this can further increase bleeding risk.
Limit Alcohol Consumption: Alcohol can enhance the effects of aspirin and increase the likelihood of stomach bleeding, so it’s best to limit or avoid alcohol during treatment.
When to Seek Medical Help?

If you notice any symptoms of excessive bleeding, such as easy bruising, nosebleeds, or prolonged bleeding after minor injuries, contact your healthcare provider immediately. In severe cases, emergency care may be needed.

Serious side effects, though rare, include signs of allergic reactions (like swelling of the face, lips, or throat), severe stomach bleeding, or liver issues. Always follow the prescribed dosage and consult your doctor if you have concerns about side effects.

Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED

There are no well controlled studies regarding the use of aspirin+atorvastatin combination medicines during pregnancy. Available clinical information for aspirin suggests that aspirin may cause growth abnormalities (premature closure of ductus arteriosus in the fetus) or prolonged labour in mothers.

Available research articles on atorvastatin during pregnancy suggests that it inhibits cholesterol production in the body which is required for normal fetal growth and development.

Therefore, the use of Ecosprin AV 75 (aspirin+atorvastatin) is not safe for use in pregnant women especially during the last trimester. If you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant inform your doctor immediately, if you are prescribed to take Ecosprin AV.

If breastfeeding, discuss alternative medications with your doctor to ensure both your safety and the baby’s health.

introduction:
Introduction About DEPLATT A 75MG TABLET

Deplatt A 75mg Tablet is a combination of two commonly used agents that are typically advised to support circulatory function and cardiovascular well-being. It contains Aspirin and Clopidogrel, which belong to the class of Antiplatelet medicines. DEPLATT A 75MG TABLET is used in the management of early and long-term atherothrombotic events such as myocardial infarction, stroke, cardiovascular death or refractory ischemia  in patients having acute coronary syndrome with or without cardiac revascularization.

Along management with DEPLATT A 75MG TABLET follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during management with DEPLATT A 75MG TABLET, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.

Deplatt A 75mg Tablet is generally advised to be taken with food and swallowed whole with water. Dosage instructions should follow professional medical advice based on individual health needs. Do not chew or crush the tablet.

DEPLATT A 75MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years). Consult your doctor for an alternative therapy.

The most common side effects of taking DEPLATT A 75MG TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DEPLATT A 75MG TABLET Works
1. Functional role of Deplatt A in circulatory health
This tablet combines two well-studied agents namely Aspirin and Clopidogrel which work together to support smoother blood flow and help maintain optimal vascular health under medical supervision
2. Understanding the dual mechanism of Aspirin and Clopidogrel
Aspirin works by blocking an enzyme (cyclooxygenase) that plays a key role in the formation of thromboxane, a substance that promotes platelet activity
Clopidogrel, on the other hand, prevents platelet activation by targeting a specific receptor (P2Y12) on the platelet surface. Together, they help maintain steady blood flow.
3. The Role of Deplatt A in Supporting Platelet Function
The combined action reduces the tendency of platelets to stick together, thus aiding in smoother blood movement through the arteries. This is particularly important in individuals where vascular care is a priority.
How Deplatt A supports blood flow in the body?

By modulating platelet aggregation, Deplatt A helps reduce the chances of unintentional clot formation, which is key to maintaining circulation balance in people under cardiac care plans.

Deplatt A 75mg Tablet is usually taken once a day, with a full glass of water. It should be swallowed whole without crushing or chewing. Following the same time daily helps improve routine compliance.

3. When should Deplatt A be taken – morning or night?

Deplatt A can be taken either in the morning or evening. However, taking it at the same time each day supports consistency. Your doctor may advise based on your individual health plan and other medicines you use

4. What is the dosage of Deplatt A for adults?

The dosage of Deplatt A 75mg Tablet is typically one tablet per day, but the exact dosage may vary based on your doctor’s instructions. Always follow the dosage mentioned on the prescription label.

5. Can I take Deplatt A on an empty stomach?

Deplatt A is often advised to be taken after food to reduce the chance of gastric irritation. If you have specific dietary restrictions, consult your doctor before changing how you take this tablet.

6. Best way to take Deplatt A 75mg Tablet

The best way is to take it at the same time each day, preferably after a meal, with water. This helps support consistent absorption and routine adherence.

introduction:
Introduction About TICAGAT 90MG TABLET

TICAGAT 90MG TABLET contains ticagrelor which belongs to the group of medicines called antiplatelet agents. It is used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction. It also reduces the rate of stent thrombosis in patients who have been stented for management of ACS.

Ticagrelor stops clumping of blood cells called platelets, which is responsible for clot formation in diseased blood vessels of heart and brain and thus reduces the chances of a blood clot formation. It can be taken with or without food.

Avoid concomitant use of ticagrelor and other oral anticoagulants like heparin or warfarin, as it may increase the risk of side effects. Do not take this medicine if you are suffering from any bleeding disorders or liver problems. This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. The most common side effect of taking this medicine are bleeding and bruising.

Used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction
mechanismOfAction:
How TICAGAT 90MG TABLET Works

Ticagrelor is a potent P2Y12 receptor antagonist. In diseased blood vessels, platelets can form thrombus (blood clot) by binding to the arterial surface. Activated platelets produces ADP3 which binds to P2Y12 receptor and propagates thrombus formation. Ticagrelor reversibly binds to P2Y12 receptor instead of ADP3 and prevents the signal transduction and platelet activation, that can lead to blood clot formation.

name: Axcer 90mg Tablet 14'S
introduction:
Introduction About AXCER 90MG TABLET

Axcer 90 mg Tablet contains Ticagrelor, a medicine that supports healthy blood circulation by helping to reduce the risk of clot formation in certain heart conditions. It is commonly recommended for individuals who have had a recent heart-related event, such as an episode of chest discomfort (angina) or certain types of heart attack, as part of ongoing cardiac care. Its mechanism works by making platelets in the blood less likely to stick together, ensuring smoother blood flow through the vessels.  

This tablet may be suggested for adults with a history of acute coronary syndrome or those who have undergone stent placement. It is generally used in combination with low-dose aspirin for enhanced cardiovascular protection. People who have risk factors like high blood pressure, diabetes, smoking history, or high cholesterol may be advised this medicine as part of a prescribed cardiac care plan. The suitability depends on individual medical history, which should be assessed by a qualified healthcare professional.

Axcer 90 mg is usually taken orally, with or without food, at the same time every day, as directed by your doctor. It is important to follow the prescribed dosage and not to stop suddenly without medical advice, as this could impact heart health. Swallow the tablet whole with water and avoid doubling doses if one is missed. Patients should inform their healthcare provider about all other medicines, supplements, or herbal products they are using to avoid unwanted interactions.  

People with a history of bleeding disorders, recent surgery, liver impairment, or certain heart rhythm problems should discuss these conditions before starting Axcer 90 mg. It is generally not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding unless specifically advised by a doctor. Common side effects may include shortness of breath, dizziness, headaches, or mild bleeding (such as nosebleeds or easy bruising). Any unusual or persistent symptoms should be reported promptly to a healthcare professional.

mechanismOfAction:
How AXCER 90MG TABLET Works
Axcer 90mg – Mechanism of Action

Axcer 90mg contains Ticagrelor, a P2Y12 receptor antagonist that works by inhibiting platelet aggregation. Platelets are blood cells that help form clots to stop bleeding, but in heart conditions, they can clump together unnecessarily and block arteries. Ticagrelor selectively and reversibly binds to P2Y12 receptors on platelets, preventing them from getting activated by ADP (adenosine diphosphate), a natural clot-promoting substance. By stopping this activation, Axcer reduces the risk of harmful blood clot formation without permanently disabling platelets, which sets it apart from some older antiplatelet drugs.

How Axcer 90mg Works to Support Blood Circulation

Axcer 90mg helps maintain smooth blood flow by keeping platelets from clumping together and forming clots in the blood vessels. In people with narrowed or damaged arteries especially after events like a heart attack or stent placement this action is crucial to prevent re-blockage and support recovery. By reducing clot formation, Axcer keeps the blood vessels open, improving oxygen and nutrient delivery to the heart and other organs. This improved circulation can reduce chest discomfort, support healing, and lower the risk of future heart-related complications when taken regularly as advised by your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About RIVABAN 10 TABLET

RIVABAN 10 TABLET contains Rivaroxaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antithrombotic agents. It is used to manage deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and venous thromboembolism (VTE). It is also used to reduce the risk of stroke, systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, recurrence of DVT or PE, major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), and major thrombotic vascular events in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD). Venous thromboembolism is a condition that occurs due to clot formation in the venous circulation. It can also be used for THE management of DVT in patients undergoing knee or hip replacement surgery, VTE in acutely ill medical patients, and thrombosis in children (older than 2 years) with congenital heart disease post the Fontan procedure.

Before taking RIVABAN 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or bleeding problems or antiphospholipid syndrome. RIVABAN 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. RIVABAN 10 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh less than 2.6 kg. RIVABAN 10 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking RIVABAN 10 TABLET are bleeding, pain and swelling in the limbs, fever, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, low blood pressure (feeling dizzy or fainting when standing up), weakness, tiredness, headache, dizziness, rash, and itchy skin. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

warnings.details: RIVABAN 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women as it not known if it causes any harm to the unborn baby. Consult your doctor before taking it.
RIVABAN 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy after taking RIVABAN 10 TABLET.
RIVABAN 10 TABLET should be taken with caution in adults with severe kidney disease and children with moderate or severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking RIVABAN 10 TABLET.
RIVABAN 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease which leads to an increased risk of bleeding. Consult your doctor before taking RIVABAN 10 TABLET.
Do not take RIVABAN 10 TABLET if you are allergic to Rivaroxaban or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

RIVABAN 10 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with lung disease where the bronchi are widened and filled with pus, or those with previous bleeding from the lung. Consult your doctor before taking RIVABAN 10 TABLET.

RIVABAN 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with acute coronary syndrome, coronary artery disease, or peripheral artery disease. RIVABAN 10 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with very high or unstable blood pressure which is not controlled by medicines, prosthetic heart valve, or coronary artery disease with severe symptomatic heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking RIVABAN 10 TABLET.

RIVABAN 10 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended for use in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh 2.6 kg. RIVABAN 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in children with moderate to severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking RIVABAN 10 TABLET.
RIVABAN 10 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before taking RIVABAN 10 TABLET.

Others

RIVABAN 10 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are bleeding excessively
Have a disease or condition in an organ of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding (Ex. stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, recent operation of the brain or eyes)
Had stroke (previously had a bleeding or a blood clot in your brain)
Had lacunar stroke (blockage of the small arteries providing blood to the brain’s deep tissues) or ischemic, nonlacunar stroke (blood clot in your brain) in the previous month

Before taking RIVABAN 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have or had bleeding problems
Have antiphospholipid syndrome (immunity disorder that causes an increased risk of blood clots)
Have diseases of your stomach or bowel that might result in bleeding (Ex. inflammation of the bowels, stomach, or food pipe) or tumours in the stomach, bowels, genital tract, or urinary tract)
Have retinopathy (problem with the blood vessels in the back of your eyes)
Need to have an operation
Weigh less than 60 kg

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking RIVABAN 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used for fungal infections (Ex. fluconazole, itraconazole, voriconazole, posaconazole), unless they are used on the skin

Medicines used for bacterial infections (Ex. clarithromycin, erythromycin, rifampicin)
Medicines used for HIV infection (Ex. ritonavir, indinavir)
Other medicines used to reduce blood clotting (Ex. enoxaparin, clopidogrel, warfarin, apixaban, heparin, acenocoumarol, prasugrel, ticagrelor)
Medicines used to manage inflammation and pain (Ex. naproxen, acetylsalicylic acid)

Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. citalopram, fluoxetine, venlafaxine, duloxetine, St. John’s wort)
Medicines used to manage fits (Ex. carbamazepine, phenytoin, phenobarbital)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of RIVABAN 10 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptom of overdose include bleeding.

Introduction About DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET

DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET is used to stop blood clots formation, reduce the risk of heart attacks, strokes, and other cardiovascular complications. It is prescribed in heart patients who previously suffered these conditions and in people who underwent angioplasty with stent or by-pass surgery to reduce further chances of heart attack or stroke.

Take DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor. It is preferably taken after food to avoid stomach irritation. Try to take this medicine at the same time everyday to help remember easily. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

Before taking DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe ulcers in the stomach or intestines, have bloody stools or vomits or scheduled for any upcoming surgeries or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

If you are pregnant, DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET  is not suitable for use especially during the last trimester due to possibility of side effects.

DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET may make you bleed easily. Therefore, be cautious while you drive, shave or get prone to injuries very easily, as any accidental injuries may make you bleed more.

Other common side effects of DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET are indigestion, skin itching and runny nose. Inform your doctor if any of these side effect worsens or trouble you.

How DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET Works

DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET works by thinning the blood to help reduce the formation of blood clots, which can block blood vessels and lead to heart attacks or strokes. The active ingredient, aspirin, inhibits platelet aggregation, reducing the likelihood of clots forming in the arteries. This is particularly beneficial for individuals with a higher risk of cardiovascular events, such as those with high blood pressure, diabetes, or a history of heart disease.

By ensuring smooth blood flow, DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET helps lower the chances of recurrent strokes and heart attacks, promoting overall cardiovascular health and improving circulation. Always follow your doctor’s instructions when using this medication to ensure its effectiveness and safety.

DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. It is not suitable for use in pregnant women especially during the last trimester.

Available clinical information for aspirin suggests that aspirin may cause growth abnormalities (premature closure of ductus arteriosus in the fetus) or prolonged labour in mothers.

Therefore, if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant inform your doctor immediately, if you are prescribed to take DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET.

Breastfeeding
CONTRAINDICATED

DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET not recommended during breastfeeding as aspirin can pass into breast milk. This may pose risks such as Reye’s syndrome in infants (a rare but serious condition) or affect the baby’s growth and development. If breastfeeding, discuss alternative medications with your doctor to ensure both your safety and the baby’s health.

Driving and Using Machines
USE WITH CAUTION

DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET do not usually affect your ability to drive or handling machinery.

Alcohol
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET, as it may worsen the risk of side effects.

Kidney
USE WITH CAUTION

DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients. Therefore, inform your doctor as a precaution before taking DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET if you have any pre-existing kidney problems.

Liver
USE WITH CAUTION

DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, inform your doctor as a precaution before taking DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET if you have any pre-existing liver problems.

Allergy
CONTRAINDICATED

Do not take DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET if you are allergic to Aspirin.

Lungs
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

Inform your doctor before taking DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET, if you are suffering from asthma or history of allergic diseases.

Use In Pediatrics
MONITORING REQUIRED

DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years unless considered needed by the doctor.

Use In Geriatrics
USE WITH CAUTION

DELISPRIN 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially if they have pre-existing liver or kidney conditions.

introduction:
Introduction About RIVABAN 20 TABLET

RIVABAN 20 TABLET contains Rivaroxaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antithrombotic agents. It is used to manage deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and venous thromboembolism (VTE). It is also used to reduce the risk of stroke, systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, recurrence of DVT or PE, major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), and major thrombotic vascular events in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD). Venous thromboembolism is a condition that occurs due to clot formation in the venous circulation. It can also be used for THE management of DVT in patients undergoing knee or hip replacement surgery, VTE in acutely ill medical patients, and thrombosis in children (older than 2 years) with congenital heart disease post the Fontan procedure.

Before taking RIVABAN 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or bleeding problems or antiphospholipid syndrome. RIVABAN 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. RIVABAN 20 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh less than 2.6 kg. RIVABAN 20 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking RIVABAN 20 TABLET are bleeding, pain and swelling in the limbs, fever, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, low blood pressure (feeling dizzy or fainting when standing up), weakness, tiredness, headache, dizziness, rash, and itchy skin. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

How RIVABAN 20 TABLET Works

RIVABAN 20 TABLET works by competitively inhibiting factor Xa (a clotting factor) and managing the progression of the coagulation cascade through the final common pathway, thus managing thrombin generation.

How to use RIVABAN 20 TABLET

Take RIVABAN 20 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking RIVABAN 20 TABLET unless your doctor advise.

RIVABAN 20 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before taking RIVABAN 20 TABLET.

Others

RIVABAN 20 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are bleeding excessively
Have a disease or condition in an organ of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding (Ex. stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, recent operation of the brain or eyes)
Had stroke (previously had a bleeding or a blood clot in your brain)
Had lacunar stroke (blockage of the small arteries providing blood to the brain’s deep tissues) or ischemic, nonlacunar stroke (blood clot in your brain) in the previous month

Before taking RIVABAN 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have or had bleeding problems
Have antiphospholipid syndrome (immunity disorder that causes an increased risk of blood clots)
Have diseases of your stomach or bowel that might result in bleeding (Ex. inflammation of the bowels, stomach, or food pipe) or tumours in the stomach, bowels, genital tract, or urinary tract)
Have retinopathy (problem with the blood vessels in the back of your eyes)
Need to have an operation
Weigh less than 60 kg

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking RIVABAN 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used for fungal infections (Ex. fluconazole, itraconazole, voriconazole, posaconazole), unless they are used on the skin
Ketoconazole (used to manage Cushing’s syndrome)
Medicines used for bacterial infections (Ex. clarithromycin, erythromycin, rifampicin)
Medicines used for HIV infection (Ex. ritonavir, indinavir)
Other medicines used to reduce blood clotting (Ex. enoxaparin, clopidogrel, warfarin, apixaban, heparin, acenocoumarol, prasugrel, ticagrelor)
Medicines used to manage inflammation and pain (Ex. naproxen, acetylsalicylic acid)
Dronedarone (used to manage abnormal heartbeat)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. citalopram, fluoxetine, venlafaxine, duloxetine, St. John’s wort)
Medicines used to manage fits (Ex. carbamazepine, phenytoin, phenobarbital)

Introduction About DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE
What is DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE?

DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE is a combination medication used for heart disease management, reducing blood clots, and improving blood circulation.

DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE is used to manage heart attacks and strokes, reduces blood clot formation and improves heart health.

Take DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE as prescribed by your doctor. It is usually taken once daily with water, preferably after a meal.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.

The most common side effects include nausea, stomach pain, dizziness, and increased bleeding risk. Consult your doctor if you experience any of the above side effects.

mechanismOfAction:
How DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE Works
How DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE helps to manage Heart attack and Stroke:
1. Manage blood clots (Aspirin + Clopidogrel – Antiplatelet action)
Heart attacks and strokes occur due to blocked arteries, often caused by blood clots
Aspirin blocks thromboxane A2 production, managing platelets from clumping together
Clopidogrel inhibits P2Y12 receptors, further reducing platelet aggregation
Together, they ensure smoother blood flow and reduce the risk of clot formation in arteries supplying the heart and brain
2. Lowers cholesterol & manages arterial blockage (Atorvastatin – Statin Action):
Atorvastatin inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, reducing cholesterol production in the liver
Lowers LDL cholesterol levels, manages atherosclerosis (artery hardening)
Increases HDL (good cholesterol), helping to remove excess fat deposits
3. Reduces inflammation & improves blood vessel health:
Aspirin & Atorvastatin reduce inflammation in arteries, decreasing oxidative stress
Manages the rupture of plaques, a major cause of sudden heart attacks
Maintains healthy, flexible arteries, ensuring steady blood flow to the heart and brain

Swallow whole with water, preferably after food to reduce stomach irritation
Long-term use as prescribed by a doctor for heart attack and stroke prevention

Always follow correct dosage & timing

warnings.details: DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE is not recommended during pregnancy unless absolutely necessary. Aspirin in low dose sometimes prescribed in pregnancy to manage pre-eclampsia and clot-related complications. However, high doses (like in DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE) may cause fetal complications (bleeding risks, delayed labor). Atorvastatin classified as Pregnancy Category X by the FDA, meaning it is strictly contraindicated due to risks of birth defects. Clopidogrel have limited human studies, however, its use during pregnancy is only advised when the benefits outweigh the risks.

DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE is generally avoided while breastfeeding due to potential risks for the baby. Aspirin may pass into breast milk in small amounts, possibly causing bleeding issues in the infant. Atorvastatin has no sufficient human studies, however, statins may interfere with infant development, so they are not recommended during breastfeeding. Clopidogrel have limited data on its presence in breast milk and safety is unclear.
DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE does not impair your ability to drive or operate any machines.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of stomach bleeding and aggravate your existing condition.

Do not take DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE if you have severe kidney disease requiring dialysis or acute kidney injury (AKI). Avoid long-term use in advanced kidney disease (e.g., Stage 4-5 CKD or dialysis patients). Kidney function (creatinine, GFR) should be monitored regularly. Dosage adjustments may be required based on kidney function.

DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE is not recommended if you have severe liver impairment or active liver disease or have a history of alcohol-induced liver damage. Liver function tests (LFTs) should be monitored before and during treatment. Doctors may adjust the dose or switch to safer alternatives.
Do not take DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE if you are allergic to Clopidogrel, Atorvastatin, Aspirin or any other ingredients of this medicine.

DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with interstitial lung disease or other respiratory problems such as hay fever, asthma or chronic respiratory diseases due to increased risk of bronchospasm and asthma attacks.
DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent ischemic stroke and should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure.
DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

DEPLATT CV 20 CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above) because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly).

Introduction About ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE

ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE is a combination medicine containing Rosuvastatin (10mg), a cholesterol-lowering statin, and Aspirin (75mg), a blood thinner. It is primarily used for the management of high cholesterol and to reduce the risk of heart attacks, strokes, and other cardiovascular events.

By lowering LDL (bad cholesterol) and raising HDL (good cholesterol), Rosuvastatin improves heart health, while Aspirin prevents blood clots, thus offering dual protection against cardiovascular issues. This medication is beneficial for patients with hyperlipidemia, those at risk of heart disease, or those who have already experienced a heart attack or stroke.

Take ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE as prescribed by your doctor. Typically, it is taken once daily, after food, to minimize gastrointestinal discomfort. The exact dose will depend on your individual medical condition. For best results, follow a balanced diet, exercise regularly, and monitor your cholesterol levels.

ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE should be avoided in patients with a history of liver disease, kidney dysfunction, or bleeding disorders. It is contraindicated in pregnant or breastfeeding women, as both Rosuvastatin and Aspirin can cause harm to the fetus or infant.

Caution should be taken in older adults or those taking other medications such as blood thinners, antifungals, or immunosuppressants. Individuals with muscle disorders or gastrointestinal problems should inform their doctor before starting this treatment. Always consult your doctor regarding the use of ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE and inform them about any ongoing health conditions or medications.

ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE may increase your blood sugar levels. Therefore, your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar levels while undergoing therapy with ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE as a precaution. It may also make you bleed more easily even after minor cuts or injuries, and so be cautions while you perform even minor activities that involves risk of cuts or injuries (like shaving, playing, or handling sharp objects).

The most common side effects of taking ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE are indigestion, constipation, muscle pain, increased bleeding tendency stomach pain, headache and nausea. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE Works

ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE is a combination medicine containing Rosuvastatin (10mg) and Aspirin (75mg). It works in two ways to protect your heart:

Rosuvastatin is a cholesterol-lowering medicine (statin) that reduces the production of bad cholesterol (LDL) in the liver and increases good cholesterol (HDL). This helps prevent fat deposits and blockages in the arteries.
Aspirin is a low-dose blood thinner (antiplatelet) that reduces blood platelets from clumping together and forming harmful clots, which can block blood flow to the heart or brain.

Together, ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE helps to control high cholesterol, improve blood circulation, and reduce the risk of heart attacks, strokes, and other cardiovascular events.

It helps lower LDL (bad cholesterol), increase HDL (good cholesterol), and control triglyceride levels effectively when combined with a heart-healthy diet and regular exercise.
ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE Dose for Heart Protection:

In patients with a history of heart attack, stroke, or at risk of cardiovascular events, ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE is prescribed as a preventive therapy.

The fixed combination of Rosuvastatin 10mg + Aspirin 75mg works together to protect your heart by lowering cholesterol and preventing blood clots.

ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE Dosage for Adults:
The usual recommended dose for adults is one capsule per day, taken at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medicine in your body.
The exact dosage may vary depending on your medical history, cholesterol levels, and cardiovascular risk factors.
ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE: Morning or Night?

ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE can be taken in the evening or at bedtime, as cholesterol production in the body is higher at night. However, follow your doctor’s instructions. Taking it at the same time every day improves effectiveness and compliance.

Long-Term Use of ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE

ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE is often prescribed for long-term use to manage chronic high cholesterol and reduce the risk of heart-related complications. Regular monitoring of lipid levels, liver function, and blood clotting parameters is recommended during prolonged therapy.

ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE Long-Term Side Effects

While ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE is effective in managing cholesterol and heart protection, long-term use may come with some risks. Rosuvastatin and Aspirin can have side effects, especially with prolonged use. Some of the common long-term side effects include:

Muscle pain or weakness (Myopathy): Long-term use of Rosuvastatin may increase the risk of muscle pain or weakness. This could lead to more serious conditions like rhabdomyolysis in rare cases, where muscles break down and cause kidney damage.
Liver damage: Statins like Rosuvastatin can affect liver function, so regular liver function tests are necessary to ensure the medication is safe for long-term use.
Kidney problems: High doses of Rosuvastatin or prolonged use can increase the risk of kidney problems.

One of the most common side effects of ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE, particularly due to Rosuvastatin, is muscle pain, tenderness, or weakness.
This condition is known as myopathy and can range from mild discomfort to severe pain.
In rare cases, muscle problems can progress to rhabdomyolysis, a serious condition that can lead to kidney damage.

If you experience unusual muscle pain or weakness, especially if it's severe or persistent, contact your doctor immediately.

Gastric Irritation with ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE
Gastric irritation or stomach discomfort can occur when taking ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE, mainly due to Aspirin.
Long-term use of aspirin can cause gastric ulcers, acid reflux, or general irritation of the stomach lining. To minimize these side effects, it is recommended to take ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE after food.

If you experience persistent heartburn, stomach pain, or digestive discomfort, it’s essential to consult your healthcare provider.

Risk of Bleeding with ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE

Aspirin in ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE is an antiplatelet that prevents blood clots from forming, reducing the risk of heart attacks and strokes. However, it also increases the risk of bleeding, especially with long-term use. This can lead to easy bruising, gastrointestinal bleeding, or even serious conditions like internal bleeding. If you notice any unusual bleeding or bruising, or if you are undergoing surgery or dental procedures, inform your doctor beforehand.

Who Is at Higher Risk of Side Effects?

Some individuals may be at higher risk for side effects when taking ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE. These include:

Older adults: They may be more susceptible to muscle pain, liver, or kidney issues.
People with existing liver or kidney problems: Rosuvastatin can affect liver and kidney function, increasing the risk of complications.
Those with a history of bleeding disorders: Aspirin can increase bleeding risk, so people with a history of ulcers, GI bleeding, or bleeding disorders should be cautious.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women: ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE is not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding due to potential risks to the baby.
People taking other medications: As noted earlier, drug interactions with other medications like blood thinners or antifungals can increase the risk of side effects.

It is crucial to seek medical advice from your doctor before using this medication during pregnancy. Always weigh the potential risks and benefits with your healthcare provider to ensure the safety of both you and your baby.

There is no proper information regarding the use of Aspirin and Rosuvastatin in breastfeeding women. Limited animal studies indicate that these medicines can pass through breast milk to the nursing infant. A risk to the infants cannot be excluded. Therefore, ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE may be considered as unsafe for use during breastfeeding. However, clarify your doubts with your doctor before use.
Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness, sleepiness or vision problems after taking ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of side effects.

ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Dose adjustments are needed for such patients. In case of severe kidney damage conditions, ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE may not be suitable for use. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE if you are allergic to Aspirin or Rosuvastatin.
ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with asthma or respiratory failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other heart problems (such as coronary heart disease). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 16 years) unless prescribed by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

ROZULA ASP 10 CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or older). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients.

introduction:
Introduction About CERUVIN AF CAPSULE

CERUVIN AF CAPSULE is a combination of Aspirin and Clopidogrel which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiplatelets. CERUVIN AF CAPSULE is used in the management of early and long-term atherothrombotic events such as myocardial infarction (also known as heart attack), stroke (reduced blood supply to brain leading to brain death), cardiovascular death or refractory ischemia (chest pain due to inadequate blood supply to the heart) in patients having acute coronary syndrome with or without cardiac revascularization (including surgical or PCI, with or without stent insertion).

Acute coronary syndrome is a heart condition caused by plaque rupture or clot formation in the coronary arteries. Symptoms include heart attack, chest pressure or pain while at rest, shortness of breath and sweating.

Along management with CERUVIN AF CAPSULE follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during management with CERUVIN AF CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.

Do not stop taking CERUVIN AF CAPSULE abruptly without consulting your doctor because premature discontinuation of this medicine may increase the risk of cardiovascular events. CERUVIN AF CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney or lung disease.

CERUVIN AF CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). Consult your doctor for an alternative therapy.

The most common side effects of taking CERUVIN AF CAPSULE are diarrhea, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking CERUVIN AF CAPSULE inform to your doctor, if you are taking any of these medicines:

Other anticoagulant medicines used to manage blood clots (Ex. warfarin, heparin, coumarin) or dipyridamole
Medicines used to manage stomach ulcers such as antacids (Ex. aluminium hydroxide, magnesium hydroxide) and proton-pump inhibitors (Ex. omeprazole or esomeprazole)
Other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (Ex. ibuprofen, paracetamol)
Glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitors (used during percutaneous coronary intervention) Ex. abciximab, eptifibatide and tirofiban
Medicines used to manage heart problems or hypertension (Ex. captopril, enalapril, lisinopril)
Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (used to manage depression) Ex. fluoxetine, sertraline, paroxetine etc
Methotrexate (used to manage cancer and other auto immune diseases)
Diuretics (used to increase urine output) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide
Acetazolamide (used to manage or manage altitude sickness)
Digoxin (used to manage abnormal heart rate)
Lithium (used to manage metal illness)
Corticosteroids (used to manage pain and inflammation) Ex. prednisolone, dexamethasone
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. phenytoin, valproic acid)
Ciclosporin or tacrolimus (used to manage graft rejection or manage auto-immune disease)
Ticlopidine (an antiplatelet medicine used to manage heart problems)
Medicines used to manage gout (such as probenecid, sulfinpyrazone or benzbromarone)
Fluconazole or voriconazole (used to manage fungal infection)

Moclobemide (a medicine used to manage depression)

Mifepristone (abortion pill)
Metoclopramide (used to manage vomiting)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else take too much of CERUVIN AF CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of CERUVIN AF CAPSULE might include increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, increased respiratory rate, hyperventilation, low blood sugar levels, low potassium and platelets levels in blood, increased body temperature, kidney failure, respiratory alkalosis, metabolic acidosis and pulmonary edema (non-cardiac related).

Introduction About ECOSPRIN 75MG TABLET

Ecosprin 75 Tablet is used to stop blood clots formation, reduce the risk of heart attacks, strokes, and other cardiovascular complications. It is prescribed in heart patients who previously suffered these conditions and in people who underwent angioplasty with stent or by-pass surgery to reduce further chances of heart attack or stroke.

Take Ecosprin Tablet exactly as prescribed by your doctor. It is preferably taken after food to avoid stomach irritation. Try to take this medicine at the same time everyday to help remember easily. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

Before taking Ecosprin, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe ulcers in the stomach or intestines, have bloody stools or vomits or scheduled for any upcoming surgeries or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

If you are pregnant, Ecosprin  is not suitable for use especially during the last trimester due to possibility of side effects.

Ecosprin 75 may make you bleed easily. Therefore, be cautious while you drive, shave or get prone to injuries very easily, as any accidental injuries may make you bleed more.

Other common side effects of Ecosprin are indigestion, skin itching and runny nose. Inform your doctor if any of these side effect worsens or trouble you.

How ECOSPRIN 75MG TABLET Works

Ecosprin 75 Tablet works by thinning the blood to help reduce the formation of blood clots, which can block blood vessels and lead to heart attacks or strokes. The active ingredient, aspirin, inhibits platelet aggregation, reducing the likelihood of clots forming in the arteries. This is particularly beneficial for individuals with a higher risk of cardiovascular events, such as those with high blood pressure, diabetes, or a history of heart disease.

By ensuring smooth blood flow, Ecosprin 75 helps lower the chances of recurrent strokes and heart attacks, promoting overall cardiovascular health and improving circulation. Always follow your doctor’s instructions when using this medication to ensure its effectiveness and safety.

Heart-Healthy Diet Recommendations:
Focus on Fresh Fruits and Vegetables: Aim for a variety of colorful fruits and vegetables to get essential nutrients and antioxidants.
Include Whole Grains: Opt for whole-grain bread, brown rice, quinoa, and oats instead of refined grains to improve heart health.
Choose Healthy Fats: Use olive oil or avocado as a source of healthy fats. Include nuts, seeds, and fatty fishlike salmon for omega-3 fatty acids.
Limit Saturated and Trans Fats: Reduce intake of red meat, butter, and processed foods. Replace them with lean proteins like chicken, fish, and plant-based options.
Reduce Sodium Intake: Avoid salty snacks, canned foods, and processed items. Use herbs and spices for flavor instead of salt.
Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water to support your heart and overall body functions.
Exercise Tips While Taking Ecosprin:

Always consult your doctor and get the guidance of fitness trainer before prefrming new or strenuous exercise.

Engage in Moderate Cardio Activities: Walking, swimming, or cycling for 30–45 minutes a day helps improve heart health without overexertion.
Incorporate Strength Training: Light resistance exercises 2–3 times a week can help maintain muscle mass and support overall well-being.
Opt for Low-Impact Workouts: Activities like yoga or Pilates can improve flexibility and are easier on the joints, especially for beginners.
Avoid High-Intensity Exercises Initially: If you are recovering from a heart condition or surgery, stick to mild exercises and gradually increase intensity under medical supervision.
Stay Consistent: Regular physical activity is more beneficial than occasional intense workouts. Aim for at least 150 minutes of exercise per week.
Listen to Your Body: Stop exercising and consult your doctor if you experience chest pain, dizziness, or shortness of breath.
Stress Management Tips While Taking Ecosprin:
Practice Deep Breathing: Spend 5–10 minutes daily doing deep, slow breaths to calm your mind and reduce stress.
Try Mindfulness or Meditation: Dedicate a few minutes each day to mindfulness meditation to help lower stress levels and promote emotional well-being.
Stay Active: Regular exercise is not just good for your heart—it also reduces stress hormones like cortisol and boosts mood.
Get Enough Sleep: Aim for 7–8 hours of quality sleep every night to help your body recover and handle stress better.
Connect with Loved Ones: Spending time with family or friends provides emotional support and helps combat stress.
Pursue Relaxing Hobbies: Activities like gardening, reading, or painting can be therapeutic and help manage anxiety.
Seek Professional Help if Needed: If stress feels overwhelming, consider counseling or therapy to develop effective coping strategies.

Introduction About DEPLATT 75MG TABLET

DEPLATT 75MG TABLET is a prescription medication containing Clopidogrel, primarily used as a blood thinner (antiplatelet) to reduce blood clots. It helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.

This medication can be taken with or without food and should be taken at the same time every day. It is crucial to continue taking it, even if you feel fine. Stopping the medication could increase your risk of having a heart attack or stroke.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, bleeding, bruising, stomach upset. Bleeding in the form of bruising, nose bleeds, blood in urine or stools (black-colored stools), or heavier periods than usual in women. If you cut or injure yourself, the bleeding may take longer than usual to stop. Typically, these bleeding episodes are mild and will resolve on their own. However, it is important to see a doctor immediately if the bleeding continues or if you are concerned.

This medication is not suitable for everyone. Avoid taking it if you are experiencing bleeding from any part of your body, such as a stomach ulcer or internal bleeding in the brain. Prior to using this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of blood clotting issues or if you have recently undergone a major injury or surgery. You may need to temporarily stop taking this medicine before any planned surgeries or dental procedures.

mechanismOfAction:
How DEPLATT 75MG TABLET Works

DEPLATT 75MG TABLET contains clopidogrel, an antiplatelet medication that works by inhibiting platelet aggregation. It does so by blocking the ADP (adenosine diphosphate) receptor on platelets, which is necessary for platelets to clump together and form blood clots. By preventing this process, DEPLATT 75MG TABLET reduces the risk of blood clots, thereby lowering the chances of stroke, heart attack, or other cardiovascular events in individuals with conditions like atherosclerosis, or those who have undergone procedures like stent placement.

introduction:
Introduction About PRAX 5MG TABLET

PRAX 5MG TABLET contains Prasugrel which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiplatelet agents. It is used to manage blood clot formation in the body. It can also reduce the risk of heart attack, stroke, angina (chest pain) and other circulatory problems among patients having heart block, stents in the heart or other heart-related complications.

Before taking PRAX 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems.  It is strictly not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems or bleeding problems (internal bleeding conditions).

PRAX 5MG TABLET may make you bleed more easily even after minor cuts or injuries, and so be cautions while you perform even minor activities in your day-to-day life that involves risk of cuts or injuries (like shaving, playing, or handling sharp objects).

You must also inform your doctor if you recently met with any accident or have stomach ulcers, or scheduled for any upcoming surgeries as a precaution, as they could make you bleed more.

Inform your doctor before taking PRAX 5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking PRAX 5MG TABLET are increased bleeding tendency, anemia, skin rashes and low RBC in blood. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How PRAX 5MG TABLET Works

This reduces the chances of blood clot formation within the blood vessel and improves blood flow within them. As a result, it reduces the risk of heart attack, stroke and angina.

Take PRAX 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It can be taken with or without meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking PRAX 5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About AXCER (+60 TABLET FREE) 90MG TABLET

AXCER (+60 TABLET FREE) 90MG TABLET contains ticagrelor which belongs to the group of medicines called antiplatelet agents. It is used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction. It also reduces the rate of stent thrombosis in patients who have been stented for management of ACS.

Ticagrelor stops clumping of blood cells called platelets, which is responsible for clot formation in diseased blood vessels of heart and brain and thus reduces the chances of a blood clot formation. It can be taken with or without food.

Avoid concomitant use of ticagrelor and other oral anticoagulants like heparin or warfarin, as it may increase the risk of side effects. Do not take this medicine if you are suffering from any bleeding disorders or liver problems. mechanismOfAction:
How AXCER (+60 TABLET FREE) 90MG TABLET Works

Ticagrelor is a potent P2Y12 receptor antagonist. In diseased blood vessels, platelets can form thrombus (blood clot) by binding to the arterial surface. Activated platelets produces ADP3 which binds to P2Y12 receptor and propagates thrombus formation. Ticagrelor reversibly binds to P2Y12 receptor instead of ADP3 and prevents the signal transduction and platelet activation, that can lead to blood clot formation.

introduction:
Introduction About PLAVIX 75MG TABLET

PLAVIX 75MG TABLET is a prescription medication containing Clopidogrel, primarily used as a blood thinner (antiplatelet) to reduce blood clots. It helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.

This medication can be taken with or without food and should be taken at the same time every day. It is crucial to continue taking it, even if you feel fine. Stopping the medication could increase your risk of having a heart attack or stroke.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, bleeding, bruising, stomach upset. Bleeding in the form of bruising, nose bleeds, blood in urine or stools (black-colored stools), or heavier periods than usual in women. If you cut or injure yourself, the bleeding may take longer than usual to stop. Typically, these bleeding episodes are mild and will resolve on their own. However, it is important to see a doctor immediately if the bleeding continues or if you are concerned.

This medication is not suitable for everyone. Avoid taking it if you are experiencing bleeding from any part of your body, such as a stomach ulcer or internal bleeding in the brain. Prior to using this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of blood clotting issues or if you have recently undergone a major injury or surgery. You may need to temporarily stop taking this medicine before any planned surgeries or dental procedures.
uses: By reducing blood clot formation, it helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.
usesDetails:
Uses Of PLAVIX 75MG TABLET
By reducing blood clot formation, it helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.
mechanismOfAction:
How PLAVIX 75MG TABLET Works

PLAVIX 75MG TABLET contains clopidogrel, an antiplatelet medication that works by inhibiting platelet aggregation. It does so by blocking the ADP (adenosine diphosphate) receptor on platelets, which is necessary for platelets to clump together and form blood clots. By preventing this process, PLAVIX 75MG TABLET reduces the risk of blood clots, thereby lowering the chances of stroke, heart attack, or other cardiovascular events in individuals with conditions like atherosclerosis, or those who have undergone procedures like stent placement.

introduction:
Introduction About CLAVIX AS 75MG TABLET

CLAVIX AS 75MG TABLET is a combination of Aspirin and Clopidogrel which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiplatelets. CLAVIX AS 75MG TABLET is used in the management of early and long-term atherothrombotic events such as myocardial infarction (also known as heart attack), stroke (reduced blood supply to brain leading to brain death), cardiovascular death or refractory ischemia (chest pain due to inadequate blood supply to the heart) in patients having acute coronary syndrome with or without cardiac revascularization (including surgical or PCI, with or without stent insertion).

Acute coronary syndrome is a heart condition caused by plaque rupture or clot formation in the coronary arteries. Symptoms include heart attack, chest pressure or pain while at rest, shortness of breath and sweating.

Along management with CLAVIX AS 75MG TABLET follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during management with CLAVIX AS 75MG TABLET, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.

Do not stop taking CLAVIX AS 75MG TABLET abruptly without consulting your doctor because premature discontinuation of this medicine may increase the risk of cardiovascular events. CLAVIX AS 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney or lung disease.

CLAVIX AS 75MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). Consult your doctor for an alternative therapy.

The most common side effects of taking CLAVIX AS 75MG TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About LIPITAB GOLD 10 CAPSULE

LIPITAB GOLD 10 CAPSULE is a combination medicine used in the management of heart attack. It is commonly prescribed for patients with percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) and myocardial infarction to reduce the risks of further heart attacks.

Take LIPITAB GOLD 10 CAPSULE with food, ideally at the same time every day, to maintain consistency and enhance its effectiveness. Follow your doctor's prescribed dosage and schedule, and do not discontinue use without medical advice, even if you feel better. Lifestyle modifications, such as following a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can significantly boost the effectiveness of this medication.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking LIPITAB GOLD 10 CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.    

Before starting LIPITAB GOLD 10 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney disease. If you are pregnant, planning to conceive, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before use. Additionally, disclose all other medications you are taking to avoid potential drug interactions.

The most common side effects of taking LIPITAB GOLD 10 CAPSULE are abdominal pain, indigestion, bruising, and nosebleeds. Since this medication increases the risk of bleeding, take extra precautions while shaving, trimming nails, or handling sharp objects. Seek immediate medical attention if you notice symptoms like muscle pain or weakness, yellowing of the skin, or dark urine. Avoid consuming alcohol while on this medication, as it may amplify side effects.

mechanismOfAction:
How LIPITAB GOLD 10 CAPSULE Works

LIPITAB GOLD 10 CAPSULE contains a combination of three medicines, namely aspirin, atorvastatin, and clopidogrel which works synergistically to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events like heart attacks and strokes by targeting different aspects of blood clotting and cholesterol management:

Aspirin and Clopidogrel are antiplatelet medicines that prevents platelets from sticking together, further reducing the risk of clot formation and enhancing blood flow in the arteries. By reducing platelet clumping, this medicine helps maintain smooth blood flow and prevents clots in blood vessels.

Atorvastatin is a statin that inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, the enzyme involved in cholesterol synthesis in the liver. It lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while increasing HDL (good cholesterol), which reduces plaque buildup in arteries (atherosclerosis) and improves blood vessel health.

Together, this medicine offers comprehensive cardiovascular protection by reducing clot formation, improving lipid profiles, and reducing  the risk for narrowing of blood vessels, significantly lowering the risk of heart attacks and strokes.
usageDetails:
How to use LIPITAB GOLD 10 CAPSULE

LIPITAB GOLD 10 CAPSULE should be taken exactly as prescribed by your doctor for optimal results.

It is best to take this medicine with food to avoid stomach discomfort.

Take it at the same time every day to ensure consistent blood levels and maximum effectiveness.

Swallow the medicine whole with water; do not crush or chew it.

Follow your doctor’s recommended dosage schedule, and do not skip doses or stop the medication without consulting your healthcare provider.

For best results, combine this medication with a healthy lifestyle, including a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking. Always consult your doctor if you have any questions about its use.

Missed dosage instructions for LIPITAB GOLD 10 CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose of LIPITAB GOLD 10 CAPSULE, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double up on doses to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects. To avoid missing doses in the future, try taking the medication at the same time every day and consider setting reminders. If you are unsure about what to do, consult your doctor or pharmacist for advice.

Overdosage instructions for LIPITAB GOLD 10 CAPSULE:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of LIPITAB GOLD 10 CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of LIPITAB GOLD 10 CAPSULE includes increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting (sometimes with blood), increased body temperature, low blood sugar levels, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, kidney failure, increased respiratory rate and hyperventilation.

CONTRAINDICATED
LIPITAB GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women due to potential risks of side effects to the growing baby. Animal studies have indicated that the use of Atorvastatin causes feotal growth abnormalities. Aspirin is generally advised not to take at later stages of pregnancy as it may increase post-partum bleeding. Although, there are no well controlled human studies, the potential risk to the growing fetus cannot be excluded. introduction:
Introduction About LYMPEDIM TABLET

LYMPEDIM TABLET contains Coumarin, chemically 5, 6 Benzo-alpha-pyrone, which is an Immunostimulant Anti-Inflammatory Drug. It is used in the management of inflammation and oedema. It restores lymphatic function, boosts immunity, reduces infections, improves microcirculation, and accelerates wound healing.

It is highly prescribed in cases such as sprains, bruises, injuries, contusions, fractures, post-operative oedema, dental extractions, post-surgery, acute and sub-acute lymphangitis, and chronic venous sufficiency.

Studies have shown that Coumarin (5, 6 Benzo-alpha-pyrone) has been proven to reduce lymphedema and edema associated with elephantiasis (filariasis), and swelling due to unknown origin.

Take LYMPEDIM TABLET as advised by your physician. Strictly follow the dosing schedule as suggested by your physician to achieve better results. Do not use this medicine for prolonged periods without medical supervision, as it could increase the risk of liver damage.

Before taking LYMPEDIM TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. Do not take LYMPEDIM TABLET if you are allergic to Coumarin. Inform your doctor before taking LYMPEDIM TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.
