mechanismOfAction:
How LYMPEDIM TABLET Works

LYMPEDIM TABLET contains coumarin (5, 6 Benzo-alpha-pyrone) which is a powerful anti-inflammatory and immune-boosting medicine. It reduces oedema (swelling) caused by excess protein by increasing the number of macrophages (a type of immune cell (WBC) that is involved in engulfing and digesting foreign particles, debris, and pathogens in the body) and by causing the breakdown of excess proteins (proteolysis). Additionally, it also stops chronic inflammation, fibrosis, and bacterial growth caused by excess protein.
usageDetails:
How to use LYMPEDIM TABLET

Take LYMPEDIM TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosages. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based on your age, body weight, and health condition.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of LYMPEDIM TABLET

There are limited studies regarding the safety of Coumarin (5, 6 Benzo-alpha-pyrone) in humans. Available studies suggest that it is safe and well tolerated with mild nausea and diarrhea during the initial days of the therapy, which typically disappears after the first month of therapy.

warnings.details: There is no proper information regarding the use of LYMPEDIM TABLET in pregnant women. Therefore, inform your doctor before taking LYMPEDIM TABLET if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant.
There is no proper information regarding the use of LYMPEDIM TABLET in breastfeeding women. Therefore, inform your doctor before taking LYMPEDIM TABLET if you are breastfeeding.
LYMPEDIM TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

LYMPEDIM TABLET is metabolized via liver. Therefore, patients with liver problems must inform their doctor about the pre-existing liver conditions before taking this medicine. It is contraindicated for use in patients with hepatitis or any other severe forms of liver inflammation.
Do not take LYMPEDIM TABLET if you are allergic to Coumarin (5, 6 Benzo-alpha-pyrone).

There are no adequate studies regarding the use of LYMPEDIM TABLET in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, your doctor will decide whether Coumarin (5, 6 Benzo-alpha-pyrone) is suitable for your child or not after evaluating the risks and benefits.
LYMPEDIM TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Introduction About CLOPILET 75MG TABLET

CLOPILET 75MG TABLET is a prescription medication containing Clopidogrel, primarily used as a blood thinner (antiplatelet) to reduce blood clots. It helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.

This medication can be taken with or without food and should be taken at the same time every day. It is crucial to continue taking it, even if you feel fine. Stopping the medication could increase your risk of having a heart attack or stroke.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, bleeding, bruising, stomach upset. Bleeding in the form of bruising, nose bleeds, blood in urine or stools (black-colored stools), or heavier periods than usual in women. If you cut or injure yourself, the bleeding may take longer than usual to stop. Typically, these bleeding episodes are mild and will resolve on their own. However, it is important to see a doctor immediately if the bleeding continues or if you are concerned.

This medication is not suitable for everyone. Avoid taking it if you are experiencing bleeding from any part of your body, such as a stomach ulcer or internal bleeding in the brain. Prior to using this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of blood clotting issues or if you have recently undergone a major injury or surgery. You may need to temporarily stop taking this medicine before any planned surgeries or dental procedures.

mechanismOfAction:
How CLOPILET 75MG TABLET Works

CLOPILET 75MG TABLET contains clopidogrel, an antiplatelet medication that works by inhibiting platelet aggregation. It does so by blocking the ADP (adenosine diphosphate) receptor on platelets, which is necessary for platelets to clump together and form blood clots. By preventing this process, CLOPILET 75MG TABLET reduces the risk of blood clots, thereby lowering the chances of stroke, heart attack, or other cardiovascular events in individuals with conditions like atherosclerosis, or those who have undergone procedures like stent placement.

introduction:
Introduction About RIVABAN 15 TABLET

RIVABAN 15 TABLET contains Rivaroxaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antithrombotic agents. It is used to manage deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and venous thromboembolism (VTE). It is also used to reduce the risk of stroke, systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, recurrence of DVT or PE, major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), and major thrombotic vascular events in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD). Venous thromboembolism is a condition that occurs due to clot formation in the venous circulation. It can also be used for THE management of DVT in patients undergoing knee or hip replacement surgery, VTE in acutely ill medical patients, and thrombosis in children (older than 2 years) with congenital heart disease post the Fontan procedure.

Before taking RIVABAN 15 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or bleeding problems or antiphospholipid syndrome. RIVABAN 15 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. RIVABAN 15 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh less than 2.6 kg. RIVABAN 15 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking RIVABAN 15 TABLET are bleeding, pain and swelling in the limbs, fever, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, low blood pressure (feeling dizzy or fainting when standing up), weakness, tiredness, headache, dizziness, rash, and itchy skin. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How RIVABAN 15 TABLET Works

RIVABAN 15 TABLET works by competitively inhibiting factor Xa (a clotting factor) and managing the progression of the coagulation cascade through the final common pathway, thus managing thrombin generation.
usageDetails:
How to use RIVABAN 15 TABLET

Take RIVABAN 15 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking RIVABAN 15 TABLET unless your doctor advise.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy after taking RIVABAN 15 TABLET.
RIVABAN 15 TABLET should be taken with caution in adults with severe kidney disease and children with moderate or severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking RIVABAN 15 TABLET.
RIVABAN 15 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease which leads to an increased risk of bleeding. Consult your doctor before taking RIVABAN 15 TABLET.
Do not take RIVABAN 15 TABLET if you are allergic to Rivaroxaban or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

RIVABAN 15 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with lung disease where the bronchi are widened and filled with pus, or those with previous bleeding from the lung. Consult your doctor before taking RIVABAN 15 TABLET.

RIVABAN 15 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with acute coronary syndrome, coronary artery disease, or peripheral artery disease. RIVABAN 15 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with very high or unstable blood pressure which is not controlled by medicines, prosthetic heart valve, or coronary artery disease with severe symptomatic heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking RIVABAN 15 TABLET.

RIVABAN 15 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended for use in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh 2.6 kg. RIVABAN 15 TABLET is not recommended for use in children with moderate to severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking RIVABAN 15 TABLET.
RIVABAN 15 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before taking RIVABAN 15 TABLET.

Others

RIVABAN 15 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are bleeding excessively
Have a disease or condition in an organ of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding (Ex. stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, recent operation of the brain or eyes)
Had stroke (previously had a bleeding or a blood clot in your brain)
Had lacunar stroke (blockage of the small arteries providing blood to the brain’s deep tissues) or ischemic, nonlacunar stroke (blood clot in your brain) in the previous month

Before taking RIVABAN 15 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have or had bleeding problems
Have antiphospholipid syndrome (immunity disorder that causes an increased risk of blood clots)
Have diseases of your stomach or bowel that might result in bleeding (Ex. inflammation of the bowels, stomach, or food pipe) or tumours in the stomach, bowels, genital tract, or urinary tract)
Have retinopathy (problem with the blood vessels in the back of your eyes)
Need to have an operation
Weigh less than 60 kg

name: TICAPREV 90 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TICAPREV 90 TABLET

TICAPREV 90 TABLET is a prescription medication used to reduce blood clots in individuals who have had a heart attack or are at risk of stroke. It works by inhibiting platelets, thus reducing the risk of clot formation in the blood vessels.

Your doctor may also prescribe aspirin, an additional antiplatelet medication, alongside TICAPREV 90 TABLET. You can take TICAPREV 90 TABLET with or without food, and it is important to take it consistently at the same time each day. Continue taking the medication as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Stopping it could raise your risk of having another heart attack or stroke.

Common side effect of this medication includes headache, dizziness, shortness of breath, dyspnea (breathlessness) and bleeding. If you cut or injure yourself, it might take longer than normal for the bleeding to stop. These bleeding episodes are typically mild and should resolve on their own. Mild breathlessness caused by this medication generally improves with ongoing management. However, inform your doctor if the bleeding continues or if the breathlessness becomes more severe or does not improve.

TICAPREV 90 TABLETmay not be appropriate for certain individuals. Avoid taking it if you are experiencing bleeding anywhere in the body, such as from a stomach ulcer or internal bleeding in the brain. It is also not recommended for those with liver conditions. Be sure to inform your doctor about any such problems before taking this medication.
uses: Blood clots

Blood clots
mechanismOfAction:
How TICAPREV 90 TABLET Works

TICAPREV 90 TABLET works by inhibiting platelet aggregation, which helps reduce blood clots from forming. It is an antiplatelet medication that selectively and reversibly binds to the P2Y12 receptor on platelets, blocking the action of ADP (adenosine diphosphate) and thereby reducing platelet activation and aggregation. This effect helps reduce cardiovascular events like heart attacks and strokes in patients with a history of acute coronary syndrome or those undergoing procedures like stent placement. By reducing clot formation, TICAPREV 90 TABLET lowers the risk of further complications related to blood clots in the arteries.

Why TICAPREV 90 TABLET(Ticagrelor)  stands out:

introduction:
Introduction About CENOROL 2MG TABLET

CENOROL 2MG TABLET contains Nicoumalone which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-coagulants. It is used to manage or prevent the formation of blood clots in the body. Blood clots (also known as thrombosis) are semi-solid masses of blood cells deposited within the blood vessels. It happens due to excessive clumping of platelets (blood cells) or other blood proteins within the blood vessels. As a result, it blocks them and reduce blood flow within them, leading to various complications such as deep vein thrombosis (blood clot in veins of legs), pulmonary embolism (blood clot in veins of lungs), heart attack, abnormal heart rate or stroke. CENOROL 2MG TABLET can also be used as an adjunct in the management of coronary occlusion (block in heart which reduces oxygen and blood supply leading to heart attack) and transient cerebral ischemic attacks (mini stroke, caused by blockage in the blood vessel supplying the brain).

Nicoumalone is a blood thinning medication. It works by preventing the formation of blood clots within the blood vessels. It blocks the actions of certain blood proteins and enzymes that forms blood clots in the body. As a result, it reduces the risk of heart attack and other serious complications such as stroke, deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism. CENOROL 2MG TABLET cannot not dissolve an existing blood clot, but it can prevent them from growing larger. During management with CENOROL 2MG TABLET, your doctor would regularly monitor your blood clotting time to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking CENOROL 2MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. Avoid drinking alcohol or cranberry juice while taking CENOROL 2MG TABLET. Inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any upcoming surgeries or if you had met with any accident recently. CENOROL 2MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women due to increased risk of bleeding at the time of childbirth. It should be used with caution in children and in elderly patients. The most common side effect of CENOROL 2MG TABLET is increased bleeding tendency (even after minor cuts or wounds). Consult your doctor if your bleeding becomes uncontrollable.

How CENOROL 2MG TABLET Works

CENOROL 2MG TABLET is a blood thinning medication. It works by preventing the formation of blood clots within the blood vessels. It blocks the actions of certain blood proteins and enzymes (such as vitamin k reductase, prothrombin, coagulation factors VII, IX, X and protein C) that forms blood clots in the body. As a result, it improves blood flow and oxygen supply through the blood vessels and reduce the symptoms of blood clotting disorders such as deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, heart attack, abnormal heart rate or stroke.

Take CENOROL 2MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

CENOROL 2MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Proper dose adjustments are required in such patients. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking.

Others

CENOROL 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have any mental illness such as schizophrenia or dementia
Have a habit of drinking excessive alcohol (alcohol abuse)
Have recently had or are going to have any major surgery on your spine, brain or eyes
Have stroke caused due to brain haemorrhage (bleeding in the brain)
Have stomach ulcer or bleeding from intestines
Have blood in urine or in vomit
Have any forms of bleeding disorders or unexplained bruising
Are going to receive any injections in your muscles

Have cancer
Have any signs of infection or inflammation in the body
Have overactive thyroid
Have ever had any stomach or intestinal ulcer
Have any recent wound or injury
Need any injections into spine or as part of a scan, x-ray or any dental surgeries
Have anaemia (low RBC count in the blood)
Had recently met with an accident

name: Revolade 50mg Tablet 7'S
introduction:
Introduction About REVOLADE 50MG TABLET

REVOLADE 50MG TABLET contains Eltrombopag which belongs to the group of medicines called Thrombopoietin-receptor agonist. REVOLADE 50MG TABLET is used to manage immune thrombocytopenia (platelet disorder) in patients aged 1-year/above when other medicines (such as corticosteroids/immunoglobulins) become ineffective to manage the disease.

REVOLADE 50MG TABLET is also used to manage thrombocytopenia (low platelet count) in adults suffering from hepatitis C (viral) infection. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage low blood counts in adults suffering from severe aplastic anemia (rare blood disorder that occurs due to failure of bone marrow to produce new blood cells).

REVOLADE 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Eltrombopag.

Before taking REVOLADE 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are at a risk of developing blood clot in veins/arteries, and/or have cancer, obesity, advanced chronic liver disease, and/or kidney problems (such as renal impairment).

REVOLADE 50MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy unless it is clearly necessary. Women of childbearing potential should use effective contraceptive measures while in management with REVOLADE 50MG TABLET. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women since it is not known whether the medicine may pass through breastmilk.

REVOLADE 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (aged below 1-year) suffering from immune thrombocytopenia. It is also not recommended for use in children (aged below 18 years) suffering from low platelet counts due to hepatitis C/severe aplastic anemia. The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking REVOLADE 50MG TABLET are common cold, cough, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, and/or hair loss. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

warnings.details: REVOLADE 50MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy unless it is clearly necessary. Women of childbearing potential should use effective contraceptive measures while in management with REVOLADE 50MG TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
REVOLADE 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women since it is not known whether the medicine may pass through breastmilk. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or less alert after taking REVOLADE 50MG TABLET.
REVOLADE 50MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with kidney problems such as renal impairment. Consult your doctor before taking REVOLADE 50MG TABLET.

REVOLADE 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from advanced chronic liver disease only if necessary, since the medicine may increase the risk of occurrence of side effects/blood clot. Consult your doctor before taking REVOLADE 50MG TABLET.
Do not take REVOLADE 50MG TABLET if you are allergic to Eltrombopag, and/or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

Before taking REVOLADE 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Are at a risk of developing blood clot in veins/arteries
Are suffering from cancer
Recently undergone surgery
Had a physical injury
Are obese
Are a smoker
Have cataract (eye lens getting cloudy)
Suffer from another blood condition such as s myelodysplastic syndrome

Use in Pediatrics:

REVOLADE 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (aged below 1-year) suffering from immune thrombocytopenia (platelet disorder). It is also not recommended for use in children (aged below 18 years) suffering from low platelet counts due to hepatitis C/severe aplastic anemia. Consult your doctor before taking REVOLADE 50MG TABLET.

Use in Geriatrics:

REVOLADE 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65-years/above). Consult your doctor before taking REVOLADE 50MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About PLAGERINE TABLET

PLAGERINE TABLET is a prescription medication containing Clopidogrel, primarily used as a blood thinner (antiplatelet) to reduce blood clots. It helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.

This medication can be taken with or without food and should be taken at the same time every day. It is crucial to continue taking it, even if you feel fine. Stopping the medication could increase your risk of having a heart attack or stroke.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, bleeding, bruising, stomach upset. Bleeding in the form of bruising, nose bleeds, blood in urine or stools (black-colored stools), or heavier periods than usual in women. If you cut or injure yourself, the bleeding may take longer than usual to stop. Typically, these bleeding episodes are mild and will resolve on their own. However, it is important to see a doctor immediately if the bleeding continues or if you are concerned.

This medication is not suitable for everyone. Avoid taking it if you are experiencing bleeding from any part of your body, such as a stomach ulcer or internal bleeding in the brain. Prior to using this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of blood clotting issues or if you have recently undergone a major injury or surgery. You may need to temporarily stop taking this medicine before any planned surgeries or dental procedures.
uses: By reducing blood clot formation, it helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.
usesDetails:
Uses Of PLAGERINE TABLET
By reducing blood clot formation, it helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.
mechanismOfAction:
How PLAGERINE TABLET Works

PLAGERINE TABLET contains clopidogrel, an antiplatelet medication that works by inhibiting platelet aggregation. It does so by blocking the ADP (adenosine diphosphate) receptor on platelets, which is necessary for platelets to clump together and form blood clots. By preventing this process, PLAGERINE TABLET reduces the risk of blood clots, thereby lowering the chances of stroke, heart attack, or other cardiovascular events in individuals with conditions like atherosclerosis, or those who have undergone procedures like stent placement.

01. Product Comparison
a) PLAGERINE TABLET Vs Ecosprin

Primary Use

	

Prevents blood clots in conditions like atherosclerosis, heart attack, stroke, and peripheral artery disease.

	

Prevents blood clots in cardiovascular conditions, such as heart attack, stroke, and in the prevention of clot formation in people with cardiovascular disease.

Clopidogrel vs Aspirin

	

Clopidogrel is often preferred for long-term antiplatelet therapy in patients with a high risk of bleeding or GI issues.

	

Aspirin is more commonly used for prevention in lower-risk patients due to its cost-effectiveness and availability.

Why PLAGERINE TABLET Might Be Preferred in Certain Cases:
Gastrointestinal Safety: PLAGERINE TABLETtends to cause less gastrointestinal irritation compared to Ecosprin, making it a better choice for individuals with a history of gastric ulcers, gastritis, or other GI concerns.
Bleeding Risk Management: PLAGERINE TABLEThas a more targeted mechanism of action (via the P2Y12 receptor), and its bleeding risk is often more manageable compared to aspirin's broader impact on COX enzymes, which can also increase the risk of gastrointestinal bleeding.
Asthma or Respiratory Concerns: PLAGERINE TABLETis preferred in patients with asthma, as aspirin can exacerbate respiratory symptoms in individuals with asthma or other allergic conditions.
Long-Term Therapy: For patients needing long-term antiplatelet therapy, PLAGERINE TABLET might be preferred over aspirin due to its more specific action on platelets, leading to a lower risk of side effects like gastrointestinal bleeding.

introduction:
Introduction About CORPARIN 40MG INJECTION(PFS)

CORPARIN 40MG INJECTION(PFS) contains Enoxaparin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used to manage blood clot formation in the body.

CORPARIN 40MG INJECTION(PFS) works by stopping the blood clots formation. It also manages the existing blood clots from growing bigger in size. Due to this property, it is highly used as a prophylactic therapy for managing blood clot formation during risky conditions that involves clot formation such as before or after a surgery, during dialysis or after a heart attack or a severe chest pain (angina).

It can also be used to reduce the risk of blood clot formation caused due to prolong period of immobility or due to cancer therapy.

Before receiving CORPARIN 40MG INJECTION(PFS) inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure or a history of stomach ulcer.

name: Acitrom 1mg Tablet 30'S
introduction:
Introduction About ACITROM 1MG TABLET

ACITROM 1MG TABLET contains Nicoumalone which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-coagulants. It is used to manage or prevent the formation of blood clots in the body. Blood clots (also known as thrombosis) are semi-solid masses of blood cells deposited within the blood vessels. It happens due to excessive clumping of platelets (blood cells) or other blood proteins within the blood vessels. As a result, it blocks them and reduce blood flow within them, leading to various complications such as deep vein thrombosis (blood clot in veins of legs), pulmonary embolism (blood clot in veins of lungs), heart attack, abnormal heart rate or stroke. ACITROM 1MG TABLET can also be used as an adjunct in the management of coronary occlusion (block in heart which reduces oxygen and blood supply leading to heart attack) and transient cerebral ischemic attacks (mini stroke, caused by blockage in the blood vessel supplying the brain).

Nicoumalone is a blood thinning medication. It works by preventing the formation of blood clots within the blood vessels. It blocks the actions of certain blood proteins and enzymes that forms blood clots in the body. As a result, it reduces the risk of heart attack and other serious complications such as stroke, deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism. ACITROM 1MG TABLET cannot not dissolve an existing blood clot, but it can prevent them from growing larger. During management with ACITROM 1MG TABLET, your doctor would regularly monitor your blood clotting time to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking ACITROM 1MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. Avoid drinking alcohol or cranberry juice while taking ACITROM 1MG TABLET. Inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any upcoming surgeries or if you had met with any accident recently. ACITROM 1MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women due to increased risk of bleeding at the time of childbirth. It should be used with caution in children and in elderly patients. The most common side effect of ACITROM 1MG TABLET is increased bleeding tendency (even after minor cuts or wounds). Consult your doctor if your bleeding becomes uncontrollable.

How ACITROM 1MG TABLET Works

ACITROM 1MG TABLET is a blood thinning medication. It works by preventing the formation of blood clots within the blood vessels. It blocks the actions of certain blood proteins and enzymes (such as vitamin k reductase, prothrombin, coagulation factors VII, IX, X and protein C) that forms blood clots in the body. As a result, it improves blood flow and oxygen supply through the blood vessels and reduce the symptoms of blood clotting disorders such as deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, heart attack, abnormal heart rate or stroke.

Take ACITROM 1MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

ACITROM 1MG TABLET does not affect your ability to drive or operate heavy tools or machines.

name: CLOVAS Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About CLOVAS TABLET

CLOVAS TABLET is used to reduce elevated cholesterol and triglyceride levels in patients when a low-fat diet and lifestyle changes alone have failed. It is a combination of Atorvastatin and Clopidogrel which belongs to the group of medicines called HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors and Antiplatelet medicines respectively. It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart problems such as myocardial infarction, angina (chest pain), heart failure including stroke or revascularization procedures in adult patients with or without a clinically evident chronic heart disease.

Along with management with CLOVAS TABLET, patient should follow an appropriate lipid-lowering diet as advised by their doctor to enhance recovery. Before using the medicine, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney disease. Patients with active liver disease should discontinue the use of CLOVAS TABLET as it may cause serious side effects in them.

It is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in patients with bleeding disorders. It is not suitable for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Avoid consumption of grapefruit juice or alcohol while taking CLOVAS TABLET as it may lead to unwanted interactions. The most common side effects are muscle pain, joint pain, diarrhoea, nausea, headache or stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

The risk of heart problems such as myocardial infarction (MI), angina, heart failure including stroke or revascularization procedures in adult patients with or without clinically evident of chronic heart disease

mechanismOfAction:
How CLOVAS TABLET Works

CLOVAS TABLET reduces elevated cholesterol and risk of heart disease, where Atorvastatin acts by inhibiting the action of an enzyme called HMG-CoA reductase, which is required to catalyze the formation of cholesterol and Clopidogrel acts by inhibiting platelet aggregation, which is believed to be an important factor resulting in heart problems.

introduction:
Introduction About TICUS 90MG TABLET

TICUS 90MG TABLET contains ticagrelor which belongs to the group of medicines called antiplatelet agents. It is used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction. It also reduces the rate of stent thrombosis in patients who have been stented for management of ACS.

Ticagrelor stops clumping of blood cells called platelets, which is responsible for clot formation in diseased blood vessels of heart and brain and thus reduces the chances of a blood clot formation. It can be taken with or without food.

Avoid concomitant use of ticagrelor and other oral anticoagulants like heparin or warfarin, as it may increase the risk of side effects. Do not take this medicine if you are suffering from any bleeding disorders or liver problems. This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. The most common side effect of taking this medicine are bleeding and bruising.
uses: Used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction
usesDetails:
Uses Of TICUS 90MG TABLET
Used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction
mechanismOfAction:
How TICUS 90MG TABLET Works

Ticagrelor is a potent P2Y12 receptor antagonist. In diseased blood vessels, platelets can form thrombus (blood clot) by binding to the arterial surface. Activated platelets produces ADP3 which binds to P2Y12 receptor and propagates thrombus formation. Ticagrelor reversibly binds to P2Y12 receptor instead of ADP3 and prevents the signal transduction and platelet activation, that can lead to blood clot formation.
usageDetails:
How to use TICUS 90MG TABLET

Take this medicine as directed by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your condition. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Continue to take this medicine, as long as your doctor tells you to do so, to obtain better results.

introduction:
Introduction About CLOPICARD 75MG TABLET

CLOPICARD 75MG TABLET is a prescription medication containing Clopidogrel, primarily used as a blood thinner (antiplatelet) to reduce blood clots. It helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.

This medication can be taken with or without food and should be taken at the same time every day. It is crucial to continue taking it, even if you feel fine. Stopping the medication could increase your risk of having a heart attack or stroke.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, bleeding, bruising, stomach upset. Bleeding in the form of bruising, nose bleeds, blood in urine or stools (black-colored stools), or heavier periods than usual in women. If you cut or injure yourself, the bleeding may take longer than usual to stop. Typically, these bleeding episodes are mild and will resolve on their own. However, it is important to see a doctor immediately if the bleeding continues or if you are concerned.

This medication is not suitable for everyone. Avoid taking it if you are experiencing bleeding from any part of your body, such as a stomach ulcer or internal bleeding in the brain. Prior to using this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of blood clotting issues or if you have recently undergone a major injury or surgery. You may need to temporarily stop taking this medicine before any planned surgeries or dental procedures.

mechanismOfAction:
How CLOPICARD 75MG TABLET Works

CLOPICARD 75MG TABLET contains clopidogrel, an antiplatelet medication that works by inhibiting platelet aggregation. It does so by blocking the ADP (adenosine diphosphate) receptor on platelets, which is necessary for platelets to clump together and form blood clots. By preventing this process, CLOPICARD 75MG TABLET reduces the risk of blood clots, thereby lowering the chances of stroke, heart attack, or other cardiovascular events in individuals with conditions like atherosclerosis, or those who have undergone procedures like stent placement.

Clopidogrel vs Aspirin

	

Clopidogrel is often preferred for long-term antiplatelet therapy in patients with a high risk of bleeding or GI issues.

	

Aspirin is more commonly used for prevention in lower-risk patients due to its cost-effectiveness and availability.

Why CLOPICARD 75MG TABLET Might Be Preferred in Certain Cases:
Gastrointestinal Safety: CLOPICARD 75MG TABLETtends to cause less gastrointestinal irritation compared to Ecosprin, making it a better choice for individuals with a history of gastric ulcers, gastritis, or other GI concerns.

introduction:
Introduction About RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET

RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET contains Rivaroxaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antithrombotic agents. It is used to manage deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and venous thromboembolism (VTE). It is also used to reduce the risk of stroke, systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, recurrence of DVT or PE, major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), and major thrombotic vascular events in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD). Venous thromboembolism is a condition that occurs due to clot formation in the venous circulation. It can also be used for THE management of DVT in patients undergoing knee or hip replacement surgery, VTE in acutely ill medical patients, and thrombosis in children (older than 2 years) with congenital heart disease post the Fontan procedure.

Before taking RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or bleeding problems or antiphospholipid syndrome. RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh less than 2.6 kg. RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET are bleeding, pain and swelling in the limbs, fever, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, low blood pressure (feeling dizzy or fainting when standing up), weakness, tiredness, headache, dizziness, rash, and itchy skin. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

How RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET Works

RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Do not take RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET if you are allergic to Rivaroxaban or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with lung disease where the bronchi are widened and filled with pus, or those with previous bleeding from the lung. Consult your doctor before taking RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET.

RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with acute coronary syndrome, coronary artery disease, or peripheral artery disease. RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with very high or unstable blood pressure which is not controlled by medicines, prosthetic heart valve, or coronary artery disease with severe symptomatic heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET.

RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended for use in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh 2.6 kg. RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in children with moderate to severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET.
RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before taking RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET.

Others

RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are bleeding excessively
Have a disease or condition in an organ of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding (Ex. stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, recent operation of the brain or eyes)
Had stroke (previously had a bleeding or a blood clot in your brain)
Had lacunar stroke (blockage of the small arteries providing blood to the brain’s deep tissues) or ischemic, nonlacunar stroke (blood clot in your brain) in the previous month

Before taking RIVABAN 2.5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have or had bleeding problems
Have antiphospholipid syndrome (immunity disorder that causes an increased risk of blood clots)
Have diseases of your stomach or bowel that might result in bleeding (Ex. inflammation of the bowels, stomach, or food pipe) or tumours in the stomach, bowels, genital tract, or urinary tract)
Have retinopathy (problem with the blood vessels in the back of your eyes)
Need to have an operation
Weigh less than 60 kg

Introduction About ATORFIT CV GOLD CAPSULE

ATORFIT CV GOLD CAPSULE is a combination medicine used in the management of heart attack. It is commonly prescribed for patients with percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) and myocardial infarction to reduce the risks of further heart attacks.

Take ATORFIT CV GOLD CAPSULE with food, ideally at the same time every day, to maintain consistency and enhance its effectiveness. Follow your doctor's prescribed dosage and schedule, and do not discontinue use without medical advice, even if you feel better. Lifestyle modifications, such as following a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can significantly boost the effectiveness of this medication.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking ATORFIT CV GOLD CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.    

Before starting ATORFIT CV GOLD CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney disease. If you are pregnant, planning to conceive, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before use. Additionally, disclose all other medications you are taking to avoid potential drug interactions.

The most common side effects of taking ATORFIT CV GOLD CAPSULE are abdominal pain, indigestion, bruising, and nosebleeds. Since this medication increases the risk of bleeding, take extra precautions while shaving, trimming nails, or handling sharp objects. Seek immediate medical attention if you notice symptoms like muscle pain or weakness, yellowing of the skin, or dark urine. Avoid consuming alcohol while on this medication, as it may amplify side effects.

mechanismOfAction:
How ATORFIT CV GOLD CAPSULE Works

ATORFIT CV GOLD CAPSULE contains a combination of three medicines, namely aspirin, atorvastatin, and clopidogrel which works synergistically to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events like heart attacks and strokes by targeting different aspects of blood clotting and cholesterol management:

Aspirin and Clopidogrel are antiplatelet medicines that prevents platelets from sticking together, further reducing the risk of clot formation and enhancing blood flow in the arteries. By reducing platelet clumping, this medicine helps maintain smooth blood flow and prevents clots in blood vessels.

Atorvastatin is a statin that inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, the enzyme involved in cholesterol synthesis in the liver. It lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while increasing HDL (good cholesterol), which reduces plaque buildup in arteries (atherosclerosis) and improves blood vessel health.

Together, this medicine offers comprehensive cardiovascular protection by reducing clot formation, improving lipid profiles, and reducing  the risk for narrowing of blood vessels, significantly lowering the risk of heart attacks and strokes.
usageDetails:
How to use ATORFIT CV GOLD CAPSULE

ATORFIT CV GOLD CAPSULE should be taken exactly as prescribed by your doctor for optimal results.

It is best to take this medicine with food to avoid stomach discomfort.

Take it at the same time every day to ensure consistent blood levels and maximum effectiveness.

Swallow the medicine whole with water; do not crush or chew it.

Follow your doctor’s recommended dosage schedule, and do not skip doses or stop the medication without consulting your healthcare provider.

For best results, combine this medication with a healthy lifestyle, including a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking. Always consult your doctor if you have any questions about its use.

Missed dosage instructions for ATORFIT CV GOLD CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose of ATORFIT CV GOLD CAPSULE, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double up on doses to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects. To avoid missing doses in the future, try taking the medication at the same time every day and consider setting reminders. If you are unsure about what to do, consult your doctor or pharmacist for advice.

Overdosage instructions for ATORFIT CV GOLD CAPSULE:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of ATORFIT CV GOLD CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of ATORFIT CV GOLD CAPSULE includes increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting (sometimes with blood), increased body temperature, low blood sugar levels, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, kidney failure, increased respiratory rate and hyperventilation.

Dehydration problem
Diabetes
Are alcoholic

introduction:
Introduction About TICAVIC 90MG TABLET

TICAVIC 90MG TABLET contains ticagrelor which belongs to the group of medicines called antiplatelet agents. It is used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction. It also reduces the rate of stent thrombosis in patients who have been stented for management of ACS.

Ticagrelor stops clumping of blood cells called platelets, which is responsible for clot formation in diseased blood vessels of heart and brain and thus reduces the chances of a blood clot formation. It can be taken with or without food.

Avoid concomitant use of ticagrelor and other oral anticoagulants like heparin or warfarin, as it may increase the risk of side effects. Do not take this medicine if you are suffering from any bleeding disorders or liver problems. This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. The most common side effect of taking this medicine are bleeding and bruising.

mechanismOfAction:
How TICAVIC 90MG TABLET Works

Ticagrelor is a potent P2Y12 receptor antagonist. In diseased blood vessels, platelets can form thrombus (blood clot) by binding to the arterial surface. Activated platelets produces ADP3 which binds to P2Y12 receptor and propagates thrombus formation. Ticagrelor reversibly binds to P2Y12 receptor instead of ADP3 and prevents the signal transduction and platelet activation, that can lead to blood clot formation.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Continue to take this medicine, as long as your doctor tells you to do so, to obtain better results.

introduction:
Introduction About ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE

ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE is a combination medicine used in the management of heart attack. It is commonly prescribed for patients with percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) and myocardial infarction to reduce the risks of further heart attacks.

Take ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE with food, ideally at the same time every day, to maintain consistency and enhance its effectiveness. Follow your doctor's prescribed dosage and schedule, and do not discontinue use without medical advice, even if you feel better. Lifestyle modifications, such as following a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can significantly boost the effectiveness of this medication.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.    

Before starting ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney disease. If you are pregnant, planning to conceive, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before use. Additionally, disclose all other medications you are taking to avoid potential drug interactions.

The most common side effects of taking ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE are abdominal pain, indigestion, bruising, and nosebleeds. Since this medication increases the risk of bleeding, take extra precautions while shaving, trimming nails, or handling sharp objects. Seek immediate medical attention if you notice symptoms like muscle pain or weakness, yellowing of the skin, or dark urine. Avoid consuming alcohol while on this medication, as it may amplify side effects.
uses: Heart Attack
ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE is a powerful medication designed to lower the risk of heart attacks by combining antiplatelet and cholesterol-lowering agents.
It prevents blood clots by stopping platelets from sticking together, ensuring smooth blood flow and reducing the risk of blockages in arteries.
Additionally, it lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while boosting HDL (good cholesterol), promoting better cardiovascular health.

By reducing the chances for atherosclerosis (hardening of arteries) and reducing the recurrence of heart attacks, this medication offers comprehensive heart protection. When combined with a healthy lifestyle, such as a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE significantly enhances heart health.

mechanismOfAction:
How ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE Works

ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE contains a combination of three medicines, namely aspirin, atorvastatin, and clopidogrel which works synergistically to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events like heart attacks and strokes by targeting different aspects of blood clotting and cholesterol management:

Aspirin and Clopidogrel are antiplatelet medicines that prevents platelets from sticking together, further reducing the risk of clot formation and enhancing blood flow in the arteries. By reducing platelet clumping, this medicine helps maintain smooth blood flow and prevents clots in blood vessels.

Atorvastatin is a statin that inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, the enzyme involved in cholesterol synthesis in the liver. It lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while increasing HDL (good cholesterol), which reduces plaque buildup in arteries (atherosclerosis) and improves blood vessel health.

Together, this medicine offers comprehensive cardiovascular protection by reducing clot formation, improving lipid profiles, and reducing  the risk for narrowing of blood vessels, significantly lowering the risk of heart attacks and strokes.
usageDetails:
How to use ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE

ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE should be taken exactly as prescribed by your doctor for optimal results.

It is best to take this medicine with food to avoid stomach discomfort.

Take it at the same time every day to ensure consistent blood levels and maximum effectiveness.

Swallow the medicine whole with water; do not crush or chew it.

Follow your doctor’s recommended dosage schedule, and do not skip doses or stop the medication without consulting your healthcare provider.

For best results, combine this medication with a healthy lifestyle, including a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking. Always consult your doctor if you have any questions about its use.

Missed dosage instructions for ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose of ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double up on doses to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects. To avoid missing doses in the future, try taking the medication at the same time every day and consider setting reminders. If you are unsure about what to do, consult your doctor or pharmacist for advice.

Overdosage instructions for ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE includes increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting (sometimes with blood), increased body temperature, low blood sugar levels, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, kidney failure, increased respiratory rate and hyperventilation.

ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with interstitial lung disease or other respiratory problems such as hay fever, asthma or chronic respiratory diseases due to increased risk of bronchospasm and asthma attacks. Consult your doctor before taking ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE.

ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above) because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly). Consult your doctor before taking ECOSPRIN GOLD 10MG CAPSULE.

Have an underactive thyroid gland
Have family history of hereditary muscular disorders

Upcoming planned surgery (including dental surgery)
Dehydration problem
Diabetes
Are alcoholic

introduction:
Introduction About ROSUSON GOLD 10 CAPSULE

ROSUSON GOLD 10 CAPSULE is used in the management of acute coronary syndrome, myocardial infarction, angina and stroke. It is a combination of Aspirin, Clopidogrel and Rosuvastatin which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs, Antiplatelets and HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors respectively.   

Along with ROSUSON GOLD 10 CAPSULE management follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during the therapy, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract. It is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney, or heart disease.  

ROSUSON GOLD 10 CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). The most common side effects are increased bleeding tendency, nausea, indigestion, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, muscle pain, dizziness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ROSUSON GOLD 10 CAPSULE Works

ROSUSON GOLD 10 CAPSULE effectively improves cardiac function and reduces the risk of heart problems, where clopidogrel acts by inhibiting platelet aggregation in the coronary arteries, aspirin acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called cyclo-oxygenase which is believed to be responsible for catalyzing the synthesis of platelets and rosuvastatin acts by inhibiting the action of an enzyme called HMG-CoA reductase, which is required to catalyze the formation of cholesterol, thus managing clot or plaque formation in the coronary arteries leading to an uninterrupted supply of oxygen and blood to the heart.

introduction:
Introduction About PRADAXA 150MG CAPSULE

PRADAXA 150MG CAPSULE contains Dabigatran etexilate which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used to manage stroke, systemic embolism and reduction of vascular mortality in adult patients with atrial fibrillation and venous thromboembolic events in patients who have undergone orthopaedic surgery.

It is also used to manage acute deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and/or pulmonary embolism (PE) and manages recurrent deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and /or pulmonary embolism (PE). This medicine is also used in children to manage blood clots and to manage blood clots from reoccurring.

Avoid taking PRADAXA 150MG CAPSULE, if you currently have bleeding disorders, organ disease of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding such as stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, severely reduced kidney or liver function.

Before taking PRADAXA 150MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have increased bleeding risks such as s bone fracture, head injury or any injury requiring surgical management, lung or heart problems.

PRADAXA 150MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking PRADAXA 150MG CAPSULE.

Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your child’s age body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before taking PRADAXA 150MG CAPSULE.

The most common side effects of taking PRADAXA 150MG CAPSULE are stomachache, indigestion, frequent loose or liquid bowel movements and or nausea. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.

Introduction About CLOPIVAS 75MG TABLET

CLOPIVAS 75MG TABLET is a prescription medication containing Clopidogrel, primarily used as a blood thinner (antiplatelet) to reduce blood clots. It helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.

This medication can be taken with or without food and should be taken at the same time every day. It is crucial to continue taking it, even if you feel fine. Stopping the medication could increase your risk of having a heart attack or stroke.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, bleeding, bruising, stomach upset. Bleeding in the form of bruising, nose bleeds, blood in urine or stools (black-colored stools), or heavier periods than usual in women. If you cut or injure yourself, the bleeding may take longer than usual to stop. Typically, these bleeding episodes are mild and will resolve on their own. However, it is important to see a doctor immediately if the bleeding continues or if you are concerned.

This medication is not suitable for everyone. Avoid taking it if you are experiencing bleeding from any part of your body, such as a stomach ulcer or internal bleeding in the brain. Prior to using this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of blood clotting issues or if you have recently undergone a major injury or surgery. You may need to temporarily stop taking this medicine before any planned surgeries or dental procedures.

mechanismOfAction:
How CLOPIVAS 75MG TABLET Works

CLOPIVAS 75MG TABLET contains clopidogrel, an antiplatelet medication that works by inhibiting platelet aggregation. It does so by blocking the ADP (adenosine diphosphate) receptor on platelets, which is necessary for platelets to clump together and form blood clots. By preventing this process, CLOPIVAS 75MG TABLET reduces the risk of blood clots, thereby lowering the chances of stroke, heart attack, or other cardiovascular events in individuals with conditions like atherosclerosis, or those who have undergone procedures like stent placement.

Clopidogrel vs Aspirin

Introduction About PRASITA 10MG TABLET

PRASITA 10MG TABLET contains Prasugrel which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiplatelet agents. It is used to manage blood clot formation in the body. It can also reduce the risk of heart attack, stroke, angina (chest pain) and other circulatory problems among patients having heart block, stents in the heart or other heart-related complications.

Before taking PRASITA 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems.  It is strictly not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems or bleeding problems (internal bleeding conditions).

PRASITA 10MG TABLET may make you bleed more easily even after minor cuts or injuries, and so be cautions while you perform even minor activities in your day-to-day life that involves risk of cuts or injuries (like shaving, playing, or handling sharp objects).

You must also inform your doctor if you recently met with any accident or have stomach ulcers, or scheduled for any upcoming surgeries as a precaution, as they could make you bleed more.

Inform your doctor before taking PRASITA 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking PRASITA 10MG TABLET are increased bleeding tendency, anemia, skin rashes and low RBC in blood. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About AXCER 60MG TABLET

AXCER 60MG TABLET contains ticagrelor which belongs to the group of medicines called antiplatelet agents. It is used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction. It also reduces the rate of stent thrombosis in patients who have been stented for management of ACS.

Ticagrelor stops clumping of blood cells called platelets, which is responsible for clot formation in diseased blood vessels of heart and brain and thus reduces the chances of a blood clot formation. It can be taken with or without food.

Avoid concomitant use of ticagrelor and other oral anticoagulants like heparin or warfarin, as it may increase the risk of side effects. Do not take this medicine if you are suffering from any bleeding disorders or liver problems. This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. The most common side effect of taking this medicine are bleeding and bruising.
uses: Used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction
usesDetails:
Uses Of AXCER 60MG TABLET
Used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction
mechanismOfAction:
How AXCER 60MG TABLET Works

Ticagrelor is a potent P2Y12 receptor antagonist. In diseased blood vessels, platelets can form thrombus (blood clot) by binding to the arterial surface. Activated platelets produces ADP3 which binds to P2Y12 receptor and propagates thrombus formation. Ticagrelor reversibly binds to P2Y12 receptor instead of ADP3 and prevents the signal transduction and platelet activation, that can lead to blood clot formation.

How to use AXCER 60MG TABLET

Take this medicine as directed by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your condition. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Continue to take this medicine, as long as your doctor tells you to do so, to obtain better results.

introduction:
Introduction About PRASUDOC 10MG TABLET

PRASUDOC 10MG TABLET contains Prasugrel which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiplatelet agents. It is used to manage blood clot formation in the body. It can also reduce the risk of heart attack, stroke, angina (chest pain) and other circulatory problems among patients having heart block, stents in the heart or other heart-related complications.

Before taking PRASUDOC 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems.  It is strictly not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems or bleeding problems (internal bleeding conditions).

PRASUDOC 10MG TABLET may make you bleed more easily even after minor cuts or injuries, and so be cautions while you perform even minor activities in your day-to-day life that involves risk of cuts or injuries (like shaving, playing, or handling sharp objects).

You must also inform your doctor if you recently met with any accident or have stomach ulcers, or scheduled for any upcoming surgeries as a precaution, as they could make you bleed more.

Inform your doctor before taking PRASUDOC 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking PRASUDOC 10MG TABLET are increased bleeding tendency, anemia, skin rashes and low RBC in blood. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE

STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE is a combination medicine used in the management of heart attack. It is commonly prescribed for patients with percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) and myocardial infarction to reduce the risks of further heart attacks.

Take STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE with food, ideally at the same time every day, to maintain consistency and enhance its effectiveness. Follow your doctor's prescribed dosage and schedule, and do not discontinue use without medical advice, even if you feel better. Lifestyle modifications, such as following a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can significantly boost the effectiveness of this medication.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.    

Before starting STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney disease. If you are pregnant, planning to conceive, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before use. Additionally, disclose all other medications you are taking to avoid potential drug interactions.

The most common side effects of taking STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE are abdominal pain, indigestion, bruising, and nosebleeds. Since this medication increases the risk of bleeding, take extra precautions while shaving, trimming nails, or handling sharp objects. Seek immediate medical attention if you notice symptoms like muscle pain or weakness, yellowing of the skin, or dark urine. Avoid consuming alcohol while on this medication, as it may amplify side effects.
uses: Heart Attack
STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE is a powerful medication designed to lower the risk of heart attacks by combining antiplatelet and cholesterol-lowering agents.
It prevents blood clots by stopping platelets from sticking together, ensuring smooth blood flow and reducing the risk of blockages in arteries.
Additionally, it lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while boosting HDL (good cholesterol), promoting better cardiovascular health.

By reducing the chances for atherosclerosis (hardening of arteries) and reducing the recurrence of heart attacks, this medication offers comprehensive heart protection. When combined with a healthy lifestyle, such as a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE significantly enhances heart health.

mechanismOfAction:
How STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE Works

STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE contains a combination of three medicines, namely aspirin, atorvastatin, and clopidogrel which works synergistically to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events like heart attacks and strokes by targeting different aspects of blood clotting and cholesterol management:

Aspirin and Clopidogrel are antiplatelet medicines that prevents platelets from sticking together, further reducing the risk of clot formation and enhancing blood flow in the arteries. By reducing platelet clumping, this medicine helps maintain smooth blood flow and prevents clots in blood vessels.

Atorvastatin is a statin that inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, the enzyme involved in cholesterol synthesis in the liver. It lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while increasing HDL (good cholesterol), which reduces plaque buildup in arteries (atherosclerosis) and improves blood vessel health.

Together, this medicine offers comprehensive cardiovascular protection by reducing clot formation, improving lipid profiles, and reducing  the risk for narrowing of blood vessels, significantly lowering the risk of heart attacks and strokes.
usageDetails:
How to use STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE

STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE should be taken exactly as prescribed by your doctor for optimal results.

It is best to take this medicine with food to avoid stomach discomfort.

Take it at the same time every day to ensure consistent blood levels and maximum effectiveness.

Swallow the medicine whole with water; do not crush or chew it.

Follow your doctor’s recommended dosage schedule, and do not skip doses or stop the medication without consulting your healthcare provider.

For best results, combine this medication with a healthy lifestyle, including a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking. Always consult your doctor if you have any questions about its use.

Missed dosage instructions for STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose of STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double up on doses to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects. To avoid missing doses in the future, try taking the medication at the same time every day and consider setting reminders. If you are unsure about what to do, consult your doctor or pharmacist for advice.

Overdosage instructions for STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE includes increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting (sometimes with blood), increased body temperature, low blood sugar levels, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, kidney failure, increased respiratory rate and hyperventilation.

STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above) because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly). CONTRAINDICATED
STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women due to potential risks of side effects to the growing baby. Animal studies have indicated that the use of Atorvastatin causes feotal growth abnormalities. Although, there are no well controlled human studies, the potential risk to the growing fetus cannot be excluded. Therefore, do not take STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE without talking to your doctor if you are pregnant.
Women of child-bearing potential should use suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while taking STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE.
If you become pregnant while on therapy with this medicine, stop taking it and consult your doctor immediately.

CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

It is not known whether Aspirin, Atorvastatin or clopidogrel pass through breast milk or not. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking STORVA GOLD 20 CAPSULE if you are breastfeeding.

SAFE

introduction:
Introduction About PREVA 75MG TABLET

PREVA 75MG TABLET is a prescription medication containing Clopidogrel, primarily used as a blood thinner (antiplatelet) to reduce blood clots. It helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.

This medication can be taken with or without food and should be taken at the same time every day. It is crucial to continue taking it, even if you feel fine. Stopping the medication could increase your risk of having a heart attack or stroke.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, bleeding, bruising, stomach upset. Bleeding in the form of bruising, nose bleeds, blood in urine or stools (black-colored stools), or heavier periods than usual in women. If you cut or injure yourself, the bleeding may take longer than usual to stop. Typically, these bleeding episodes are mild and will resolve on their own. However, it is important to see a doctor immediately if the bleeding continues or if you are concerned.

This medication is not suitable for everyone. Avoid taking it if you are experiencing bleeding from any part of your body, such as a stomach ulcer or internal bleeding in the brain. Prior to using this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of blood clotting issues or if you have recently undergone a major injury or surgery. You may need to temporarily stop taking this medicine before any planned surgeries or dental procedures.

mechanismOfAction:
How PREVA 75MG TABLET Works

PREVA 75MG TABLET contains clopidogrel, an antiplatelet medication that works by inhibiting platelet aggregation. It does so by blocking the ADP (adenosine diphosphate) receptor on platelets, which is necessary for platelets to clump together and form blood clots. By preventing this process, PREVA 75MG TABLET reduces the risk of blood clots, thereby lowering the chances of stroke, heart attack, or other cardiovascular events in individuals with conditions like atherosclerosis, or those who have undergone procedures like stent placement.

introduction:
Introduction About CLOPICAN 75MG TABLET

CLOPICAN 75MG TABLET is a prescription medication containing Clopidogrel, primarily used as a blood thinner (antiplatelet) to reduce blood clots. It helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.

This medication can be taken with or without food and should be taken at the same time every day. It is crucial to continue taking it, even if you feel fine. Stopping the medication could increase your risk of having a heart attack or stroke.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, bleeding, bruising, stomach upset. Bleeding in the form of bruising, nose bleeds, blood in urine or stools (black-colored stools), or heavier periods than usual in women. If you cut or injure yourself, the bleeding may take longer than usual to stop. Typically, these bleeding episodes are mild and will resolve on their own. However, it is important to see a doctor immediately if the bleeding continues or if you are concerned.

This medication is not suitable for everyone. Avoid taking it if you are experiencing bleeding from any part of your body, such as a stomach ulcer or internal bleeding in the brain. Prior to using this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of blood clotting issues or if you have recently undergone a major injury or surgery. You may need to temporarily stop taking this medicine before any planned surgeries or dental procedures.

mechanismOfAction:
How CLOPICAN 75MG TABLET Works

CLOPICAN 75MG TABLET contains clopidogrel, an antiplatelet medication that works by inhibiting platelet aggregation. It does so by blocking the ADP (adenosine diphosphate) receptor on platelets, which is necessary for platelets to clump together and form blood clots. By preventing this process, CLOPICAN 75MG TABLET reduces the risk of blood clots, thereby lowering the chances of stroke, heart attack, or other cardiovascular events in individuals with conditions like atherosclerosis, or those who have undergone procedures like stent placement.

name: CLOPILET A 150 Capsule 15's
introduction:
Introduction About CLOPILET A 150 CAPSULE

CLOPILET A 150 CAPSULE is a combination of Aspirin and Clopidogrel which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiplatelets. CLOPILET A 150 CAPSULE is used in the management of early and long-term atherothrombotic events such as myocardial infarction (also known as heart attack), stroke (reduced blood supply to brain leading to brain death), cardiovascular death or refractory ischemia (chest pain due to inadequate blood supply to the heart) in patients having acute coronary syndrome with or without cardiac revascularization (including surgical or PCI, with or without stent insertion).

Acute coronary syndrome is a heart condition caused by plaque rupture or clot formation in the coronary arteries. Symptoms include heart attack, chest pressure or pain while at rest, shortness of breath and sweating.

Along management with CLOPILET A 150 CAPSULE follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during management with CLOPILET A 150 CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.

Do not stop taking CLOPILET A 150 CAPSULE abruptly without consulting your doctor because premature discontinuation of this medicine may increase the risk of cardiovascular events. CLOPILET A 150 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney or lung disease.

CLOPILET A 150 CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). Consult your doctor for an alternative therapy.

The most common side effects of taking CLOPILET A 150 CAPSULE are diarrhea, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

CLOPILET A 150 CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have coagulation disorders (Ex. hemophilia, thrombocytopenia)
Have bleeding in the brain (Ex. intracranial hemorrhage or cerebrovascular hemorrhage)

Have gout
Have menorrhagia (abnormally heavy or prolonged menstrual period)

Have stomach ulcer or severe stomach pain
Had a recent serious injury
Are going to have any upcoming surgery (including dental procedures) or already had recently
Had a recent ischemic stroke (blot clot in the artery supplying the brain)
Have a history of asthma or other allergic diseases
Are alcoholic
Have G6PD deficiency (a genetic disorder causing destruction of red blood cells in response to certain stimuli)
Have active chickenpox or shingles infection

CLOPILET A 150 CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly). A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking CLOPILET A 150 CAPSULE inform to your doctor, if you are taking any of these medicines:

Other anticoagulant medicines used to manage blood clots (Ex. warfarin, heparin, coumarin) or dipyridamole
Medicines used to manage stomach ulcers such as antacids (Ex. aluminium hydroxide, magnesium hydroxide) and proton-pump inhibitors (Ex. omeprazole or esomeprazole)
Other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (Ex. ibuprofen, paracetamol)
Glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitors (used during percutaneous coronary intervention) Ex. abciximab, eptifibatide and tirofiban
Medicines used to manage heart problems or hypertension (Ex. captopril, enalapril, lisinopril)
Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (used to manage depression) Ex. fluoxetine, sertraline, paroxetine etc
Methotrexate (used to manage cancer and other auto immune diseases)
Diuretics (used to increase urine output) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide
Acetazolamide (used to manage or manage altitude sickness)
Digoxin (used to manage abnormal heart rate)
Lithium (used to manage metal illness)
Corticosteroids (used to manage pain and inflammation) Ex. prednisolone, dexamethasone
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. phenytoin, valproic acid)
Ciclosporin or tacrolimus (used to manage graft rejection or manage auto-immune disease)
Ticlopidine (an antiplatelet medicine used to manage heart problems)

Medicines used to manage HIV infection (Ex. efavirenz or tenofovir)
Varicella vaccine (used to manage chickenpox or shingles)
Moclobemide (a medicine used to manage depression)
Medicines used to control blood glucose level (Ex. glipizide, gliclazide, glimepiride, repaglinide)

Mifepristone (abortion pill)
Metoclopramide (used to manage vomiting)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else take too much of CLOPILET A 150 CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of CLOPILET A 150 CAPSULE might include increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, increased respiratory rate, hyperventilation, low blood sugar levels, low potassium and platelets levels in blood, increased body temperature, kidney failure, respiratory alkalosis, metabolic acidosis and pulmonary edema (non-cardiac related).
