Others

CIDOGREL A TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have coagulation disorders (Ex. hemophilia, thrombocytopenia)
Have bleeding in the brain (Ex. intracranial hemorrhage or cerebrovascular hemorrhage)
Have bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract
Have gout
Have menorrhagia (abnormally heavy or prolonged menstrual period)

Before taking CIDOGREL A TABLET, inform your physician if you:

Have stomach ulcer or severe stomach pain
Had a recent serious injury
Are going to have any upcoming surgery (including dental procedures) or already had recently
Had a recent ischemic stroke (blot clot in the artery supplying the brain)
Have a history of asthma or other allergic diseases
Are alcoholic
Have G6PD deficiency (a genetic disorder causing destruction of red blood cells in response to certain stimuli)
Have active chickenpox or shingles infection

Use in pediatrics:

CIDOGREL A TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

CIDOGREL A TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly). Consult your doctor before taking CIDOGREL A TABLET.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking CIDOGREL A TABLET inform to your doctor, if you are taking any of these medicines:

Other anticoagulant medicines used to manage blood clots (Ex. warfarin, heparin, coumarin) or dipyridamole
Medicines used to manage stomach ulcers such as antacids (Ex. aluminium hydroxide, magnesium hydroxide) and proton-pump inhibitors (Ex. omeprazole or esomeprazole)
Other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (Ex. ibuprofen, paracetamol)
Glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitors (used during percutaneous coronary intervention) Ex. abciximab, eptifibatide and tirofiban
Medicines used to manage heart problems or hypertension (Ex. captopril, enalapril, lisinopril)
Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (used to manage depression) Ex. fluoxetine, sertraline, paroxetine etc
Methotrexate (used to manage cancer and other auto immune diseases)
Diuretics (used to increase urine output) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide
Acetazolamide (used to manage or manage altitude sickness)
Digoxin (used to manage abnormal heart rate)
Lithium (used to manage metal illness)
Corticosteroids (used to manage pain and inflammation) Ex. prednisolone, dexamethasone
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. phenytoin, valproic acid)
Ciclosporin or tacrolimus (used to manage graft rejection or manage auto-immune disease)
Ticlopidine (an antiplatelet medicine used to manage heart problems)
Medicines used to manage gout (such as probenecid, sulfinpyrazone or benzbromarone)
Fluconazole or voriconazole (used to manage fungal infection)
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (Ex. efavirenz or tenofovir)

Mifepristone (abortion pill)
Metoclopramide (used to manage vomiting)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else take too much of CIDOGREL A TABLET, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of CIDOGREL A TABLET might include increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, increased respiratory rate, hyperventilation, low blood sugar levels, low potassium and platelets levels in blood, increased body temperature, kidney failure, respiratory alkalosis, metabolic acidosis and pulmonary edema (non-cardiac related).

introduction:
Introduction About CLAVIX 75MG TABLET

CLAVIX 75MG TABLET is a prescription medication containing Clopidogrel, primarily used as a blood thinner (antiplatelet) to reduce blood clots. It helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.

This medication can be taken with or without food and should be taken at the same time every day. It is crucial to continue taking it, even if you feel fine. Stopping the medication could increase your risk of having a heart attack or stroke.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, bleeding, bruising, stomach upset. Bleeding in the form of bruising, nose bleeds, blood in urine or stools (black-colored stools), or heavier periods than usual in women. If you cut or injure yourself, the bleeding may take longer than usual to stop. Typically, these bleeding episodes are mild and will resolve on their own. However, it is important to see a doctor immediately if the bleeding continues or if you are concerned.

This medication is not suitable for everyone. Avoid taking it if you are experiencing bleeding from any part of your body, such as a stomach ulcer or internal bleeding in the brain. Prior to using this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of blood clotting issues or if you have recently undergone a major injury or surgery. You may need to temporarily stop taking this medicine before any planned surgeries or dental procedures.
uses: By reducing blood clot formation, it helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.

By reducing blood clot formation, it helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.
mechanismOfAction:
How CLAVIX 75MG TABLET Works

CLAVIX 75MG TABLET contains clopidogrel, an antiplatelet medication that works by inhibiting platelet aggregation. It does so by blocking the ADP (adenosine diphosphate) receptor on platelets, which is necessary for platelets to clump together and form blood clots. By preventing this process, CLAVIX 75MG TABLET reduces the risk of blood clots, thereby lowering the chances of stroke, heart attack, or other cardiovascular events in individuals with conditions like atherosclerosis, or those who have undergone procedures like stent placement.

a) CLAVIX 75MG TABLET Vs Ecosprin

Aspect

	

CLAVIX 75MG TABLET(Clopidogrel)

	

Ecosprin (Aspirin)




Drug Class

Antiplatelet (COX inhibitor)




Mechanism of Action

	

Inhibits ADP binding to P2Y12 receptors on platelets, preventing activation and aggregation.

	

Inhibits cyclooxygenase (COX-1 and COX-2), reducing thromboxane A2, which prevents platelet aggregation.




Primary Use

	

Prevents blood clots in conditions like atherosclerosis, heart attack, stroke, and peripheral artery disease.

	

Prevents blood clots in cardiovascular conditions, such as heart attack, stroke, and in the prevention of clot formation in people with cardiovascular disease.




Indications

- Primary and secondary prevention of heart attack and stroke


 	

- Stroke prevention

	

- Angina, myocardial infarction (MI) prevention


 	

- Myocardial infarction (MI) prevention

	

- Prevention of thrombotic events in high-risk patients




Onset of Action

	

2-4 hours

	

30 minutes to 1 hour




Duration of Action

	

24-48 hours (after a single dose)

	

4-6 hours




Side Effects

	

- Bleeding risk

	

- Gastrointestinal irritation (e.g., ulcers, bleeding)


 	

- Gastrointestinal issues (less common than aspirin)

	

- Allergic reactions, asthma exacerbation


 	

- Rarely, thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (TTP)

	

- Gastrointestinal bleeding (rare but serious)




Contraindications

	

- Active bleeding

	

- Active gastrointestinal bleeding


 	

- Severe liver impairment

	

- Asthma (in some cases), history of GI ulcers


 	

- Hypersensitivity to clopidogrel

	

- Hypersensitivity to aspirin




Risk of Bleeding

	

Higher bleeding risk (due to inhibition of platelet aggregation)

	

Higher risk of gastrointestinal bleeding, less platelet effect compared to Clopidogrel




Usage in Patients with GI Conditions

	

Preferred for patients with a history of GI issues (less GI irritation than aspirin)

	

May not be ideal for patients with active gastrointestinal ulcers or issues




Use in Patients with Asthma

	

Preferred (lower risk of asthma exacerbation)

	

Not preferred for patients with asthma (can exacerbate symptoms)




Clopidogrel vs Aspirin

	

Clopidogrel is often preferred for long-term antiplatelet therapy in patients with a high risk of bleeding or GI issues.

	

Aspirin is more commonly used for prevention in lower-risk patients due to its cost-effectiveness and availability.




Co-Administration with Other Medications

	

Often co-administered with aspirin in dual antiplatelet therapy, especially post-stent placement.

	

Can be taken alone or with other cardiovascular medications.

 

Why CLAVIX 75MG TABLET Might Be Preferred in Certain Cases:
Gastrointestinal Safety: CLAVIX 75MG TABLETtends to cause less gastrointestinal irritation compared to Ecosprin, making it a better choice for individuals with a history of gastric ulcers, gastritis, or other GI concerns.
Bleeding Risk Management: CLAVIX 75MG TABLEThas a more targeted mechanism of action (via the P2Y12 receptor), and its bleeding risk is often more manageable compared to aspirin's broader impact on COX enzymes, which can also increase the risk of gastrointestinal bleeding.
Asthma or Respiratory Concerns: CLAVIX 75MG TABLETis preferred in patients with asthma, as aspirin can exacerbate respiratory symptoms in individuals with asthma or other allergic conditions.
Long-Term Therapy: For patients needing long-term antiplatelet therapy, CLAVIX 75MG TABLET might be preferred over aspirin due to its more specific action on platelets, leading to a lower risk of side effects like gastrointestinal bleeding.

- No need for regular INR monitoring
- Fewer dietary restrictions

Why CLAVIX 75MG TABLET Might Be Preferred:
No Need for Regular Monitoring: CLAVIX 75MG TABLET does not require frequent blood tests, which is a significant advantage for patients who are unable to frequently visit healthcare providers for INR testing.
Fewer Dietary Restrictions: Unlike Coumadin, which requires careful monitoring of Vitamin K intake (present in many foods like leafy greens), CLAVIX 75MG TABLET does not have these restrictions, making it easier for patients to maintain a normal diet.
Faster Onset: CLAVIX 75MG TABLET acts more quickly than Coumadin, which is important for certain acute conditions like after coronary interventions.

introduction:
Introduction About EXAFIB 10 TABLET

EXAFIB 10 TABLET contains Rivaroxaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antithrombotic agents. It is used to manage deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and venous thromboembolism (VTE). It is also used to reduce the risk of stroke, systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, recurrence of DVT or PE, major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), and major thrombotic vascular events in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD). Venous thromboembolism is a condition that occurs due to clot formation in the venous circulation. It can also be used for THE management of DVT in patients undergoing knee or hip replacement surgery, VTE in acutely ill medical patients, and thrombosis in children (older than 2 years) with congenital heart disease post the Fontan procedure.

Before taking EXAFIB 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or bleeding problems or antiphospholipid syndrome. EXAFIB 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. EXAFIB 10 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh less than 2.6 kg. EXAFIB 10 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking EXAFIB 10 TABLET are bleeding, pain and swelling in the limbs, fever, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, low blood pressure (feeling dizzy or fainting when standing up), weakness, tiredness, headache, dizziness, rash, and itchy skin. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

How EXAFIB 10 TABLET Works

EXAFIB 10 TABLET works by competitively inhibiting factor Xa (a clotting factor) and managing the progression of the coagulation cascade through the final common pathway, thus managing thrombin generation.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking EXAFIB 10 TABLET unless your doctor advise.

warnings.details: EXAFIB 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women as it not known if it causes any harm to the unborn baby. Consult your doctor before taking it.
EXAFIB 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy after taking EXAFIB 10 TABLET.
EXAFIB 10 TABLET should be taken with caution in adults with severe kidney disease and children with moderate or severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking EXAFIB 10 TABLET.
EXAFIB 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease which leads to an increased risk of bleeding. Consult your doctor before taking EXAFIB 10 TABLET.
Do not take EXAFIB 10 TABLET if you are allergic to Rivaroxaban or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

EXAFIB 10 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with lung disease where the bronchi are widened and filled with pus, or those with previous bleeding from the lung. Consult your doctor before taking EXAFIB 10 TABLET.

EXAFIB 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with acute coronary syndrome, coronary artery disease, or peripheral artery disease. EXAFIB 10 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with very high or unstable blood pressure which is not controlled by medicines, prosthetic heart valve, or coronary artery disease with severe symptomatic heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking EXAFIB 10 TABLET.

EXAFIB 10 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended for use in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh 2.6 kg. EXAFIB 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in children with moderate to severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking EXAFIB 10 TABLET.
EXAFIB 10 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before taking EXAFIB 10 TABLET.

Others

EXAFIB 10 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are bleeding excessively
Have a disease or condition in an organ of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding (Ex. stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, recent operation of the brain or eyes)
Had stroke (previously had a bleeding or a blood clot in your brain)
Had lacunar stroke (blockage of the small arteries providing blood to the brain’s deep tissues) or ischemic, nonlacunar stroke (blood clot in your brain) in the previous month

Before taking EXAFIB 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have or had bleeding problems
Have antiphospholipid syndrome (immunity disorder that causes an increased risk of blood clots)
Have diseases of your stomach or bowel that might result in bleeding (Ex. inflammation of the bowels, stomach, or food pipe) or tumours in the stomach, bowels, genital tract, or urinary tract)
Have retinopathy (problem with the blood vessels in the back of your eyes)
Need to have an operation
Weigh less than 60 kg

Before taking EXAFIB 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used for fungal infections (Ex. fluconazole, itraconazole, voriconazole, posaconazole), unless they are used on the skin

name: Revolade 25mg Tablet 7'S
introduction:
Introduction About REVOLADE 25MG TABLET

REVOLADE 25MG TABLET contains Eltrombopag which belongs to the group of medicines called Thrombopoietin-receptor agonist. REVOLADE 25MG TABLET is used to manage immune thrombocytopenia (platelet disorder) in patients aged 1-year/above when other medicines (such as corticosteroids/immunoglobulins) become ineffective to manage the disease.

REVOLADE 25MG TABLET is also used to manage thrombocytopenia (low platelet count) in adults suffering from hepatitis C (viral) infection. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage low blood counts in adults suffering from severe aplastic anemia (rare blood disorder that occurs due to failure of bone marrow to produce new blood cells).

REVOLADE 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Eltrombopag.

Before taking REVOLADE 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are at a risk of developing blood clot in veins/arteries, and/or have cancer, obesity, advanced chronic liver disease, and/or kidney problems (such as renal impairment).

REVOLADE 25MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy unless it is clearly necessary. Women of childbearing potential should use effective contraceptive measures while in management with REVOLADE 25MG TABLET. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women since it is not known whether the medicine may pass through breastmilk.

REVOLADE 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (aged below 1-year) suffering from immune thrombocytopenia. It is also not recommended for use in children (aged below 18 years) suffering from low platelet counts due to hepatitis C/severe aplastic anemia. The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking REVOLADE 25MG TABLET are common cold, cough, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, and/or hair loss. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

How REVOLADE 25MG TABLET Works

Signs of blood clot such as swelling/pain/tenderness in one leg, sudden shortness of breath (associated with sharp pain in the chest), rapid breathing, stomach pain, enlarged abdomen, and/or blood in stools
Signs of liver problems such as yellowing of skin/ whites of the eyes (jaundice), dark-colored urine
Signs of bleeding in the digestive system such as vomiting blood, black tarry stools, and/or blood in stools

introduction:
Introduction About GOODFLO 150MG CAPSULE

GOODFLO 150MG CAPSULE contains Dabigatran etexilate which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used to manage stroke, systemic embolism and reduction of vascular mortality in adult patients with atrial fibrillation and venous thromboembolic events in patients who have undergone orthopaedic surgery.

It is also used to manage acute deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and/or pulmonary embolism (PE) and manages recurrent deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and /or pulmonary embolism (PE). This medicine is also used in children to manage blood clots and to manage blood clots from reoccurring.

Avoid taking GOODFLO 150MG CAPSULE, if you currently have bleeding disorders, organ disease of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding such as stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, severely reduced kidney or liver function.

Before taking GOODFLO 150MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have increased bleeding risks such as s bone fracture, head injury or any injury requiring surgical management, lung or heart problems.

GOODFLO 150MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking GOODFLO 150MG CAPSULE.

Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your child’s age body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before taking GOODFLO 150MG CAPSULE.

The most common side effects of taking GOODFLO 150MG CAPSULE are stomachache, indigestion, frequent loose or liquid bowel movements and or nausea. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.

GOODFLO 150MG CAPSULE works by blocking thrombin (blood central clotting agent) that results in the management of blood clots thereby managing the occurrence of stroke, heart attack, deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism.

name: TORPLAT 90mg Tablet 14's
introduction:
Introduction About TORPLAT 90MG TABLET

TORPLAT 90MG TABLET contains ticagrelor which belongs to the group of medicines called antiplatelet agents. It is used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction. It also reduces the rate of stent thrombosis in patients who have been stented for management of ACS.

Ticagrelor stops clumping of blood cells called platelets, which is responsible for clot formation in diseased blood vessels of heart and brain and thus reduces the chances of a blood clot formation. It can be taken with or without food.

Avoid concomitant use of ticagrelor and other oral anticoagulants like heparin or warfarin, as it may increase the risk of side effects. Do not take this medicine if you are suffering from any bleeding disorders or liver problems. This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. The most common side effect of taking this medicine are bleeding and bruising.
uses: Used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction
usesDetails:
Uses Of TORPLAT 90MG TABLET
Used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction
mechanismOfAction:
How TORPLAT 90MG TABLET Works

Ticagrelor is a potent P2Y12 receptor antagonist. In diseased blood vessels, platelets can form thrombus (blood clot) by binding to the arterial surface. Activated platelets produces ADP3 which binds to P2Y12 receptor and propagates thrombus formation. Ticagrelor reversibly binds to P2Y12 receptor instead of ADP3 and prevents the signal transduction and platelet activation, that can lead to blood clot formation.
usageDetails:
How to use TORPLAT 90MG TABLET

Take this medicine as directed by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your condition. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Continue to take this medicine, as long as your doctor tells you to do so, to obtain better results.

introduction:
Introduction About CUTENOX 40MG PREFILLED SYRINGE

CUTENOX 40MG PREFILLED SYRINGE contains Enoxaparin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used to manage blood clot formation in the body.

CUTENOX 40MG PREFILLED SYRINGE works by stopping the blood clots formation. It also manages the existing blood clots from growing bigger in size. Due to this property, it is highly used as a prophylactic therapy for managing blood clot formation during risky conditions that involves clot formation such as before or after a surgery, during dialysis or after a heart attack or a severe chest pain (angina).

It can also be used to reduce the risk of blood clot formation caused due to prolong period of immobility or due to cancer therapy.

Before receiving CUTENOX 40MG PREFILLED SYRINGE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure or a history of stomach ulcer.

CUTENOX 40MG PREFILLED SYRINGE is not recommended for use in patients who are bleeding heavily or have any pre-existing conditions (such as stomach ulcer or stroke) that can increase the risk of internal bleeding. It is also not suitable for use in patients scheduled for spinal anesthesia or lumbar puncture.

Inform your doctor before receiving CUTENOX 40MG PREFILLED SYRINGE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of receiving CUTENOX 40MG PREFILLED SYRINGE are injection site reactions (such as pain or irritation), skin rashes, low platelet count, bleeding or bruising and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage and manages blood clots in the body

Manage and manages blood clots in the body
mechanismOfAction:
How CUTENOX 40MG PREFILLED SYRINGE Works

CUTENOX 40MG PREFILLED SYRINGE is an anticoagulant medicine. It inactivates certain proteins (such as coagulation factor II a and X a) in the blood that causes blood clotting. This reduces the chances of blood clot formation within the body which therefore manages blockage of blood vessels.
usageDetails:
How to use CUTENOX 40MG PREFILLED SYRINGE

CUTENOX 40MG PREFILLED SYRINGE will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or under the skin (subcutaneously).

It can also be self-administered by the patients if advised by the physician. Carefully, follow the instructions given by the doctor in case of self-administration.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Have a previous history of heparin-induced thrombocytopenia (low platelet count in blood)

name: RIVAFLO 20 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About RIVAFLO 20 TABLET

RIVAFLO 20 TABLET contains Rivaroxaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antithrombotic agents. It is used to manage deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and venous thromboembolism (VTE). It is also used to reduce the risk of stroke, systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, recurrence of DVT or PE, major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), and major thrombotic vascular events in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD). Venous thromboembolism is a condition that occurs due to clot formation in the venous circulation. It can also be used for THE management of DVT in patients undergoing knee or hip replacement surgery, VTE in acutely ill medical patients, and thrombosis in children (older than 2 years) with congenital heart disease post the Fontan procedure.

Before taking RIVAFLO 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or bleeding problems or antiphospholipid syndrome. RIVAFLO 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. RIVAFLO 20 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh less than 2.6 kg. RIVAFLO 20 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking RIVAFLO 20 TABLET are bleeding, pain and swelling in the limbs, fever, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, low blood pressure (feeling dizzy or fainting when standing up), weakness, tiredness, headache, dizziness, rash, and itchy skin. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

How RIVAFLO 20 TABLET Works

RIVAFLO 20 TABLET works by competitively inhibiting factor Xa (a clotting factor) and managing the progression of the coagulation cascade through the final common pathway, thus managing thrombin generation.
usageDetails:

Take RIVAFLO 20 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking RIVAFLO 20 TABLET unless your doctor advise.

Others

Are bleeding excessively

Had stroke (previously had a bleeding or a blood clot in your brain)
Had lacunar stroke (blockage of the small arteries providing blood to the brain’s deep tissues) or ischemic, nonlacunar stroke (blood clot in your brain) in the previous month

Have or had bleeding problems

Have retinopathy (problem with the blood vessels in the back of your eyes)
Need to have an operation
Weigh less than 60 kg

introduction:
Introduction About CREVAST GOLD 20MG CAPSULE

CREVAST GOLD 20MG CAPSULE is used in the management of acute coronary syndrome, myocardial infarction, angina and stroke. It is a combination of Aspirin, Clopidogrel and Rosuvastatin which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs, Antiplatelets and HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors respectively.   

Along with CREVAST GOLD 20MG CAPSULE management follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during the therapy, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract. It is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney, or heart disease.  

CREVAST GOLD 20MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). The most common side effects are increased bleeding tendency, nausea, indigestion, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, muscle pain, dizziness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

How CREVAST GOLD 20MG CAPSULE Works

CREVAST GOLD 20MG CAPSULE effectively improves cardiac function and reduces the risk of heart problems, where clopidogrel acts by inhibiting platelet aggregation in the coronary arteries, aspirin acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called cyclo-oxygenase which is believed to be responsible for catalyzing the synthesis of platelets and rosuvastatin acts by inhibiting the action of an enzyme called HMG-CoA reductase, which is required to catalyze the formation of cholesterol, thus managing clot or plaque formation in the coronary arteries leading to an uninterrupted supply of oxygen and blood to the heart.

introduction:
Introduction About BRILINTA 90MG TABLET

Brilinta 90mg Tablet is a prescription medication used to reduce blood clots in individuals who have had a heart attack or are at risk of stroke. It works by inhibiting platelets, thus reducing the risk of clot formation in the blood vessels.

Your doctor may also prescribe aspirin, an additional antiplatelet medication, alongside Brilinta 90mg Tablet. You can take Brilinta with or without food, and it is important to take it consistently at the same time each day. Continue taking the medication as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Stopping it could raise your risk of having another heart attack or stroke.

Common side effect of this medication includes headache, dizziness, shortness of breath, dyspnea (breathlessness) and bleeding. If you cut or injure yourself, it might take longer than normal for the bleeding to stop. These bleeding episodes are typically mild and should resolve on their own. Mild breathlessness caused by this medication generally improves with ongoing management. However, inform your doctor if the bleeding continues or if the breathlessness becomes more severe or does not improve.

Brilinta 90mg Tablet may not be appropriate for certain individuals. Avoid taking it if you are experiencing bleeding anywhere in the body, such as from a stomach ulcer or internal bleeding in the brain. It is also not recommended for those with liver conditions. Be sure to inform your doctor about any such problems before taking this medication.

mechanismOfAction:
How BRILINTA 90MG TABLET Works

Brilinta 90mg works by inhibiting platelet aggregation, which helps reduce blood clots from forming. It is an antiplatelet medication that selectively and reversibly binds to the P2Y12 receptor on platelets, blocking the action of ADP (adenosine diphosphate) and thereby reducing platelet activation and aggregation. This effect helps reduce cardiovascular events like heart attacks and strokes in patients with a history of acute coronary syndrome or those undergoing procedures like stent placement. By reducing clot formation, Brilinta lowers the risk of further complications related to blood clots in the arteries.

More Information
01.Product Comparison
a) Brilinta Vs Plavix

Aspect

	

Brilinta (Ticagrelor) 90mg

	

Plavix (Clopidogrel)




Mechanism of Action

	

Reversible P2Y12 receptor inhibitor that prevents platelet aggregation.

	

Irreversible P2Y12 receptor inhibitor, reduces platelet aggregation.




Onset of Action

	

Faster onset (1-3 hours)

	

Slower onset (2-6 hours)




Duration of Action

	

Shorter duration (approximately 12 hours)

	

Longer duration (approximately 5-7 days)




Metabolism

	

Primarily metabolized in the liver by CYP3A4 and CYP3A5.

	

Metabolized in the liver by CYP2C19.




Effect on Platelet Function

	

More potent and consistent inhibition of platelet aggregation.

	

Less potent and may have variable effect due to genetic differences.




Indications

	

Acute coronary syndrome (ACS), following heart attacks or stenting.

	

ACS, stroke prevention, peripheral artery disease.




Common Side Effects

	

Shortness of breath, bleeding, bradycardia, elevated uric acid.

	

Bleeding, bruising, rash, diarrhea.




Risk of Bleeding

	

Moderate risk of bleeding, though less than some other anticoagulants.

	

Moderate risk of bleeding.




Required Dosing

	

Twice daily (typically 90mg twice a day)

	

Once daily (75mg dose)




Food and Drug Interactions

	

Interacts with CYP3A4 inhibitors, which may require dose adjustments.

	

Interactions with CYP2C19 inhibitors, may require dose adjustments.




Efficacy in ACS

	

Proven to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events in ACS.

	

Effective but may not be as potent in reducing cardiovascular events in ACS.




Reversibility

	

Reversible platelet inhibition, allowing a quicker return of normal platelet function.

	

Irreversible platelet inhibition, takes longer to recover normal platelet function.




Special Considerations

	

Not recommended in patients with severe liver disease or significant bleeding risk.

	

Lower efficacy in patients with poor CYP2C19 metabolism.

Why Brilinta (Ticagrelor) 90mg stands out:

Faster Onset: Brilinta starts working faster, which is especially beneficial in acute situations like heart attacks.
Reversible Inhibition: Brilinta’s reversible action allows a faster return to normal platelet function compared to Plavix’s irreversible effect.
More Potent: Brilinta is generally more potent and consistent in preventing platelet aggregation, which leads to better clinical outcomes in some patients.
Lower Risk of Clopidogrel Resistance: Brilinta avoids the genetic variability of Clopidogrel, which may be less effective in some individuals due to their genetic makeup.
Dual Antiplatelet Therapy: Brilinta is preferred in certain dual antiplatelet therapy regimens post-ACS or stent placement due to its superior outcomes.

 

b) Brilinta 90mg tablet Vs Ecotrin

Feature

	

Brilinta 90mg Tablet

	

Ecotrin (Aspirin)




Active Ingredient

	

Ticagrelor

	

Acetylsalicylic Acid (Aspirin)




Class of Drug

	

Antiplatelet agent (P2Y12 receptor inhibitor)

	

Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID)




Primary Indication

	

Prevents blood clots in patients with acute coronary syndrome or those with a history of heart attack

	

Reduces pain, inflammation, and prevents blood clots




Mechanism of Action

	

Inhibits platelet aggregation by blocking the P2Y12 receptor on platelets

	

Inhibits cyclooxygenase (COX), reducing thromboxane A2 production, thereby preventing platelet aggregation




Formulation

	

Oral tablet (90mg)

	

Oral tablet (various doses, typically 81mg, 325mg)




Onset of Action

	

Fast-acting, with peak effects within 1.5 hours

	

Slow onset, with effects occurring within 30-60 minutes




Duration of Effect

	

Longer duration of platelet inhibition (up to 5 days)

	

Effects last a few hours, depending on the dose




Efficacy in Cardiovascular Events

	

Highly effective in preventing heart attacks, strokes, and other cardiovascular events in high-risk patients

	

Effective for general clot prevention, but less potent in preventing recurrent cardiovascular events




Side Effects

	

Higher risk of bleeding, shortness of breath, headache, dizziness, bradycardia

	

GI irritation, ulcers, bleeding, tinnitus (with high doses)




Specific Indication for ACS

	

Indicated for acute coronary syndrome (ACS) patients (e.g., after heart attack or angioplasty)

	

Not specifically indicated for ACS; more general clot prevention




Patient Group

	

Used in high-risk cardiovascular patients, including those with ACS or a history of heart attack

	

Commonly used in general cardiovascular prevention and pain relief, suitable for a broader patient group




Bleeding Risk

	

Higher bleeding risk due to more potent platelet inhibition

	

Moderate bleeding risk, lower than Brilinta




Reversible Antiplatelet Effect

	

Yes, effect is reversible upon discontinuation within a short period

	

No, effect persists for the duration of platelet life (7-10 days)




Drug Interactions

	

Stronger drug interactions due to CYP3A4 metabolism (e.g., statins, antifungals)

	

Interactions with other blood thinners, certain antihypertensives, and alcohol




FDA Approval for Stroke Prevention

	

Yes, indicated for reducing the risk of stroke in high-risk patients

	

Not directly indicated for stroke prevention (primarily used for cardiovascular prevention)

Why Brilinta 90mg Tablet Stands Out:

More Potent Platelet Inhibition: Brilinta offers a more potent and sustained effect in preventing platelet aggregation, especially in high-risk cardiovascular patients, making it more effective in preventing heart attacks and strokes in acute coronary syndrome (ACS) patients.

introduction:
Introduction About CLOFLOW 75MG TABLET

CLOFLOW 75MG TABLET is a prescription medication containing Clopidogrel, primarily used as a blood thinner (antiplatelet) to reduce blood clots. It helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.

This medication can be taken with or without food and should be taken at the same time every day. It is crucial to continue taking it, even if you feel fine. Stopping the medication could increase your risk of having a heart attack or stroke.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, bleeding, bruising, stomach upset. Bleeding in the form of bruising, nose bleeds, blood in urine or stools (black-colored stools), or heavier periods than usual in women. If you cut or injure yourself, the bleeding may take longer than usual to stop. Typically, these bleeding episodes are mild and will resolve on their own. However, it is important to see a doctor immediately if the bleeding continues or if you are concerned.

This medication is not suitable for everyone. Avoid taking it if you are experiencing bleeding from any part of your body, such as a stomach ulcer or internal bleeding in the brain. Prior to using this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of blood clotting issues or if you have recently undergone a major injury or surgery. You may need to temporarily stop taking this medicine before any planned surgeries or dental procedures.

mechanismOfAction:
How CLOFLOW 75MG TABLET Works

CLOFLOW 75MG TABLET contains clopidogrel, an antiplatelet medication that works by inhibiting platelet aggregation. It does so by blocking the ADP (adenosine diphosphate) receptor on platelets, which is necessary for platelets to clump together and form blood clots. By preventing this process, CLOFLOW 75MG TABLET reduces the risk of blood clots, thereby lowering the chances of stroke, heart attack, or other cardiovascular events in individuals with conditions like atherosclerosis, or those who have undergone procedures like stent placement.

introduction:
Introduction About RIVARED 10 TABLET

RIVARED 10 TABLET contains Rivaroxaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antithrombotic agents. It is used to manage deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and venous thromboembolism (VTE). It is also used to reduce the risk of stroke, systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, recurrence of DVT or PE, major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), and major thrombotic vascular events in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD). Venous thromboembolism is a condition that occurs due to clot formation in the venous circulation. It can also be used for THE management of DVT in patients undergoing knee or hip replacement surgery, VTE in acutely ill medical patients, and thrombosis in children (older than 2 years) with congenital heart disease post the Fontan procedure.

Before taking RIVARED 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or bleeding problems or antiphospholipid syndrome. RIVARED 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. RIVARED 10 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh less than 2.6 kg. RIVARED 10 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking RIVARED 10 TABLET are bleeding, pain and swelling in the limbs, fever, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, low blood pressure (feeling dizzy or fainting when standing up), weakness, tiredness, headache, dizziness, rash, and itchy skin. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

RIVARED 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with acute coronary syndrome, coronary artery disease, or peripheral artery disease. RIVARED 10 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with very high or unstable blood pressure which is not controlled by medicines, prosthetic heart valve, or coronary artery disease with severe symptomatic heart failure. Others

Are bleeding excessively
Have a disease or condition in an organ of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding (Ex. stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, recent operation of the brain or eyes)
Had stroke (previously had a bleeding or a blood clot in your brain)

Have or had bleeding problems
Have antiphospholipid syndrome (immunity disorder that causes an increased risk of blood clots)
Have diseases of your stomach or bowel that might result in bleeding (Ex. inflammation of the bowels, stomach, or food pipe) or tumours in the stomach, bowels, genital tract, or urinary tract)
Have retinopathy (problem with the blood vessels in the back of your eyes)

Introduction About AZTOGOLD 10 CAPSULE

AZTOGOLD 10 CAPSULE is a combination medicine used in the management of heart attack. It is commonly prescribed for patients with percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) and myocardial infarction to reduce the risks of further heart attacks.

Take AZTOGOLD 10 CAPSULE with food, ideally at the same time every day, to maintain consistency and enhance its effectiveness. Follow your doctor's prescribed dosage and schedule, and do not discontinue use without medical advice, even if you feel better. Lifestyle modifications, such as following a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can significantly boost the effectiveness of this medication.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking AZTOGOLD 10 CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.    

Before starting AZTOGOLD 10 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney disease. If you are pregnant, planning to conceive, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before use. Additionally, disclose all other medications you are taking to avoid potential drug interactions.

The most common side effects of taking AZTOGOLD 10 CAPSULE are abdominal pain, indigestion, bruising, and nosebleeds. Since this medication increases the risk of bleeding, take extra precautions while shaving, trimming nails, or handling sharp objects. Seek immediate medical attention if you notice symptoms like muscle pain or weakness, yellowing of the skin, or dark urine. Avoid consuming alcohol while on this medication, as it may amplify side effects.

mechanismOfAction:
How AZTOGOLD 10 CAPSULE Works

AZTOGOLD 10 CAPSULE contains a combination of three medicines, namely aspirin, atorvastatin, and clopidogrel which works synergistically to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events like heart attacks and strokes by targeting different aspects of blood clotting and cholesterol management:

Aspirin and Clopidogrel are antiplatelet medicines that prevents platelets from sticking together, further reducing the risk of clot formation and enhancing blood flow in the arteries. By reducing platelet clumping, this medicine helps maintain smooth blood flow and prevents clots in blood vessels.

Atorvastatin is a statin that inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, the enzyme involved in cholesterol synthesis in the liver. It lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while increasing HDL (good cholesterol), which reduces plaque buildup in arteries (atherosclerosis) and improves blood vessel health.

Together, this medicine offers comprehensive cardiovascular protection by reducing clot formation, improving lipid profiles, and reducing  the risk for narrowing of blood vessels, significantly lowering the risk of heart attacks and strokes.
usageDetails:
How to use AZTOGOLD 10 CAPSULE

AZTOGOLD 10 CAPSULE should be taken exactly as prescribed by your doctor for optimal results.

It is best to take this medicine with food to avoid stomach discomfort.

Take it at the same time every day to ensure consistent blood levels and maximum effectiveness.

Swallow the medicine whole with water; do not crush or chew it.

Follow your doctor’s recommended dosage schedule, and do not skip doses or stop the medication without consulting your healthcare provider.

For best results, combine this medication with a healthy lifestyle, including a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking. Always consult your doctor if you have any questions about its use.

Missed dosage instructions for AZTOGOLD 10 CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose of AZTOGOLD 10 CAPSULE, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double up on doses to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects. To avoid missing doses in the future, try taking the medication at the same time every day and consider setting reminders. If you are unsure about what to do, consult your doctor or pharmacist for advice.

Overdosage instructions for AZTOGOLD 10 CAPSULE:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of AZTOGOLD 10 CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of AZTOGOLD 10 CAPSULE includes increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting (sometimes with blood), increased body temperature, low blood sugar levels, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, kidney failure, increased respiratory rate and hyperventilation.

introduction:
Introduction About CLOPICARD AP 75MG TABLET

CLOPICARD AP 75MG TABLET is a combination of Aspirin and Clopidogrel which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiplatelets. CLOPICARD AP 75MG TABLET is used in the management of early and long-term atherothrombotic events such as myocardial infarction (also known as heart attack), stroke (reduced blood supply to brain leading to brain death), cardiovascular death or refractory ischemia (chest pain due to inadequate blood supply to the heart) in patients having acute coronary syndrome with or without cardiac revascularization (including surgical or PCI, with or without stent insertion).

Acute coronary syndrome is a heart condition caused by plaque rupture or clot formation in the coronary arteries. Symptoms include heart attack, chest pressure or pain while at rest, shortness of breath and sweating.

Along management with CLOPICARD AP 75MG TABLET follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during management with CLOPICARD AP 75MG TABLET, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.

Do not stop taking CLOPICARD AP 75MG TABLET abruptly without consulting your doctor because premature discontinuation of this medicine may increase the risk of cardiovascular events. CLOPICARD AP 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney or lung disease.

CLOPICARD AP 75MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). Consult your doctor for an alternative therapy.

The most common side effects of taking CLOPICARD AP 75MG TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ELIXABAN 2.5 TABLET

ELIXABAN 2.5 TABLET contains Apixaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used in adults to manage blood clots from forming after hip or knee replacement operations and to manage blood clots (clusters of blood) in patients with an irregular heartbeat (atrial fibrillation). It also helps in the management of blood clots in the legs (deep vein thrombosis) and the veins of the lungs (pulmonary embolism) and the management of their recurrence in either the legs or lungs.

GBNKEYWORD] is not recommended in patients who have liver disease, active bleeding, or a disease that can lead to active bleeding, such as an active ulcer or a recent bleed in the brain. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before taking ELIXABAN 2.5 TABLET. Patients who have kidney disease should use ELIXABAN 2.5 TABLET with caution. ELIXABAN 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for children and adolescents (under the age of 18). ELIXABAN 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients over the age of 75.

The most common side effects of taking ELIXABAN 2.5 TABLET are bleeding (eyes, nose, gums, urine, rectum, stomach, or bowel), bruising or swelling, anemia, low blood pressure, and a quickened heart rate. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor immediately.

introduction:
Introduction About ECOSPRIN GOLD 40 CAPSULE

ECOSPRIN GOLD 40 CAPSULE is a combination medicine used in the management of heart attack. It is commonly prescribed for patients with percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) and myocardial infarction to reduce the risks of further heart attacks.

Take ECOSPRIN GOLD 40 CAPSULE with food, ideally at the same time every day, to maintain consistency and enhance its effectiveness. Follow your doctor's prescribed dosage and schedule, and do not discontinue use without medical advice, even if you feel better. Lifestyle modifications, such as following a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can significantly boost the effectiveness of this medication.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking ECOSPRIN GOLD 40 CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.    

Before starting ECOSPRIN GOLD 40 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney disease. If you are pregnant, planning to conceive, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before use. Additionally, disclose all other medications you are taking to avoid potential drug interactions.

The most common side effects of taking ECOSPRIN GOLD 40 CAPSULE are abdominal pain, indigestion, bruising, and nosebleeds. Since this medication increases the risk of bleeding, take extra precautions while shaving, trimming nails, or handling sharp objects. Seek immediate medical attention if you notice symptoms like muscle pain or weakness, yellowing of the skin, or dark urine. Avoid consuming alcohol while on this medication, as it may amplify side effects.
uses: Heart Attack
ECOSPRIN GOLD 40 CAPSULE is a powerful medication designed to lower the risk of heart attacks by combining antiplatelet and cholesterol-lowering agents.
It prevents blood clots by stopping platelets from sticking together, ensuring smooth blood flow and reducing the risk of blockages in arteries.
Additionally, it lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while boosting HDL (good cholesterol), promoting better cardiovascular health.

By reducing the chances for atherosclerosis (hardening of arteries) and reducing the recurrence of heart attacks, this medication offers comprehensive heart protection. When combined with a healthy lifestyle, such as a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, ECOSPRIN GOLD 40 CAPSULE significantly enhances heart health.

mechanismOfAction:
How ECOSPRIN GOLD 40 CAPSULE Works

ECOSPRIN GOLD 40 CAPSULE contains a combination of three medicines, namely aspirin, atorvastatin, and clopidogrel which works synergistically to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events like heart attacks and strokes by targeting different aspects of blood clotting and cholesterol management:

Aspirin and Clopidogrel are antiplatelet medicines that prevents platelets from sticking together, further reducing the risk of clot formation and enhancing blood flow in the arteries. By reducing platelet clumping, this medicine helps maintain smooth blood flow and prevents clots in blood vessels.

Atorvastatin is a statin that inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, the enzyme involved in cholesterol synthesis in the liver. It lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while increasing HDL (good cholesterol), which reduces plaque buildup in arteries (atherosclerosis) and improves blood vessel health.

Together, this medicine offers comprehensive cardiovascular protection by reducing clot formation, improving lipid profiles, and reducing  the risk for narrowing of blood vessels, significantly lowering the risk of heart attacks and strokes.
usageDetails:
How to use ECOSPRIN GOLD 40 CAPSULE

ECOSPRIN GOLD 40 CAPSULE should be taken exactly as prescribed by your doctor for optimal results.

It is best to take this medicine with food to avoid stomach discomfort.

Take it at the same time every day to ensure consistent blood levels and maximum effectiveness.

Swallow the medicine whole with water; do not crush or chew it.

Follow your doctor’s recommended dosage schedule, and do not skip doses or stop the medication without consulting your healthcare provider.

For best results, combine this medication with a healthy lifestyle, including a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking. Always consult your doctor if you have any questions about its use.

Missed dosage instructions for ECOSPRIN GOLD 40 CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose of ECOSPRIN GOLD 40 CAPSULE, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double up on doses to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects. To avoid missing doses in the future, try taking the medication at the same time every day and consider setting reminders. If you are unsure about what to do, consult your doctor or pharmacist for advice.

Overdosage instructions for ECOSPRIN GOLD 40 CAPSULE:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of ECOSPRIN GOLD 40 CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of ECOSPRIN GOLD 40 CAPSULE includes increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting (sometimes with blood), increased body temperature, low blood sugar levels, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, kidney failure, increased respiratory rate and hyperventilation.

mechanismOfAction:
How CLOPILET A 75 CAPSULE Works
Clopidogrel is a prodrug: It requires activation in the liver by enzymes, mainly CYP2C19, to become effective.
It irreversibly inhibits the P2Y12 receptor: This receptor is found on the surface of platelets (blood cells involved in clotting).
Blocking the receptor: stops ADP (adenosine diphosphate) from binding to the P2Y12 receptor, which stops the activation of platelets.
Stops platelet aggregation: As a result, platelets do not stick together easily, reducing blood clot formation.
Long-lasting effect: Because it irreversibly binds, the inhibition lasts for the lifespan of the platelet, about 7-10 days.
Supports blood flow: This mechanism helps lower the risk of clots blocking blood vessels, supporting cardiovascular health.

Introduction About DEPLATT CV 40 CAPSULE

DEPLATT CV 40 CAPSULE is a combination medicine used in the management of heart attack. It is commonly prescribed for patients with percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) and myocardial infarction to reduce the risks of further heart attacks.

Take DEPLATT CV 40 CAPSULE with food, ideally at the same time every day, to maintain consistency and enhance its effectiveness. Follow your doctor's prescribed dosage and schedule, and do not discontinue use without medical advice, even if you feel better. Lifestyle modifications, such as following a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can significantly boost the effectiveness of this medication.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking DEPLATT CV 40 CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.    

Before starting DEPLATT CV 40 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney disease. If you are pregnant, planning to conceive, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before use. Additionally, disclose all other medications you are taking to avoid potential drug interactions.

The most common side effects of taking DEPLATT CV 40 CAPSULE are abdominal pain, indigestion, bruising, and nosebleeds. Since this medication increases the risk of bleeding, take extra precautions while shaving, trimming nails, or handling sharp objects. Seek immediate medical attention if you notice symptoms like muscle pain or weakness, yellowing of the skin, or dark urine. Avoid consuming alcohol while on this medication, as it may amplify side effects.

mechanismOfAction:
How DEPLATT CV 40 CAPSULE Works

DEPLATT CV 40 CAPSULE contains a combination of three medicines, namely aspirin, atorvastatin, and clopidogrel which works synergistically to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events like heart attacks and strokes by targeting different aspects of blood clotting and cholesterol management:

Aspirin and Clopidogrel are antiplatelet medicines that prevents platelets from sticking together, further reducing the risk of clot formation and enhancing blood flow in the arteries. By reducing platelet clumping, this medicine helps maintain smooth blood flow and prevents clots in blood vessels.

Atorvastatin is a statin that inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, the enzyme involved in cholesterol synthesis in the liver. It lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while increasing HDL (good cholesterol), which reduces plaque buildup in arteries (atherosclerosis) and improves blood vessel health.

Together, this medicine offers comprehensive cardiovascular protection by reducing clot formation, improving lipid profiles, and reducing  the risk for narrowing of blood vessels, significantly lowering the risk of heart attacks and strokes.

How to use DEPLATT CV 40 CAPSULE

DEPLATT CV 40 CAPSULE should be taken exactly as prescribed by your doctor for optimal results.

It is best to take this medicine with food to avoid stomach discomfort.

Take it at the same time every day to ensure consistent blood levels and maximum effectiveness.

Swallow the medicine whole with water; do not crush or chew it.

Follow your doctor’s recommended dosage schedule, and do not skip doses or stop the medication without consulting your healthcare provider.

For best results, combine this medication with a healthy lifestyle, including a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking. Always consult your doctor if you have any questions about its use.

Missed dosage instructions for DEPLATT CV 40 CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose of DEPLATT CV 40 CAPSULE, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double up on doses to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects. To avoid missing doses in the future, try taking the medication at the same time every day and consider setting reminders. If you are unsure about what to do, consult your doctor or pharmacist for advice.

Overdosage instructions for DEPLATT CV 40 CAPSULE:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of DEPLATT CV 40 CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of DEPLATT CV 40 CAPSULE includes increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting (sometimes with blood), increased body temperature, low blood sugar levels, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, kidney failure, increased respiratory rate and hyperventilation.

introduction:
Introduction About AFOGATRAN 110MG CAPSULE

AFOGATRAN 110MG CAPSULE contains Dabigatran etexilate which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used to manage stroke, systemic embolism and reduction of vascular mortality in adult patients with atrial fibrillation and venous thromboembolic events in patients who have undergone orthopaedic surgery.

It is also used to manage acute deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and/or pulmonary embolism (PE) and manages recurrent deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and /or pulmonary embolism (PE). This medicine is also used in children to manage blood clots and to manage blood clots from reoccurring.

Avoid taking AFOGATRAN 110MG CAPSULE, if you currently have bleeding disorders, organ disease of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding such as stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, severely reduced kidney or liver function.

Before taking AFOGATRAN 110MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have increased bleeding risks such as s bone fracture, head injury or any injury requiring surgical management, lung or heart problems.

AFOGATRAN 110MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking AFOGATRAN 110MG CAPSULE.

Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your child’s age body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before taking AFOGATRAN 110MG CAPSULE.

The most common side effects of taking AFOGATRAN 110MG CAPSULE are stomachache, indigestion, frequent loose or liquid bowel movements and or nausea. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.

How AFOGATRAN 110MG CAPSULE Works

AFOGATRAN 110MG CAPSULE works by blocking thrombin (blood central clotting agent) that results in the management of blood clots thereby managing the occurrence of stroke, heart attack, deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism.

name: RICOSPRIN 2.5 Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET

RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET contains Rivaroxaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antithrombotic agents. It is used to manage deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and venous thromboembolism (VTE). It is also used to reduce the risk of stroke, systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, recurrence of DVT or PE, major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), and major thrombotic vascular events in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD). Venous thromboembolism is a condition that occurs due to clot formation in the venous circulation. It can also be used for THE management of DVT in patients undergoing knee or hip replacement surgery, VTE in acutely ill medical patients, and thrombosis in children (older than 2 years) with congenital heart disease post the Fontan procedure.

Before taking RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or bleeding problems or antiphospholipid syndrome. RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh less than 2.6 kg. RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET are bleeding, pain and swelling in the limbs, fever, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, low blood pressure (feeling dizzy or fainting when standing up), weakness, tiredness, headache, dizziness, rash, and itchy skin. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

To manage deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), venous thromboembolism (VTE)
To reduces the risk of stroke, systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, recurrence of DVT or PE, major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), and major thrombotic vascular conditions in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD)
To manage DVT in patients undergoing knee or hip replacement surgery, VTE in acutely ill medical patients, and thrombosis in children (2 years and older) with congenital heart disease post the Fontan procedure
mechanismOfAction:
How RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET Works

RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET works by competitively inhibiting factor Xa (a clotting factor) and managing the progression of the coagulation cascade through the final common pathway, thus managing thrombin generation.

Do not take RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET if you are allergic to Rivaroxaban or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with lung disease where the bronchi are widened and filled with pus, or those with previous bleeding from the lung. Consult your doctor before taking RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET.

RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with acute coronary syndrome, coronary artery disease, or peripheral artery disease. RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with very high or unstable blood pressure which is not controlled by medicines, prosthetic heart valve, or coronary artery disease with severe symptomatic heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET.

RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended for use in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh 2.6 kg. RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in children with moderate to severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET.
RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before taking RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET.

Others

RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are bleeding excessively
Have a disease or condition in an organ of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding (Ex. stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, recent operation of the brain or eyes)
Had stroke (previously had a bleeding or a blood clot in your brain)
Had lacunar stroke (blockage of the small arteries providing blood to the brain’s deep tissues) or ischemic, nonlacunar stroke (blood clot in your brain) in the previous month

Before taking RICOSPRIN 2.5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have or had bleeding problems
Have antiphospholipid syndrome (immunity disorder that causes an increased risk of blood clots)
Have diseases of your stomach or bowel that might result in bleeding (Ex. inflammation of the bowels, stomach, or food pipe) or tumours in the stomach, bowels, genital tract, or urinary tract)
Have retinopathy (problem with the blood vessels in the back of your eyes)
Need to have an operation
Weigh less than 60 kg

introduction:
Introduction About PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE

PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE is a combination of Aspirin and Clopidogrel which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiplatelets. PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE is used in the management of early and long-term atherothrombotic events such as myocardial infarction (also known as heart attack), stroke (reduced blood supply to brain leading to brain death), cardiovascular death or refractory ischemia (chest pain due to inadequate blood supply to the heart) in patients having acute coronary syndrome with or without cardiac revascularization (including surgical or PCI, with or without stent insertion).

Acute coronary syndrome is a heart condition caused by plaque rupture or clot formation in the coronary arteries. Symptoms include heart attack, chest pressure or pain while at rest, shortness of breath and sweating.

Along management with PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during management with PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.

Do not stop taking PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE abruptly without consulting your doctor because premature discontinuation of this medicine may increase the risk of cardiovascular events. PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney or lung disease.

PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). Consult your doctor for an alternative therapy.

The most common side effects of taking PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE are diarrhea, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE Works

PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE reduces the risk of heart problems, where clopidogrel acts by irreversibly inhibiting platelet aggregation in the coronary arteries and aspirin acts by blocking an enzyme called cyclo-oxygenase 1 which is believed to be responsible for catalyzing the synthesis of platelets, thus leading to the management of fatal cardiac outcomes.

PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney disease and should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE.

PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease and it should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE.

PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having respiratory conditions such as asthma, nasal discharge (runny nose) or polyps (a type of growth in the nose). Consult your doctor before taking PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE.

Others

PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have coagulation disorders (Ex. hemophilia, thrombocytopenia)
Have bleeding in the brain (Ex. intracranial hemorrhage or cerebrovascular hemorrhage)
Have bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract
Have gout
Have menorrhagia (abnormally heavy or prolonged menstrual period)

Before taking PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE, inform your physician if you:

Have stomach ulcer or severe stomach pain
Had a recent serious injury
Are going to have any upcoming surgery (including dental procedures) or already had recently
Had a recent ischemic stroke (blot clot in the artery supplying the brain)
Have a history of asthma or other allergic diseases
Are alcoholic
Have G6PD deficiency (a genetic disorder causing destruction of red blood cells in response to certain stimuli)
Have active chickenpox or shingles infection

PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly). Consult your doctor before taking PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE.

Overdosage symptoms of PLAGERINE A 75MG CAPSULE might include increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, increased respiratory rate, hyperventilation, low blood sugar levels, low potassium and platelets levels in blood, increased body temperature, kidney failure, respiratory alkalosis, metabolic acidosis and pulmonary edema (non-cardiac related).

introduction:
Introduction About ABAXIS 2.5 TABLET

ABAXIS 2.5 TABLET contains Apixaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used in adults to manage blood clots from forming after hip or knee replacement operations and to manage blood clots (clusters of blood) in patients with an irregular heartbeat (atrial fibrillation). It also helps in the management of blood clots in the legs (deep vein thrombosis) and the veins of the lungs (pulmonary embolism) and the management of their recurrence in either the legs or lungs.

GBNKEYWORD] is not recommended in patients who have liver disease, active bleeding, or a disease that can lead to active bleeding, such as an active ulcer or a recent bleed in the brain. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before taking ABAXIS 2.5 TABLET. Patients who have kidney disease should use ABAXIS 2.5 TABLET with caution. ABAXIS 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for children and adolescents (under the age of 18). ABAXIS 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients over the age of 75.

The most common side effects of taking ABAXIS 2.5 TABLET are bleeding (eyes, nose, gums, urine, rectum, stomach, or bowel), bruising or swelling, anemia, low blood pressure, and a quickened heart rate. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor immediately.

name: ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 Capsule 15's
introduction:
Introduction About ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE

ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE is used in the management of acute coronary syndrome, myocardial infarction, angina and stroke. It is a combination of Aspirin, Clopidogrel and Rosuvastatin which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs, Antiplatelets and HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors respectively.   

Along with ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE management follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during the therapy, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract. It is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney, or heart disease.  

ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). The most common side effects are increased bleeding tendency, nausea, indigestion, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, muscle pain, dizziness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Acute coronary syndrome
Myocardial infarction
Angina
Stroke
usesDetails:
Uses Of ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE

It is used to manage:

Acute coronary syndrome
Myocardial infarction
Angina
Stroke
mechanismOfAction:
How ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE Works

ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE effectively improves cardiac function and reduces the risk of heart problems, where clopidogrel acts by inhibiting platelet aggregation in the coronary arteries, aspirin acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called cyclo-oxygenase which is believed to be responsible for catalyzing the synthesis of platelets and rosuvastatin acts by inhibiting the action of an enzyme called HMG-CoA reductase, which is required to catalyze the formation of cholesterol, thus managing clot or plaque formation in the coronary arteries leading to an uninterrupted supply of oxygen and blood to the heart.
usageInstructions: Take ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE as advised by your physician
Swallow the with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition
