Symptoms of pancreatitis (severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, fever, rapid heart rate)
Jaundice (yellowing of eyes, skin, and urine with fever)
Flu-like symptoms (fever, cough, sore throat, headache and extreme tiredness)
Hemorrhagic vasculitis (inflammation of the blood vessels with bleeding)
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE
Common side effects of ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE:
Indigestion, diarrhea, stomach pain, nausea, constipation
Dizziness, headache
Muscle cramps or pain
Tingling or numbness sensation

Stop taking ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe allergic reactions (skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, throat and neck, difficulty in breathing or swallowing)
Symptoms of pancreatitis (severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, fever, rapid heart rate)
Jaundice (yellowing of eyes, skin, and urine with fever)
Flu-like symptoms (fever, cough, sore throat, headache and extreme tiredness)
Hemorrhagic vasculitis (inflammation of the blood vessels with bleeding)

warnings.details: ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE is not recommended for use during pregnancy. Women of child-bearing potential should use suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while taking the medicine.
ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.
ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE does not affect your ability to drive or operate machines. However, if you experience dizziness during management with the medicine. Do not drive or operate any machines.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of stomach bleeding and aggravate your existing condition.
ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having moderate-to-severe kidney disease. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.

ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease and active liver disease (including persistent elevations of serum transaminases exceeding three times the upper limit). It should be used with caution in patients with history of liver disease.
Do not take ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE if you are allergic to Clopidogrel, Rosuvastatin, Aspirin or prostaglandin synthetase inhibitors (Ex. naproxen, ibuprofen, mefenamic acid, and indomethacin).
ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with interstitial lung disease or severe respiratory failure.
ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent ischemic stroke.
ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) unless prescribed by your physician due to increased risk of bleeding.

ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above) because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly).

Others

It is not recommended for use if you:

Have or had any repeated or unexplained muscle pains
Have family history of hereditary muscular disorders
Have family history of muscle problems following management with cholesterol-lowering medicines
Have an underactive thyroid gland
Have gastrointestinal problems (such as peptic ulcer, or bleeding in the gut)
Have bleeding disorders (Ex. bleeding in the brain, hemophilia, or others)
Have thrombocytopenia (decreased platelet count)
Have gout
Have lactose intolerance
Have diabetes
Have dehydration
Have menorrhagia (abnormally heavy bleeding during menstruation)

Before taking ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have:

Upcoming planned surgery (including dental surgery)

Kidney

Liver

USE WITH CAUTION

ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with interstitial lung disease or severe respiratory failure.

CONTRAINDICATED

ROSYCAP GOLD 10/75 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent ischemic stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About XARELTO 10MG TABLET

XARELTO 10MG TABLET contains Rivaroxaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antithrombotic agents. It is used to manage deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and venous thromboembolism (VTE). It is also used to reduce the risk of stroke, systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, recurrence of DVT or PE, major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), and major thrombotic vascular events in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD). Venous thromboembolism is a condition that occurs due to clot formation in the venous circulation. It can also be used for THE management of DVT in patients undergoing knee or hip replacement surgery, VTE in acutely ill medical patients, and thrombosis in children (older than 2 years) with congenital heart disease post the Fontan procedure.

Before taking XARELTO 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or bleeding problems or antiphospholipid syndrome. XARELTO 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. XARELTO 10MG TABLET is not studied and is not recommended in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh less than 2.6 kg. XARELTO 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking XARELTO 10MG TABLET are bleeding, pain and swelling in the limbs, fever, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, low blood pressure (feeling dizzy or fainting when standing up), weakness, tiredness, headache, dizziness, rash, and itchy skin. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How XARELTO 10MG TABLET Works

XARELTO 10MG TABLET works by competitively inhibiting factor Xa (a clotting factor) and managing the progression of the coagulation cascade through the final common pathway, thus managing thrombin generation.
usageDetails:
How to use XARELTO 10MG TABLET

Take XARELTO 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking XARELTO 10MG TABLET unless your doctor advise.

Others

XARELTO 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are bleeding excessively
Have a disease or condition in an organ of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding (Ex. stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, recent operation of the brain or eyes)
Had stroke (previously had a bleeding or a blood clot in your brain)
Had lacunar stroke (blockage of the small arteries providing blood to the brain’s deep tissues) or ischemic, nonlacunar stroke (blood clot in your brain) in the previous month

Before taking XARELTO 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have or had bleeding problems
Have antiphospholipid syndrome (immunity disorder that causes an increased risk of blood clots)
Have diseases of your stomach or bowel that might result in bleeding (Ex. inflammation of the bowels, stomach, or food pipe) or tumours in the stomach, bowels, genital tract, or urinary tract)
Have retinopathy (problem with the blood vessels in the back of your eyes)
Need to have an operation
Weigh less than 60 kg

name: Clopitab A 150mg Capsule 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About CLOPITAB A 150MG CAPSULE

CLOPITAB A 150MG CAPSULE is a combination of Aspirin and Clopidogrel which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiplatelets. CLOPITAB A 150MG CAPSULE is used in the management of early and long-term atherothrombotic events such as myocardial infarction (also known as heart attack), stroke (reduced blood supply to brain leading to brain death), cardiovascular death or refractory ischemia (chest pain due to inadequate blood supply to the heart) in patients having acute coronary syndrome with or without cardiac revascularization (including surgical or PCI, with or without stent insertion).

Acute coronary syndrome is a heart condition caused by plaque rupture or clot formation in the coronary arteries. Symptoms include heart attack, chest pressure or pain while at rest, shortness of breath and sweating.

Along management with CLOPITAB A 150MG CAPSULE follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during management with CLOPITAB A 150MG CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.

Do not stop taking CLOPITAB A 150MG CAPSULE abruptly without consulting your doctor because premature discontinuation of this medicine may increase the risk of cardiovascular events. CLOPITAB A 150MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney or lung disease.

CLOPITAB A 150MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). Consult your doctor for an alternative therapy.

The most common side effects of taking CLOPITAB A 150MG CAPSULE are diarrhea, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: To manage atherothrombotic events (such as myocardial infarction, stroke, cardiovascular death or refractory ischemia) in patients having acute coronary syndrome with or without cardiac revascularization (including surgical or PCI, with or without stent insertion)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CLOPITAB A 150MG CAPSULE
To manage atherothrombotic events (such as myocardial infarction, stroke, cardiovascular death or refractory ischemia) in patients having acute coronary syndrome with or without cardiac revascularization (including surgical or PCI, with or without stent insertion)
mechanismOfAction:
How CLOPITAB A 150MG CAPSULE Works

CLOPITAB A 150MG CAPSULE reduces the risk of heart problems, where clopidogrel acts by irreversibly inhibiting platelet aggregation in the coronary arteries and aspirin acts by blocking an enzyme called cyclo-oxygenase 1 which is believed to be responsible for catalyzing the synthesis of platelets, thus leading to the management of fatal cardiac outcomes.
usageDetails:

Take CLOPITAB A 150MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow CLOPITAB A 150MG CAPSULE with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Consult your doctor before taking CLOPITAB A 150MG CAPSULE.

introduction:
Introduction About APIXATOR 2.5 TABLET

APIXATOR 2.5 TABLET contains Apixaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used in adults to manage blood clots from forming after hip or knee replacement operations and to manage blood clots (clusters of blood) in patients with an irregular heartbeat (atrial fibrillation). It also helps in the management of blood clots in the legs (deep vein thrombosis) and the veins of the lungs (pulmonary embolism) and the management of their recurrence in either the legs or lungs.

GBNKEYWORD] is not recommended in patients who have liver disease, active bleeding, or a disease that can lead to active bleeding, such as an active ulcer or a recent bleed in the brain. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before taking APIXATOR 2.5 TABLET. Patients who have kidney disease should use APIXATOR 2.5 TABLET with caution. APIXATOR 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for children and adolescents (under the age of 18). APIXATOR 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients over the age of 75.

The most common side effects of taking APIXATOR 2.5 TABLET are bleeding (eyes, nose, gums, urine, rectum, stomach, or bowel), bruising or swelling, anemia, low blood pressure, and a quickened heart rate. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor immediately.

How APIXATOR 2.5 TABLET Works

APIXATOR 2.5 TABLET helps to manage the formation of blood clots by acting on the blood clotting mechanism of the body. It blocks clotting factor Xa which is an essential factor in the clotting mechanism.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: TICASPAN 90mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TICASPAN 90MG TABLET

TICASPAN 90MG TABLET contains ticagrelor which belongs to the group of medicines called antiplatelet agents. It is used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction. It also reduces the rate of stent thrombosis in patients who have been stented for management of ACS.

Ticagrelor stops clumping of blood cells called platelets, which is responsible for clot formation in diseased blood vessels of heart and brain and thus reduces the chances of a blood clot formation. It can be taken with or without food.

Avoid concomitant use of ticagrelor and other oral anticoagulants like heparin or warfarin, as it may increase the risk of side effects. Do not take this medicine if you are suffering from any bleeding disorders or liver problems. This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. The most common side effect of taking this medicine are bleeding and bruising.
uses: Used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction
usesDetails:
Uses Of TICASPAN 90MG TABLET
Used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction
mechanismOfAction:
How TICASPAN 90MG TABLET Works

Ticagrelor is a potent P2Y12 receptor antagonist. In diseased blood vessels, platelets can form thrombus (blood clot) by binding to the arterial surface. Activated platelets produces ADP3 which binds to P2Y12 receptor and propagates thrombus formation. Ticagrelor reversibly binds to P2Y12 receptor instead of ADP3 and prevents the signal transduction and platelet activation, that can lead to blood clot formation.

Take this medicine as directed by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your condition. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Continue to take this medicine, as long as your doctor tells you to do so, to obtain better results.

Introduction About ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE

ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE is used in the management of acute coronary syndrome, myocardial infarction, angina and stroke. It is a combination of Aspirin, Clopidogrel and Rosuvastatin which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs, Antiplatelets and HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors respectively.   

Along with ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE management follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during the therapy, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract. It is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney, or heart disease.  

ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). The most common side effects are increased bleeding tendency, nausea, indigestion, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, muscle pain, dizziness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE Works

ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE effectively improves cardiac function and reduces the risk of heart problems, where clopidogrel acts by inhibiting platelet aggregation in the coronary arteries, aspirin acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called cyclo-oxygenase which is believed to be responsible for catalyzing the synthesis of platelets and rosuvastatin acts by inhibiting the action of an enzyme called HMG-CoA reductase, which is required to catalyze the formation of cholesterol, thus managing clot or plaque formation in the coronary arteries leading to an uninterrupted supply of oxygen and blood to the heart.

Side Effects Of ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE
Common side effects of ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE:
Indigestion, diarrhea, stomach pain, nausea, constipation
Dizziness, headache
Muscle cramps or pain
Tingling or numbness sensation

Stop taking ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe allergic reactions (skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, throat and neck, difficulty in breathing or swallowing)
Symptoms of pancreatitis (severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, fever, rapid heart rate)
Jaundice (yellowing of eyes, skin, and urine with fever)
Flu-like symptoms (fever, cough, sore throat, headache and extreme tiredness)
Hemorrhagic vasculitis (inflammation of the blood vessels with bleeding)

warnings.details: ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use during pregnancy. Women of child-bearing potential should use suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while taking the medicine.
ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.
ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE does not affect your ability to drive or operate machines. However, if you experience dizziness during management with the medicine. Do not drive or operate any machines.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of stomach bleeding and aggravate your existing condition.
ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having moderate-to-severe kidney disease. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.

ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease and active liver disease (including persistent elevations of serum transaminases exceeding three times the upper limit). It should be used with caution in patients with history of liver disease.
Do not take ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE if you are allergic to Clopidogrel, Rosuvastatin, Aspirin or prostaglandin synthetase inhibitors (Ex. naproxen, ibuprofen, mefenamic acid, and indomethacin).
ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with interstitial lung disease or severe respiratory failure.
ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent ischemic stroke.
ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) unless prescribed by your physician due to increased risk of bleeding.

ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above) because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly).

Others

It is not recommended for use if you:

Have or had any repeated or unexplained muscle pains
Have family history of hereditary muscular disorders
Have family history of muscle problems following management with cholesterol-lowering medicines
Have an underactive thyroid gland
Have gastrointestinal problems (such as peptic ulcer, or bleeding in the gut)
Have bleeding disorders (Ex. bleeding in the brain, hemophilia, or others)
Have thrombocytopenia (decreased platelet count)
Have gout
Have lactose intolerance
Have diabetes
Have dehydration
Have menorrhagia (abnormally heavy bleeding during menstruation)

Before taking ACMEROSE GOLD 10 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have:

Upcoming planned surgery (including dental surgery)

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking the medicine, inform to your doctor, if you are taking any of these medicines:

Anticoagulants (Ex. warfarin, coumarin, heparin, phenindione)
Anti-lipidemic agents (Ex. clofibrate, gemfibrozil, fenofibrate, ezetimibe)

Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (Ex. fluoxetine, sertraline, paroxetine, or fluvoxamine)
Antacids (Ex. aluminium hydroxide, magnesium hydroxide)
Proton-pump inhibitors (Ex. omeprazole or esomeprazole)
Medicines used during percutaneous coronary intervention (Ex. abciximab, eptifibatide, and tirofiban)
Antibiotics (Ex. azithromycin, erythromycin, roxithromycin, and clarithromycin, fusidic acid)
Anticonvulsants (Ex. phenytoin, valproic acid)
Anti-diabetic agents (Ex. insulin, glipizide, glimepiride)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. ciclosporin or tacrolimus, methotrexate)
Nicotinic acid  
Antifungal agents (Ex. clotrimazole, fluconazole)
Cardiac glycosides (Ex. digoxin)
Anti-cancer agents (Ex. darolutamide, regorafenib)
Anti-gout agents (Ex. probenecid or sulfinpyrazone)

Acetazolamide

Overdosage symptoms might include increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, convulsions, vomiting, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, increased respiratory rate and hyperventilation.

introduction:
Introduction About MSN REBOPAG 50 TABLET

MSN REBOPAG 50 TABLET contains Eltrombopag which belongs to the group of medicines called Thrombopoietin-receptor agonist. MSN REBOPAG 50 TABLET is used to manage immune thrombocytopenia (platelet disorder) in patients aged 1-year/above when other medicines (such as corticosteroids/immunoglobulins) become ineffective to manage the disease.

MSN REBOPAG 50 TABLET is also used to manage thrombocytopenia (low platelet count) in adults suffering from hepatitis C (viral) infection. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage low blood counts in adults suffering from severe aplastic anemia (rare blood disorder that occurs due to failure of bone marrow to produce new blood cells).

MSN REBOPAG 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Eltrombopag.

Before taking MSN REBOPAG 50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are at a risk of developing blood clot in veins/arteries, and/or have cancer, obesity, advanced chronic liver disease, and/or kidney problems (such as renal impairment).

MSN REBOPAG 50 TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy unless it is clearly necessary. Women of childbearing potential should use effective contraceptive measures while in management with MSN REBOPAG 50 TABLET. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women since it is not known whether the medicine may pass through breastmilk.

MSN REBOPAG 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children (aged below 1-year) suffering from immune thrombocytopenia. It is also not recommended for use in children (aged below 18 years) suffering from low platelet counts due to hepatitis C/severe aplastic anemia. The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking MSN REBOPAG 50 TABLET are common cold, cough, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, and/or hair loss. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

How MSN REBOPAG 50 TABLET Works

MSN REBOPAG 50 TABLET works by binding and activating thrombopoietin receptor protein (molecules responsible for regulating platelet production) which helps in activating the pathways within the cells to increase production and development of bone marrow progenitor cells (membrane bound units responsible for producing all types of cell in bone marrow) which results in increased production of platelet cells in patients affected with immune thrombocytopenia bleeding disorder associated with/without hepatitis C or severe aplastic anemia.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking MSN REBOPAG 50 TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

A blood thinner
Antacids (used in indigestion, stomach ulcers/heartburn) Ex. aluminum hydroxide, magnesium carbonate
Statins (used to manage high cholesterol) Ex. atorvastatin, fluvastatin
Lopinavir, ritonavir (medicines used to manage HIV)
Ciclosporin (used to manage rejection of transplanted organ)
Vitamins and mineral supplements such as iron, calcium, aluminum, magnesium, selenium, and zinc
Methotrexate, topotecan (medicines used to manage cancer)
Corticosteroids (used to provide relief from inflammation) Ex. cortisone, hydrocortisone
Danazol (used to manage endometriosis)
Azathioprine (used for inflammatory conditions)

B. Drug-food interaction:

Avoid taking MSN REBOPAG 50 TABLET with dairy foods/drinks since calcium in dairy products may affect the absorption of the medicine and alter its effect.

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of MSN REBOPAG 50 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital to manage overdose symptoms.

name: FLOVAS 20 Tablet 14's
introduction:
Introduction About FLOVAS 20 TABLET

FLOVAS 20 TABLET contains Rivaroxaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antithrombotic agents. It is used to manage deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and venous thromboembolism (VTE). It is also used to reduce the risk of stroke, systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, recurrence of DVT or PE, major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), and major thrombotic vascular events in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD). Venous thromboembolism is a condition that occurs due to clot formation in the venous circulation. It can also be used for THE management of DVT in patients undergoing knee or hip replacement surgery, VTE in acutely ill medical patients, and thrombosis in children (older than 2 years) with congenital heart disease post the Fontan procedure.

Before taking FLOVAS 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or bleeding problems or antiphospholipid syndrome. FLOVAS 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. FLOVAS 20 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh less than 2.6 kg. FLOVAS 20 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking FLOVAS 20 TABLET are bleeding, pain and swelling in the limbs, fever, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, low blood pressure (feeling dizzy or fainting when standing up), weakness, tiredness, headache, dizziness, rash, and itchy skin. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About CLOPITAB 150MG TABLET

CLOPITAB 150MG TABLET contains Clopidogrel which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiplatelets. CLOPITAB 150MG TABLET is used to manage blood clots (thrombi) due to atherothrombosis which may lead to atherothrombotic events such as stroke or heart attack and atherosclerotic events (myocardial infraction) in patients with atherosclerosis. It is also used to manage in-stent restenosis in patients undergo percutaneous coronary Intervention (PCI).

Platelets are very small structures in the blood which clump together during blood clotting. By managing this clumping, antiplatelet medicinal products reduce the chances of blood clots forming (a process called thrombosis).

Atherothrombosis is an inflammatory process of the arteries that affects the coronary (heart), cerebral (brain) and peripheral circulation (blood circulation to arms, hands, legs and feet) by aberrant thickening of the blood vessel wall and reducing the blood flow to the tissue that triggers the occurrence of myocardial infarction, stroke and peripheral arterial disease.

Along with this management, your doctor may advise regular blood tests to check your blood clotting time.

Avoid taking CLOPITAB 150MG TABLET, if you are allergic to Clopidogrel or have a medical condition that is currently causing bleeding such as a stomach ulcer or bleeding within the brain, severe liver disease.

Before taking CLOPITAB 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are at a risk of internal bleeding, have or ever had a clot in artery of your brain (ischemic stroke) which might have occurred within the last seven days or have heart or kidney problems.

CLOPITAB 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking CLOPITAB 150MG TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking CLOPITAB 150MG TABLET are bleeding, diarrhea, abdominal pain, indigestion and heartburn. Consult your doctor if any of these above symptoms gets worse.

Manage atherosclerotic events (myocardial infraction)
Prevent in-stent restenosis in patients undergo percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI)

name: CLOPITORVA 40 Capsule 10's
introduction:
Introduction About CLOPITORVA 40 CAPSULE

CLOPITORVA 40 CAPSULE is used to reduce elevated cholesterol and triglyceride levels in patients when a low-fat diet and lifestyle changes alone have failed. It is a combination of Atorvastatin and Clopidogrel which belongs to the group of medicines called HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors and Antiplatelet medicines respectively. It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart problems such as myocardial infarction, angina (chest pain), heart failure including stroke or revascularization procedures in adult patients with or without a clinically evident chronic heart disease.

Along with management with CLOPITORVA 40 CAPSULE, patient should follow an appropriate lipid-lowering diet as advised by their doctor to enhance recovery. Before using the medicine, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney disease. Patients with active liver disease should discontinue the use of CLOPITORVA 40 CAPSULE as it may cause serious side effects in them.

It is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in patients with bleeding disorders. It is not suitable for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Avoid consumption of grapefruit juice or alcohol while taking CLOPITORVA 40 CAPSULE as it may lead to unwanted interactions. The most common side effects are muscle pain, joint pain, diarrhoea, nausea, headache or stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About CLOPIKIND 75MG TABLET

CLOPIKIND 75MG TABLET is a prescription medication containing Clopidogrel, primarily used as a blood thinner (antiplatelet) to reduce blood clots. It helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.

This medication can be taken with or without food and should be taken at the same time every day. It is crucial to continue taking it, even if you feel fine. Stopping the medication could increase your risk of having a heart attack or stroke.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, bleeding, bruising, stomach upset. Bleeding in the form of bruising, nose bleeds, blood in urine or stools (black-colored stools), or heavier periods than usual in women. If you cut or injure yourself, the bleeding may take longer than usual to stop. Typically, these bleeding episodes are mild and will resolve on their own. However, it is important to see a doctor immediately if the bleeding continues or if you are concerned.

This medication is not suitable for everyone. Avoid taking it if you are experiencing bleeding from any part of your body, such as a stomach ulcer or internal bleeding in the brain. Prior to using this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of blood clotting issues or if you have recently undergone a major injury or surgery. You may need to temporarily stop taking this medicine before any planned surgeries or dental procedures.
uses: By reducing blood clot formation, it helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.

mechanismOfAction:
How CLOPIKIND 75MG TABLET Works

CLOPIKIND 75MG TABLET contains clopidogrel, an antiplatelet medication that works by inhibiting platelet aggregation. It does so by blocking the ADP (adenosine diphosphate) receptor on platelets, which is necessary for platelets to clump together and form blood clots. By preventing this process, CLOPIKIND 75MG TABLET reduces the risk of blood clots, thereby lowering the chances of stroke, heart attack, or other cardiovascular events in individuals with conditions like atherosclerosis, or those who have undergone procedures like stent placement.

Clopidogrel vs Aspirin

	

Clopidogrel is often preferred for long-term antiplatelet therapy in patients with a high risk of bleeding or GI issues.

	

Aspirin is more commonly used for prevention in lower-risk patients due to its cost-effectiveness and availability.

Why CLOPIKIND 75MG TABLET Might Be Preferred in Certain Cases:
Gastrointestinal Safety: CLOPIKIND 75MG TABLETtends to cause less gastrointestinal irritation compared to Ecosprin, making it a better choice for individuals with a history of gastric ulcers, gastritis, or other GI concerns.
Bleeding Risk Management: CLOPIKIND 75MG TABLEThas a more targeted mechanism of action (via the P2Y12 receptor), and its bleeding risk is often more manageable compared to aspirin's broader impact on COX enzymes, which can also increase the risk of gastrointestinal bleeding.
Asthma or Respiratory Concerns: CLOPIKIND 75MG TABLETis preferred in patients with asthma, as aspirin can exacerbate respiratory symptoms in individuals with asthma or other allergic conditions.
Long-Term Therapy: For patients needing long-term antiplatelet therapy, CLOPIKIND 75MG TABLET might be preferred over aspirin due to its more specific action on platelets, leading to a lower risk of side effects like gastrointestinal bleeding.

introduction:
Introduction About STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE

STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE is a combination medicine used in the management of heart attack. It is commonly prescribed for patients with percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) and myocardial infarction to reduce the risks of further heart attacks.

Take STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE with food, ideally at the same time every day, to maintain consistency and enhance its effectiveness. Follow your doctor's prescribed dosage and schedule, and do not discontinue use without medical advice, even if you feel better. Lifestyle modifications, such as following a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can significantly boost the effectiveness of this medication.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.    

Before starting STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney disease. If you are pregnant, planning to conceive, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before use. Additionally, disclose all other medications you are taking to avoid potential drug interactions.

The most common side effects of taking STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE are abdominal pain, indigestion, bruising, and nosebleeds. Since this medication increases the risk of bleeding, take extra precautions while shaving, trimming nails, or handling sharp objects. Seek immediate medical attention if you notice symptoms like muscle pain or weakness, yellowing of the skin, or dark urine. Avoid consuming alcohol while on this medication, as it may amplify side effects.

mechanismOfAction:
How STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE Works

STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE contains a combination of three medicines, namely aspirin, atorvastatin, and clopidogrel which works synergistically to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events like heart attacks and strokes by targeting different aspects of blood clotting and cholesterol management:

Aspirin and Clopidogrel are antiplatelet medicines that prevents platelets from sticking together, further reducing the risk of clot formation and enhancing blood flow in the arteries. By reducing platelet clumping, this medicine helps maintain smooth blood flow and prevents clots in blood vessels.

Atorvastatin is a statin that inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, the enzyme involved in cholesterol synthesis in the liver. It lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while increasing HDL (good cholesterol), which reduces plaque buildup in arteries (atherosclerosis) and improves blood vessel health.

Together, this medicine offers comprehensive cardiovascular protection by reducing clot formation, improving lipid profiles, and reducing  the risk for narrowing of blood vessels, significantly lowering the risk of heart attacks and strokes.
usageDetails:
How to use STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE

STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE should be taken exactly as prescribed by your doctor for optimal results.

It is best to take this medicine with food to avoid stomach discomfort.

Take it at the same time every day to ensure consistent blood levels and maximum effectiveness.

Swallow the medicine whole with water; do not crush or chew it.

Follow your doctor’s recommended dosage schedule, and do not skip doses or stop the medication without consulting your healthcare provider.

For best results, combine this medication with a healthy lifestyle, including a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking. Always consult your doctor if you have any questions about its use.

Missed dosage instructions for STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose of STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double up on doses to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects. To avoid missing doses in the future, try taking the medication at the same time every day and consider setting reminders. If you are unsure about what to do, consult your doctor or pharmacist for advice.

Overdosage instructions for STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE includes increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting (sometimes with blood), increased body temperature, low blood sugar levels, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, kidney failure, increased respiratory rate and hyperventilation.

STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE does not impair your ability to drive or operate any machines. Consult your doctor before taking STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of stomach bleeding and aggravate your existing condition. Consult your doctor before taking STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE.

STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney disease and should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver impairment and active liver disease (including persistent elevations of serum transaminases exceeding three times the upper limit) and should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not take STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE if you are allergic to Clopidogrel, Atorvastatin, Aspirin or Prostaglandin synthetase inhibitors (Ex. naproxen, ibuprofen, mefenamic acid and indomethacin).

STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with interstitial lung disease or other respiratory problems such as hay fever, asthma or chronic respiratory diseases due to increased risk of bronchospasm and asthma attacks. Consult your doctor before taking STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE.

STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent ischemic stroke and should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above) because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly). Consult your doctor before taking STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE.

Others

STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have active or recurrent peptic ulcer with or without gastrointestinal bleeding
Have bleeding disorders (Ex. bleeding in the brain, hemophilia or others)
Have thrombocytopenia (decreased platelet count)
Have gout
Have menorrhagia (abnormally heavy bleeding during menstruation)

Before taking STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Have an underactive thyroid gland
Have family history of hereditary muscular disorders
Have family history of muscle problems following management with cholesterol-lowering medicines
Upcoming planned surgery (including dental surgery)
Dehydration problem
Diabetes
Are alcoholic

Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women due to potential risks of side effects to the growing baby. Animal studies have indicated that the use of Atorvastatin causes feotal growth abnormalities. Aspirin is generally advised not to take at later stages of pregnancy as it may increase post-partum bleeding. Although, there are no well controlled human studies, the potential risk to the growing fetus cannot be excluded. Therefore, do not take STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE without talking to your doctor if you are pregnant.
Women of child-bearing potential should use suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while taking STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE.
If you become pregnant while on therapy with this medicine, stop taking it and consult your doctor immediately.

CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

It is not known whether Aspirin, Atorvastatin or clopidogrel pass through breast milk or not. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking STORVA GOLD 10 CAPSULE if you are breastfeeding.

introduction:
Introduction About XARELTO 20MG TABLET

XARELTO 20MG TABLET contains Rivaroxaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antithrombotic agents. It is used to manage deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and venous thromboembolism (VTE). It is also used to reduce the risk of stroke, systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, recurrence of DVT or PE, major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), and major thrombotic vascular events in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD). Venous thromboembolism is a condition that occurs due to clot formation in the venous circulation. It can also be used for THE management of DVT in patients undergoing knee or hip replacement surgery, VTE in acutely ill medical patients, and thrombosis in children (older than 2 years) with congenital heart disease post the Fontan procedure.

Before taking XARELTO 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or bleeding problems or antiphospholipid syndrome. XARELTO 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. XARELTO 20MG TABLET is not studied and is not recommended in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh less than 2.6 kg. XARELTO 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking XARELTO 20MG TABLET are bleeding, pain and swelling in the limbs, fever, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, low blood pressure (feeling dizzy or fainting when standing up), weakness, tiredness, headache, dizziness, rash, and itchy skin. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

How XARELTO 20MG TABLET Works

XARELTO 20MG TABLET works by competitively inhibiting factor Xa (a clotting factor) and managing the progression of the coagulation cascade through the final common pathway, thus managing thrombin generation.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking XARELTO 20MG TABLET unless your doctor advise.

introduction:
Introduction About ATORMAC GOLD CAPSULE

ATORMAC GOLD CAPSULE is a combination medicine used in the management of heart attack. It is commonly prescribed for patients with percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) and myocardial infarction to reduce the risks of further heart attacks.

Take ATORMAC GOLD CAPSULE with food, ideally at the same time every day, to maintain consistency and enhance its effectiveness. Follow your doctor's prescribed dosage and schedule, and do not discontinue use without medical advice, even if you feel better. Lifestyle modifications, such as following a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can significantly boost the effectiveness of this medication.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking ATORMAC GOLD CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.    

Before starting ATORMAC GOLD CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney disease. If you are pregnant, planning to conceive, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before use. Additionally, disclose all other medications you are taking to avoid potential drug interactions.

The most common side effects of taking ATORMAC GOLD CAPSULE are abdominal pain, indigestion, bruising, and nosebleeds. Since this medication increases the risk of bleeding, take extra precautions while shaving, trimming nails, or handling sharp objects. Seek immediate medical attention if you notice symptoms like muscle pain or weakness, yellowing of the skin, or dark urine. Avoid consuming alcohol while on this medication, as it may amplify side effects.

mechanismOfAction:
How ATORMAC GOLD CAPSULE Works

ATORMAC GOLD CAPSULE contains a combination of three medicines, namely aspirin, atorvastatin, and clopidogrel which works synergistically to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events like heart attacks and strokes by targeting different aspects of blood clotting and cholesterol management:

Aspirin and Clopidogrel are antiplatelet medicines that prevents platelets from sticking together, further reducing the risk of clot formation and enhancing blood flow in the arteries. By reducing platelet clumping, this medicine helps maintain smooth blood flow and prevents clots in blood vessels.

Atorvastatin is a statin that inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, the enzyme involved in cholesterol synthesis in the liver. It lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while increasing HDL (good cholesterol), which reduces plaque buildup in arteries (atherosclerosis) and improves blood vessel health.

Together, this medicine offers comprehensive cardiovascular protection by reducing clot formation, improving lipid profiles, and reducing  the risk for narrowing of blood vessels, significantly lowering the risk of heart attacks and strokes.
usageDetails:
How to use ATORMAC GOLD CAPSULE

ATORMAC GOLD CAPSULE should be taken exactly as prescribed by your doctor for optimal results.

It is best to take this medicine with food to avoid stomach discomfort.

Take it at the same time every day to ensure consistent blood levels and maximum effectiveness.

Swallow the medicine whole with water; do not crush or chew it.

Follow your doctor’s recommended dosage schedule, and do not skip doses or stop the medication without consulting your healthcare provider.

For best results, combine this medication with a healthy lifestyle, including a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking. Always consult your doctor if you have any questions about its use.

Missed dosage instructions for ATORMAC GOLD CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose of ATORMAC GOLD CAPSULE, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double up on doses to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects. To avoid missing doses in the future, try taking the medication at the same time every day and consider setting reminders. If you are unsure about what to do, consult your doctor or pharmacist for advice.

Overdosage instructions for ATORMAC GOLD CAPSULE:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of ATORMAC GOLD CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of ATORMAC GOLD CAPSULE includes increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting (sometimes with blood), increased body temperature, low blood sugar levels, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, kidney failure, increased respiratory rate and hyperventilation.

Increased bleeding or bruising
Bleeding from the nose
Indigestion, diarrhea, stomach pain, nausea, constipation
High blood glucose
Dizziness and headache
Muscle cramps or pain
Joint pain, back pain, swelling of joints
Tingling or prickling sensation in hands or feet
Weight gain
Changes in taste

Severe allergic reactions (such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, throat and neck, difficulty in breathing or swallowing)

Abnormal heavy or prolonged menstrual periods

introduction:
Introduction About CLOPINOL 75 TABLET

CLOPINOL 75 TABLET is a prescription medication containing Clopidogrel, primarily used as a blood thinner (antiplatelet) to reduce blood clots. It helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.

This medication can be taken with or without food and should be taken at the same time every day. It is crucial to continue taking it, even if you feel fine. Stopping the medication could increase your risk of having a heart attack or stroke.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, bleeding, bruising, stomach upset. Bleeding in the form of bruising, nose bleeds, blood in urine or stools (black-colored stools), or heavier periods than usual in women. If you cut or injure yourself, the bleeding may take longer than usual to stop. Typically, these bleeding episodes are mild and will resolve on their own. However, it is important to see a doctor immediately if the bleeding continues or if you are concerned.

This medication is not suitable for everyone. Avoid taking it if you are experiencing bleeding from any part of your body, such as a stomach ulcer or internal bleeding in the brain. Prior to using this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of blood clotting issues or if you have recently undergone a major injury or surgery. You may need to temporarily stop taking this medicine before any planned surgeries or dental procedures.

mechanismOfAction:
How CLOPINOL 75 TABLET Works

CLOPINOL 75 TABLET contains clopidogrel, an antiplatelet medication that works by inhibiting platelet aggregation. It does so by blocking the ADP (adenosine diphosphate) receptor on platelets, which is necessary for platelets to clump together and form blood clots. By preventing this process, CLOPINOL 75 TABLET reduces the risk of blood clots, thereby lowering the chances of stroke, heart attack, or other cardiovascular events in individuals with conditions like atherosclerosis, or those who have undergone procedures like stent placement.

Clopidogrel vs Aspirin

RAZEL GOLD 10MG CAPSULE effectively improves cardiac function and reduces the risk of heart problems, where clopidogrel acts by inhibiting platelet aggregation in the coronary arteries, aspirin acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called cyclo-oxygenase which is believed to be responsible for catalyzing the synthesis of platelets and rosuvastatin acts by inhibiting the action of an enzyme called HMG-CoA reductase, which is required to catalyze the formation of cholesterol, thus managing clot or plaque formation in the coronary arteries leading to an uninterrupted supply of oxygen and blood to the heart.

Swallow the with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition

Side Effects Of RAZEL GOLD 10MG CAPSULE
Common side effects of RAZEL GOLD 10MG CAPSULE:
Indigestion, diarrhea, stomach pain, nausea, constipation
Dizziness, headache
Muscle cramps or pain
Tingling or numbness sensation

Stop taking RAZEL GOLD 10MG CAPSULE and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe allergic reactions (skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, throat and neck, difficulty in breathing or swallowing)
Symptoms of pancreatitis (severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, fever, rapid heart rate)
Jaundice (yellowing of eyes, skin, and urine with fever)
Flu-like symptoms (fever, cough, sore throat, headache and extreme tiredness)
Hemorrhagic vasculitis (inflammation of the blood vessels with bleeding)

warnings.details: RAZEL GOLD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use during pregnancy. Women of child-bearing potential should use suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while taking the medicine.
RAZEL GOLD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.
RAZEL GOLD 10MG CAPSULE does not affect your ability to drive or operate machines. However, if you experience dizziness during management with the medicine. Do not drive or operate any machines.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking RAZEL GOLD 10MG CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of stomach bleeding and aggravate your existing condition.
RAZEL GOLD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having moderate-to-severe kidney disease. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.

RAZEL GOLD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease and active liver disease (including persistent elevations of serum transaminases exceeding three times the upper limit). It should be used with caution in patients with history of liver disease.
Do not take RAZEL GOLD 10MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Clopidogrel, Rosuvastatin, Aspirin or prostaglandin synthetase inhibitors (Ex. naproxen, ibuprofen, mefenamic acid, and indomethacin).
RAZEL GOLD 10MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with interstitial lung disease or severe respiratory failure.
RAZEL GOLD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent ischemic stroke.
RAZEL GOLD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) unless prescribed by your physician due to increased risk of bleeding.

RAZEL GOLD 10MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above) because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly).

Others

It is not recommended for use if you:

Have or had any repeated or unexplained muscle pains
Have family history of hereditary muscular disorders
Have family history of muscle problems following management with cholesterol-lowering medicines
Have an underactive thyroid gland
Have gastrointestinal problems (such as peptic ulcer, or bleeding in the gut)
Have bleeding disorders (Ex. bleeding in the brain, hemophilia, or others)
Have thrombocytopenia (decreased platelet count)
Have gout
Have lactose intolerance
Have diabetes
Have dehydration
Have menorrhagia (abnormally heavy bleeding during menstruation)

Before taking RAZEL GOLD 10MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have:

Upcoming planned surgery (including dental surgery)

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking the medicine, inform to your doctor, if you are taking any of these medicines:

Anticoagulants (Ex. warfarin, coumarin, heparin, phenindione)
Anti-lipidemic agents (Ex. clofibrate, gemfibrozil, fenofibrate, ezetimibe)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (Ex. ibuprofen, paracetamol)
Anti-viral agents (Ex. ritonavir with lopinavir and/or atazanavir or sofosbuvir with velpatasvir and voxilaprevir)
Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (Ex. fluoxetine, sertraline, paroxetine, or fluvoxamine)
Antacids (Ex. aluminium hydroxide, magnesium hydroxide)
Proton-pump inhibitors (Ex. omeprazole or esomeprazole)
Medicines used during percutaneous coronary intervention (Ex. abciximab, eptifibatide, and tirofiban)
Antibiotics (Ex. azithromycin, erythromycin, roxithromycin, and clarithromycin, fusidic acid)
Anticonvulsants (Ex. phenytoin, valproic acid)
Anti-diabetic agents (Ex. insulin, glipizide, glimepiride)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. ciclosporin or tacrolimus, methotrexate)
Nicotinic acid  
Antifungal agents (Ex. clotrimazole, fluconazole)
Cardiac glycosides (Ex. digoxin)
Anti-cancer agents (Ex. darolutamide, regorafenib)
Anti-gout agents (Ex. probenecid or sulfinpyrazone)
Antiplatelet agents (Ex. dipyridamole)
Anti-maniac agents (Ex. lithium)
Corticosteroids (Ex. prednisolone, dexamethasone)
Acetazolamide  
Contraceptive (Ex. mifepristone)
Anti-emetic agents (Ex. metoclopramide)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else take too much of RAZEL GOLD 10MG CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms might include increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, convulsions, vomiting, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, increased respiratory rate and hyperventilation.

introduction:
Introduction About CLAVIX AS 150MG TABLET

CLAVIX AS 150MG TABLET is a combination of Aspirin and Clopidogrel which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiplatelets. CLAVIX AS 150MG TABLET is used in the management of early and long-term atherothrombotic events such as myocardial infarction (also known as heart attack), stroke (reduced blood supply to brain leading to brain death), cardiovascular death or refractory ischemia (chest pain due to inadequate blood supply to the heart) in patients having acute coronary syndrome with or without cardiac revascularization (including surgical or PCI, with or without stent insertion).

Acute coronary syndrome is a heart condition caused by plaque rupture or clot formation in the coronary arteries. Symptoms include heart attack, chest pressure or pain while at rest, shortness of breath and sweating.

Along management with CLAVIX AS 150MG TABLET follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during management with CLAVIX AS 150MG TABLET, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.

Do not stop taking CLAVIX AS 150MG TABLET abruptly without consulting your doctor because premature discontinuation of this medicine may increase the risk of cardiovascular events. CLAVIX AS 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney or lung disease.

CLAVIX AS 150MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). Consult your doctor for an alternative therapy.

The most common side effects of taking CLAVIX AS 150MG TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

Had a recent serious injury
Are going to have any upcoming surgery (including dental procedures) or already had recently
Had a recent ischemic stroke (blot clot in the artery supplying the brain)
Have a history of asthma or other allergic diseases
Are alcoholic
Have G6PD deficiency (a genetic disorder causing destruction of red blood cells in response to certain stimuli)
Have active chickenpox or shingles infection

CLAVIX AS 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor for advice.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking CLAVIX AS 150MG TABLET inform to your doctor, if you are taking any of these medicines:

Other anticoagulant medicines used to manage blood clots (Ex. warfarin, heparin, coumarin) or dipyridamole
Medicines used to manage stomach ulcers such as antacids (Ex. aluminium hydroxide, magnesium hydroxide) and proton-pump inhibitors (Ex. omeprazole or esomeprazole)
Other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (Ex. ibuprofen, paracetamol)
Glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitors (used during percutaneous coronary intervention) Ex. abciximab, eptifibatide and tirofiban
Medicines used to manage heart problems or hypertension (Ex. captopril, enalapril, lisinopril)
Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (used to manage depression) Ex. fluoxetine, sertraline, paroxetine etc
Methotrexate (used to manage cancer and other auto immune diseases)
Diuretics (used to increase urine output) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide
Acetazolamide (used to manage or manage altitude sickness)
Digoxin (used to manage abnormal heart rate)
Lithium (used to manage metal illness)
Corticosteroids (used to manage pain and inflammation) Ex. prednisolone, dexamethasone
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. phenytoin, valproic acid)
Ciclosporin or tacrolimus (used to manage graft rejection or manage auto-immune disease)
Ticlopidine (an antiplatelet medicine used to manage heart problems)
Medicines used to manage gout (such as probenecid, sulfinpyrazone or benzbromarone)
Fluconazole or voriconazole (used to manage fungal infection)
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (Ex. efavirenz or tenofovir)
Varicella vaccine (used to manage chickenpox or shingles)
Moclobemide (a medicine used to manage depression)
Medicines used to control blood glucose level (Ex. glipizide, gliclazide, glimepiride, repaglinide)
Paclitaxel (used to manage certain forms of cancer)
Nicorandil (used to manage chest pain)
Mifepristone (abortion pill)
Metoclopramide (used to manage vomiting)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else take too much of CLAVIX AS 150MG TABLET, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of CLAVIX AS 150MG TABLET might include increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, increased respiratory rate, hyperventilation, low blood sugar levels, low potassium and platelets levels in blood, increased body temperature, kidney failure, respiratory alkalosis, metabolic acidosis and pulmonary edema (non-cardiac related).

Introduction About LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE

LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE is a combination medicine used in the management of heart attack. It is commonly prescribed for patients with percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) and myocardial infarction to reduce the risks of further heart attacks.

Take LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE with food, ideally at the same time every day, to maintain consistency and enhance its effectiveness. Follow your doctor's prescribed dosage and schedule, and do not discontinue use without medical advice, even if you feel better. Lifestyle modifications, such as following a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can significantly boost the effectiveness of this medication.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.    

Before starting LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney disease. If you are pregnant, planning to conceive, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before use. Additionally, disclose all other medications you are taking to avoid potential drug interactions.

The most common side effects of taking LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE are abdominal pain, indigestion, bruising, and nosebleeds. Since this medication increases the risk of bleeding, take extra precautions while shaving, trimming nails, or handling sharp objects. Seek immediate medical attention if you notice symptoms like muscle pain or weakness, yellowing of the skin, or dark urine. Avoid consuming alcohol while on this medication, as it may amplify side effects.

mechanismOfAction:
How LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE Works

LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE contains a combination of three medicines, namely aspirin, atorvastatin, and clopidogrel which works synergistically to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events like heart attacks and strokes by targeting different aspects of blood clotting and cholesterol management:

Aspirin and Clopidogrel are antiplatelet medicines that prevents platelets from sticking together, further reducing the risk of clot formation and enhancing blood flow in the arteries. By reducing platelet clumping, this medicine helps maintain smooth blood flow and prevents clots in blood vessels.

Atorvastatin is a statin that inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, the enzyme involved in cholesterol synthesis in the liver. It lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while increasing HDL (good cholesterol), which reduces plaque buildup in arteries (atherosclerosis) and improves blood vessel health.

Together, this medicine offers comprehensive cardiovascular protection by reducing clot formation, improving lipid profiles, and reducing  the risk for narrowing of blood vessels, significantly lowering the risk of heart attacks and strokes.
usageDetails:
How to use LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE

LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE should be taken exactly as prescribed by your doctor for optimal results.

It is best to take this medicine with food to avoid stomach discomfort.

Take it at the same time every day to ensure consistent blood levels and maximum effectiveness.

Swallow the medicine whole with water; do not crush or chew it.

Follow your doctor’s recommended dosage schedule, and do not skip doses or stop the medication without consulting your healthcare provider.

For best results, combine this medication with a healthy lifestyle, including a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking. Always consult your doctor if you have any questions about its use.

Missed dosage instructions for LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose of LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double up on doses to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects. To avoid missing doses in the future, try taking the medication at the same time every day and consider setting reminders. If you are unsure about what to do, consult your doctor or pharmacist for advice.

Overdosage instructions for LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE includes increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting (sometimes with blood), increased body temperature, low blood sugar levels, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, kidney failure, increased respiratory rate and hyperventilation.

LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver impairment and active liver disease (including persistent elevations of serum transaminases exceeding three times the upper limit) and should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment. Do not take LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE if you are allergic to Clopidogrel, Atorvastatin, Aspirin or Prostaglandin synthetase inhibitors (Ex. naproxen, ibuprofen, mefenamic acid and indomethacin).

LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with interstitial lung disease or other respiratory problems such as hay fever, asthma or chronic respiratory diseases due to increased risk of bronchospasm and asthma attacks. Consult your doctor before taking LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE.

LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent ischemic stroke and should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above) because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly). Consult your doctor before taking LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE.

Others

LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have active or recurrent peptic ulcer with or without gastrointestinal bleeding
Have bleeding disorders (Ex. bleeding in the brain, hemophilia or others)
Have thrombocytopenia (decreased platelet count)
Have gout
Have menorrhagia (abnormally heavy bleeding during menstruation)

Before taking LIPITAB GOLD 20 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Have an underactive thyroid gland
Have family history of hereditary muscular disorders
Have family history of muscle problems following management with cholesterol-lowering medicines
Upcoming planned surgery (including dental surgery)
Dehydration problem
Diabetes
Are alcoholic

mechanismOfAction:
How ATORNIZ A CAPSULE Works

ATORNIZ A CAPSULE contains two active ingredients namely, Atorvastatin and Aspirin. Aspirin at the dose of 75mg contains blood thinning properties. It causes blood thinning which helps the heart to pump blood easily across the body in less pressure and also reduces the chance for platelets accumulation within the blood vessels which leads to atherosclerosis or other blood vessel complications.

Atorvastatin is a lipid lowering medicine which reduces bad cholesterol levels in the body. It works by inhibiting cholesterol production within the body. Together, they help in lowering blood cholesterol levels, reduces the risk of heart attack or stroke and other heart complications.

How ATORNIZ A CAPSULE Aids in Post-Heart Surgery Recovery?
ATORNIZ A CAPSULE works by reducing the risk of further blood clot formation by thinning the blood, which is essential in the recovery process after heart surgery.
It improves blood circulation and reduces the risk of complications like heart attacks or strokes.
Doctors often prescribe it as part of a post-surgery care plan to enhance recovery and reduce the risk of future cardiovascular events.
How ATORNIZ A CAPSULE Supports Overall Heart Health?
ATORNIZ A CAPSULE supports heart health by reducing the risk of formation of harmful blood clots, which can lead to heart attacks or strokes.
The aspirin in the capsule helps reduce inflammation, while the atorvastatin lowers cholesterol levels, promoting better cardiovascular health and reducing the risk of heart disease.
How ATORNIZ A CAPSULE Helps in Heart Attack Risk Reduction?

ATORNIZ A CAPSULE helps in preventing heart attacks by reducing the likelihood of blood clot formation, which can block arteries and disrupt blood flow to the heart. The capsule's combination of aspirin and atorvastatin helps lower cholesterol levels, further protecting against heart attack risks.

ATORNIZ A CAPSULE and Risk of bleeding:

Aspirin, the active ingredient in ATORNIZ A CAPSULE, works by inhibiting the function of platelets, which are responsible for blood clotting. While this is beneficial for reducing the risk for blood clot formation that may lead to heart attacks or strokes, it also increases the risk of excessive bleeding, especially in the gastrointestinal tract or during injuries.

Precautions to Reduce the Risk of Bleeding while taking ATORNIZ A CAPSULE:

Take with Food: Always take ATORNIZ A CAPSULE after meals to minimize stomach irritation and reduce the risk of gastrointestinal bleeding.
Monitor for Symptoms of Bleeding: Be vigilant for any signs of unusual bruising, prolonged bleeding from cuts, blood in the stool, or black tarry stools, and report them to your doctor immediately.
Avoid Combining with Other Blood Thinners: Do not take ATORNIZ A CAPSULE with other anticoagulants (e.g., warfarin) or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) unless directed by your doctor, as this can further increase bleeding risk.
Limit Alcohol Consumption: Alcohol can enhance the effects of aspirin and increase the likelihood of stomach bleeding, so it’s best to limit or avoid alcohol during treatment.
When to Seek Medical Help?

If you notice any symptoms of excessive bleeding, such as easy bruising, nosebleeds, or prolonged bleeding after minor injuries, contact your healthcare provider immediately. In severe cases, emergency care may be needed.

Serious side effects, though rare, include signs of allergic reactions (like swelling of the face, lips, or throat), severe stomach bleeding, or liver issues. Always follow the prescribed dosage and consult your doctor if you have concerns about side effects.

Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED

There are no well controlled studies regarding the use of aspirin+atorvastatin combination medicines during pregnancy. Available clinical information for aspirin suggests that aspirin may cause growth abnormalities (premature closure of ductus arteriosus in the fetus) or prolonged labour in mothers.

Available research articles on atorvastatin during pregnancy suggests that it inhibits cholesterol production in the body which is required for normal fetal growth and development.

Therefore, the use of ATORNIZ A CAPSULE (aspirin+atorvastatin) is not safe for use in pregnant women especially during the last trimester. If you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant inform your doctor immediately, if you are prescribed to takeATORNIZ A CAPSULE.

introduction:
Introduction About ROZAGOLD 10MG CAPSULE

ROZAGOLD 10MG CAPSULE is used in the management of acute coronary syndrome, myocardial infarction, angina and stroke. It is a combination of Aspirin, Clopidogrel and Rosuvastatin which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs, Antiplatelets and HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors respectively.   

Along with ROZAGOLD 10MG CAPSULE management follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during the therapy, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract. It is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney, or heart disease.  

ROZAGOLD 10MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). The most common side effects are increased bleeding tendency, nausea, indigestion, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, muscle pain, dizziness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ROZAGOLD 10MG CAPSULE Works

ROZAGOLD 10MG CAPSULE effectively improves cardiac function and reduces the risk of heart problems, where clopidogrel acts by inhibiting platelet aggregation in the coronary arteries, aspirin acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called cyclo-oxygenase which is believed to be responsible for catalyzing the synthesis of platelets and rosuvastatin acts by inhibiting the action of an enzyme called HMG-CoA reductase, which is required to catalyze the formation of cholesterol, thus managing clot or plaque formation in the coronary arteries leading to an uninterrupted supply of oxygen and blood to the heart.

warnings.details: ROZAGOLD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use during pregnancy. Women of child-bearing potential should use suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while taking the medicine.
ROZAGOLD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.
ROZAGOLD 10MG CAPSULE does not affect your ability to drive or operate machines. However, if you experience dizziness during management with the medicine. Do not drive or operate any machines.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ROZAGOLD 10MG CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of stomach bleeding and aggravate your existing condition.
ROZAGOLD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having moderate-to-severe kidney disease. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.

ROZAGOLD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease and active liver disease (including persistent elevations of serum transaminases exceeding three times the upper limit). It should be used with caution in patients with history of liver disease.
Do not take ROZAGOLD 10MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Clopidogrel, Rosuvastatin, Aspirin or prostaglandin synthetase inhibitors (Ex. naproxen, ibuprofen, mefenamic acid, and indomethacin).
ROZAGOLD 10MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with interstitial lung disease or severe respiratory failure.
ROZAGOLD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent ischemic stroke.
ROZAGOLD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) unless prescribed by your physician due to increased risk of bleeding.

ROZAGOLD 10MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above) because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly).

Others

It is not recommended for use if you:

Have or had any repeated or unexplained muscle pains
Have family history of hereditary muscular disorders
Have family history of muscle problems following management with cholesterol-lowering medicines
Have an underactive thyroid gland
Have gastrointestinal problems (such as peptic ulcer, or bleeding in the gut)
Have bleeding disorders (Ex. bleeding in the brain, hemophilia, or others)
Have thrombocytopenia (decreased platelet count)
Have gout
Have lactose intolerance
Have diabetes
Have dehydration
Have menorrhagia (abnormally heavy bleeding during menstruation)

Before taking ROZAGOLD 10MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have:

Upcoming planned surgery (including dental surgery)
