introduction:
Introduction About FLOVAS 10 TABLET

FLOVAS 10 TABLET contains Rivaroxaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antithrombotic agents. It is used to manage deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and venous thromboembolism (VTE). It is also used to reduce the risk of stroke, systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, recurrence of DVT or PE, major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), and major thrombotic vascular events in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD). Venous thromboembolism is a condition that occurs due to clot formation in the venous circulation. It can also be used for THE management of DVT in patients undergoing knee or hip replacement surgery, VTE in acutely ill medical patients, and thrombosis in children (older than 2 years) with congenital heart disease post the Fontan procedure.

Before taking FLOVAS 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or bleeding problems or antiphospholipid syndrome. FLOVAS 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. FLOVAS 10 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh less than 2.6 kg. FLOVAS 10 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking FLOVAS 10 TABLET are bleeding, pain and swelling in the limbs, fever, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, low blood pressure (feeling dizzy or fainting when standing up), weakness, tiredness, headache, dizziness, rash, and itchy skin. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

Need to have an operation

introduction:
Introduction About ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE

ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE is a combination medicine used in the management of heart attack. It is commonly prescribed for patients with percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) and myocardial infarction to reduce the risks of further heart attacks.

Take ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE with food, ideally at the same time every day, to maintain consistency and enhance its effectiveness. Follow your doctor's prescribed dosage and schedule, and do not discontinue use without medical advice, even if you feel better. Lifestyle modifications, such as following a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can significantly boost the effectiveness of this medication.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.    

Before starting ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney disease. If you are pregnant, planning to conceive, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before use. Additionally, disclose all other medications you are taking to avoid potential drug interactions.

The most common side effects of taking ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE are abdominal pain, indigestion, bruising, and nosebleeds. Since this medication increases the risk of bleeding, take extra precautions while shaving, trimming nails, or handling sharp objects. Seek immediate medical attention if you notice symptoms like muscle pain or weakness, yellowing of the skin, or dark urine. Avoid consuming alcohol while on this medication, as it may amplify side effects.
uses: Heart Attack
ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE is a powerful medication designed to lower the risk of heart attacks by combining antiplatelet and cholesterol-lowering agents.
It prevents blood clots by stopping platelets from sticking together, ensuring smooth blood flow and reducing the risk of blockages in arteries.
Additionally, it lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while boosting HDL (good cholesterol), promoting better cardiovascular health.

By reducing the chances for atherosclerosis (hardening of arteries) and reducing the recurrence of heart attacks, this medication offers comprehensive heart protection. When combined with a healthy lifestyle, such as a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE significantly enhances heart health.

mechanismOfAction:
How ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE Works

ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE contains a combination of three medicines, namely aspirin, atorvastatin, and clopidogrel which works synergistically to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events like heart attacks and strokes by targeting different aspects of blood clotting and cholesterol management:

Aspirin and Clopidogrel are antiplatelet medicines that prevents platelets from sticking together, further reducing the risk of clot formation and enhancing blood flow in the arteries. By reducing platelet clumping, this medicine helps maintain smooth blood flow and prevents clots in blood vessels.

Atorvastatin is a statin that inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, the enzyme involved in cholesterol synthesis in the liver. It lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while increasing HDL (good cholesterol), which reduces plaque buildup in arteries (atherosclerosis) and improves blood vessel health.

Together, this medicine offers comprehensive cardiovascular protection by reducing clot formation, improving lipid profiles, and reducing  the risk for narrowing of blood vessels, significantly lowering the risk of heart attacks and strokes.
usageDetails:
How to use ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE

ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE should be taken exactly as prescribed by your doctor for optimal results.

It is best to take this medicine with food to avoid stomach discomfort.

Take it at the same time every day to ensure consistent blood levels and maximum effectiveness.

Swallow the medicine whole with water; do not crush or chew it.

Follow your doctor’s recommended dosage schedule, and do not skip doses or stop the medication without consulting your healthcare provider.

For best results, combine this medication with a healthy lifestyle, including a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking. Always consult your doctor if you have any questions about its use.

Missed dosage instructions for ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose of ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double up on doses to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects. To avoid missing doses in the future, try taking the medication at the same time every day and consider setting reminders. If you are unsure about what to do, consult your doctor or pharmacist for advice.

Overdosage instructions for ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE includes increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting (sometimes with blood), increased body temperature, low blood sugar levels, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, kidney failure, increased respiratory rate and hyperventilation.

Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women due to potential risks of side effects to the growing baby. Animal studies have indicated that the use of Atorvastatin causes feotal growth abnormalities. Aspirin is generally advised not to take at later stages of pregnancy as it may increase post-partum bleeding. Although, there are no well controlled human studies, the potential risk to the growing fetus cannot be excluded. Therefore, do not take ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE without talking to your doctor if you are pregnant.
Women of child-bearing potential should use suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while taking ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE.
If you become pregnant while on therapy with this medicine, stop taking it and consult your doctor immediately.
Breastfeeding
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

It is not known whether Aspirin, Atorvastatin or clopidogrel pass through breast milk or not. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE if you are breastfeeding.

Driving and Using Machines
SAFE

ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE does not impair your ability to drive or operate any machines. Consult your doctor before taking ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE.

Alcohol
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of stomach bleeding and aggravate your existing condition. Consult your doctor before taking ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE.

Kidney
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney disease and should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

Liver
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver impairment and active liver disease (including persistent elevations of serum transaminases exceeding three times the upper limit) and should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

Allergy
CONTRAINDICATED

Do not take ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Clopidogrel, Atorvastatin, Aspirin or Prostaglandin synthetase inhibitors (Ex. naproxen, ibuprofen, mefenamic acid and indomethacin).

Lungs
USE WITH CAUTION

ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with interstitial lung disease or other respiratory problems such as hay fever, asthma or chronic respiratory diseases due to increased risk of bronchospasm and asthma attacks. Consult your doctor before taking ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE.

Heart Disease
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent ischemic stroke and should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

CONTRAINDICATED

ATORMAC GOLD 20MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

introduction:
Introduction About DABLEXA 150MG CAPSULE

DABLEXA 150MG CAPSULE contains Dabigatran etexilate which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used to manage stroke, systemic embolism and reduction of vascular mortality in adult patients with atrial fibrillation and venous thromboembolic events in patients who have undergone orthopaedic surgery.

It is also used to manage acute deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and/or pulmonary embolism (PE) and manages recurrent deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and /or pulmonary embolism (PE). This medicine is also used in children to manage blood clots and to manage blood clots from reoccurring.

Avoid taking DABLEXA 150MG CAPSULE, if you currently have bleeding disorders, organ disease of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding such as stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, severely reduced kidney or liver function.

Before taking DABLEXA 150MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have increased bleeding risks such as s bone fracture, head injury or any injury requiring surgical management, lung or heart problems.

DABLEXA 150MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking DABLEXA 150MG CAPSULE.

Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your child’s age body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before taking DABLEXA 150MG CAPSULE.

The most common side effects of taking DABLEXA 150MG CAPSULE are stomachache, indigestion, frequent loose or liquid bowel movements and or nausea. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.

How DABLEXA 150MG CAPSULE Works

DABLEXA 150MG CAPSULE works by blocking thrombin (blood central clotting agent) that results in the management of blood clots thereby managing the occurrence of stroke, heart attack, deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism.

Take DABLEXA 150MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow DABLEXA 150MG CAPSULE with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Others

DABLEXA 150MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have bleeding problems

Before taking DABLEXA 150MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Have increased bleeding risk such as surgical tissue removal (biopsy), serious injury (bone fracture, head injury or any injury requiring surgical management), inflammation of the gullet or stomach, reflux of gastric juice into the gullet
Have symptoms of dehydration such as feeling thirsty and passing reduced amounts of dark-coloured (concentrated) or foaming urine

Use in pediatrics:

DABLEXA 150MG CAPSULE is recommended for use in children and adolescents (from 8 to 18 years of age) to manage and reduce the risk of recurrence of blood clot disorder. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before taking DABLEXA 150MG CAPSULE.

Use in geriatrics:

DABLEXA 150MG CAPSULE is used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years or above). Consult your doctor before taking DABLEXA 150MG CAPSULE.

name: Prasita A Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About PRASITA A CAPSULE

PRASITA A CAPSULE is a combination of Aspirin and Prasugrel which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiplatelet agents. It is used to reduce the risk of blood clot formation in the body.

It is typically used among patients who have undergone percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI, a non-surgical procedure used to open clogged blood vessels supplying the heart) or stent implantation in the heart.

It also manages the recurrence of heart attack, stroke, angina, atherosclerosis and other circulatory problems caused due to blood clots among patients with heart problems and/or problems in blood circulation.

Before taking PRASITA A CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, hay fever, high blood pressure, dehydration, heavy menstrual periods or if you are scheduled for any surgery (including minor dental surgeries) in the upcoming days as a precaution.

PRASITA A CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with ulcers or bleeding from the stomach or intestines. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless recommended by a physician.

PRASITA A CAPSULE may also make you bleed more easily even after minor cuts or injuries, and so be cautious while you perform even minor activities that involve the risk of cuts or injuries (like shaving, playing, or handling sharp objects). The most common side effects of taking PRASITA A CAPSULE are increased bleeding tendency, anaemia, stomach problems and indigestion. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

How PRASITA A CAPSULE Works

PRASITA A CAPSULE is an antiplatelet medication. It manages the clumping of platelets (a type of blood cell that causes blood clots) within the blood vessels. This reduces the risk of clot or plaque formation within the blood vessels and improves blood flow to all parts of the body.

Take PRASITA A CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It can be taken with or without meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking PRASITA A CAPSULE without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About CLOPINOX A 150/75MG CAPSULE

CLOPINOX A 150/75MG CAPSULE is a combination of Aspirin and Clopidogrel which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiplatelets. CLOPINOX A 150/75MG CAPSULE is used in the management of early and long-term atherothrombotic events such as myocardial infarction (also known as heart attack), stroke (reduced blood supply to brain leading to brain death), cardiovascular death or refractory ischemia (chest pain due to inadequate blood supply to the heart) in patients having acute coronary syndrome with or without cardiac revascularization (including surgical or PCI, with or without stent insertion).

Acute coronary syndrome is a heart condition caused by plaque rupture or clot formation in the coronary arteries. Symptoms include heart attack, chest pressure or pain while at rest, shortness of breath and sweating.

Along management with CLOPINOX A 150/75MG CAPSULE follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during management with CLOPINOX A 150/75MG CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.

Do not stop taking CLOPINOX A 150/75MG CAPSULE abruptly without consulting your doctor because premature discontinuation of this medicine may increase the risk of cardiovascular events. CLOPINOX A 150/75MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney or lung disease.

CLOPINOX A 150/75MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). Consult your doctor for an alternative therapy.

The most common side effects of taking CLOPINOX A 150/75MG CAPSULE are diarrhea, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How CLOPINOX A 150/75MG CAPSULE Works

CLOPINOX A 150/75MG CAPSULE reduces the risk of heart problems, where clopidogrel acts by irreversibly inhibiting platelet aggregation in the coronary arteries and aspirin acts by blocking an enzyme called cyclo-oxygenase 1 which is believed to be responsible for catalyzing the synthesis of platelets, thus leading to the management of fatal cardiac outcomes.
usageDetails:
How to use CLOPINOX A 150/75MG CAPSULE

Take CLOPINOX A 150/75MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow CLOPINOX A 150/75MG CAPSULE with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: RIVAFLO 2.5 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET

RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET contains Rivaroxaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antithrombotic agents. It is used to manage deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and venous thromboembolism (VTE). It is also used to reduce the risk of stroke, systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, recurrence of DVT or PE, major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), and major thrombotic vascular events in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD). Venous thromboembolism is a condition that occurs due to clot formation in the venous circulation. It can also be used for THE management of DVT in patients undergoing knee or hip replacement surgery, VTE in acutely ill medical patients, and thrombosis in children (older than 2 years) with congenital heart disease post the Fontan procedure.

Before taking RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or bleeding problems or antiphospholipid syndrome. RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh less than 2.6 kg. RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET are bleeding, pain and swelling in the limbs, fever, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, low blood pressure (feeling dizzy or fainting when standing up), weakness, tiredness, headache, dizziness, rash, and itchy skin. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

How RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET Works

Do not take RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET if you are allergic to Rivaroxaban or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with lung disease where the bronchi are widened and filled with pus, or those with previous bleeding from the lung. Consult your doctor before taking RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET.

RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with acute coronary syndrome, coronary artery disease, or peripheral artery disease. RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with very high or unstable blood pressure which is not controlled by medicines, prosthetic heart valve, or coronary artery disease with severe symptomatic heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET.

RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended for use in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh 2.6 kg. RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in children with moderate to severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET.
RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before taking RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET.

Others

RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are bleeding excessively
Have a disease or condition in an organ of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding (Ex. stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, recent operation of the brain or eyes)
Had stroke (previously had a bleeding or a blood clot in your brain)
Had lacunar stroke (blockage of the small arteries providing blood to the brain’s deep tissues) or ischemic, nonlacunar stroke (blood clot in your brain) in the previous month

Before taking RIVAFLO 2.5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have or had bleeding problems
Have antiphospholipid syndrome (immunity disorder that causes an increased risk of blood clots)
Have diseases of your stomach or bowel that might result in bleeding (Ex. inflammation of the bowels, stomach, or food pipe) or tumours in the stomach, bowels, genital tract, or urinary tract)
Have retinopathy (problem with the blood vessels in the back of your eyes)
Need to have an operation
Weigh less than 60 kg

introduction:
Introduction About DEPLATT A 150MG TABLET

DEPLATT A 150MG TABLET is a combination of Aspirin and Clopidogrel which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiplatelets. DEPLATT A 150MG TABLET is used in the management of early and long-term atherothrombotic events such as myocardial infarction (also known as heart attack), stroke (reduced blood supply to brain leading to brain death), cardiovascular death or refractory ischemia (chest pain due to inadequate blood supply to the heart) in patients having acute coronary syndrome with or without cardiac revascularization (including surgical or PCI, with or without stent insertion).

Acute coronary syndrome is a heart condition caused by plaque rupture or clot formation in the coronary arteries. Symptoms include heart attack, chest pressure or pain while at rest, shortness of breath and sweating.

Along management with DEPLATT A 150MG TABLET follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during management with DEPLATT A 150MG TABLET, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.

Do not stop taking DEPLATT A 150MG TABLET abruptly without consulting your doctor because premature discontinuation of this medicine may increase the risk of cardiovascular events. DEPLATT A 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney or lung disease.

DEPLATT A 150MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). Consult your doctor for an alternative therapy.

The most common side effects of taking DEPLATT A 150MG TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

How DEPLATT A 150MG TABLET Works

DEPLATT A 150MG TABLET reduces the risk of heart problems, where clopidogrel acts by irreversibly inhibiting platelet aggregation in the coronary arteries and aspirin acts by blocking an enzyme called cyclo-oxygenase 1 which is believed to be responsible for catalyzing the synthesis of platelets, thus leading to the management of fatal cardiac outcomes.

DEPLATT A 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney disease and should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking DEPLATT A 150MG TABLET.

Others

DEPLATT A 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have coagulation disorders (Ex. hemophilia, thrombocytopenia)
Have bleeding in the brain (Ex. intracranial hemorrhage or cerebrovascular hemorrhage)
Have bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract
Have gout
Have menorrhagia (abnormally heavy or prolonged menstrual period)

Before taking DEPLATT A 150MG TABLET, inform your physician if you:

Have stomach ulcer or severe stomach pain
Had a recent serious injury
Are going to have any upcoming surgery (including dental procedures) or already had recently
Had a recent ischemic stroke (blot clot in the artery supplying the brain)
Have a history of asthma or other allergic diseases
Are alcoholic
Have G6PD deficiency (a genetic disorder causing destruction of red blood cells in response to certain stimuli)
Have active chickenpox or shingles infection

DEPLATT A 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor for advice.

DEPLATT A 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly). Consult your doctor before taking DEPLATT A 150MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About VASOHART GOLD 10 CAPSULE

VASOHART GOLD 10 CAPSULE is used in the management of acute coronary syndrome, myocardial infarction, angina and stroke. It is a combination of Aspirin, Clopidogrel and Rosuvastatin which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs, Antiplatelets and HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors respectively.   

Along with VASOHART GOLD 10 CAPSULE management follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during the therapy, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract. It is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney, or heart disease.  

VASOHART GOLD 10 CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). The most common side effects are increased bleeding tendency, nausea, indigestion, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, muscle pain, dizziness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How VASOHART GOLD 10 CAPSULE Works

VASOHART GOLD 10 CAPSULE effectively improves cardiac function and reduces the risk of heart problems, where clopidogrel acts by inhibiting platelet aggregation in the coronary arteries, aspirin acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called cyclo-oxygenase which is believed to be responsible for catalyzing the synthesis of platelets and rosuvastatin acts by inhibiting the action of an enzyme called HMG-CoA reductase, which is required to catalyze the formation of cholesterol, thus managing clot or plaque formation in the coronary arteries leading to an uninterrupted supply of oxygen and blood to the heart.

VASOHART GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease and active liver disease (including persistent elevations of serum transaminases exceeding three times the upper limit). It should be used with caution in patients with history of liver disease.

VASOHART GOLD 10 CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above) because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly).

Have gastrointestinal problems (such as peptic ulcer, or bleeding in the gut)
Have bleeding disorders (Ex. bleeding in the brain, hemophilia, or others)
Have thrombocytopenia (decreased platelet count)
Have gout
Have lactose intolerance
Have diabetes
Have dehydration
Have menorrhagia (abnormally heavy bleeding during menstruation)

Upcoming planned surgery (including dental surgery)

introduction:
Introduction About CLOFRE 75MG TABLET

CLOFRE 75MG TABLET is a prescription medication containing Clopidogrel, primarily used as a blood thinner (antiplatelet) to reduce blood clots. It helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.

This medication can be taken with or without food and should be taken at the same time every day. It is crucial to continue taking it, even if you feel fine. Stopping the medication could increase your risk of having a heart attack or stroke.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, bleeding, bruising, stomach upset. Bleeding in the form of bruising, nose bleeds, blood in urine or stools (black-colored stools), or heavier periods than usual in women. If you cut or injure yourself, the bleeding may take longer than usual to stop. Typically, these bleeding episodes are mild and will resolve on their own. However, it is important to see a doctor immediately if the bleeding continues or if you are concerned.

This medication is not suitable for everyone. Avoid taking it if you are experiencing bleeding from any part of your body, such as a stomach ulcer or internal bleeding in the brain. Prior to using this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of blood clotting issues or if you have recently undergone a major injury or surgery. You may need to temporarily stop taking this medicine before any planned surgeries or dental procedures.

mechanismOfAction:
How CLOFRE 75MG TABLET Works

CLOFRE 75MG TABLET contains clopidogrel, an antiplatelet medication that works by inhibiting platelet aggregation. It does so by blocking the ADP (adenosine diphosphate) receptor on platelets, which is necessary for platelets to clump together and form blood clots. By preventing this process, CLOFRE 75MG TABLET reduces the risk of blood clots, thereby lowering the chances of stroke, heart attack, or other cardiovascular events in individuals with conditions like atherosclerosis, or those who have undergone procedures like stent placement.

More Information
01. Product Comparison
a) CLOFRE 75MG TABLET Vs Ecosprin

Aspect

	

CLOFRE 75MG TABLET(Clopidogrel)

	

Ecosprin (Aspirin)




Drug Class

	

Antiplatelet (P2Y12 receptor inhibitor)

	

Antiplatelet (COX inhibitor)




Mechanism of Action

	

Inhibits ADP binding to P2Y12 receptors on platelets, preventing activation and aggregation.

	

Inhibits cyclooxygenase (COX-1 and COX-2), reducing thromboxane A2, which prevents platelet aggregation.




Primary Use

	

Prevents blood clots in conditions like atherosclerosis, heart attack, stroke, and peripheral artery disease.

	

Prevents blood clots in cardiovascular conditions, such as heart attack, stroke, and in the prevention of clot formation in people with cardiovascular disease.




Indications

	

- Acute coronary syndrome (ACS)

	

- Primary and secondary prevention of heart attack and stroke


 	

- Stroke prevention

	

- Angina, myocardial infarction (MI) prevention


 	

- Myocardial infarction (MI) prevention

	

- Prevention of thrombotic events in high-risk patients




Onset of Action

	

2-4 hours

	

30 minutes to 1 hour




Duration of Action

	

24-48 hours (after a single dose)

	

4-6 hours




Side Effects

	

- Bleeding risk

	

- Gastrointestinal irritation (e.g., ulcers, bleeding)


 	

- Gastrointestinal issues (less common than aspirin)

	

- Allergic reactions, asthma exacerbation


 	

- Rarely, thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (TTP)

	

- Gastrointestinal bleeding (rare but serious)




Contraindications

	

- Active bleeding

	

- Active gastrointestinal bleeding


 	

- Severe liver impairment

	

- Asthma (in some cases), history of GI ulcers


 	

- Hypersensitivity to clopidogrel

	

- Hypersensitivity to aspirin




Risk of Bleeding

	

Higher bleeding risk (due to inhibition of platelet aggregation)

	

Higher risk of gastrointestinal bleeding, less platelet effect compared to Clopidogrel




Usage in Patients with GI Conditions

	

Preferred for patients with a history of GI issues (less GI irritation than aspirin)

	

May not be ideal for patients with active gastrointestinal ulcers or issues




Use in Patients with Asthma

	

Preferred (lower risk of asthma exacerbation)

	

Not preferred for patients with asthma (can exacerbate symptoms)




Clopidogrel vs Aspirin

	

Clopidogrel is often preferred for long-term antiplatelet therapy in patients with a high risk of bleeding or GI issues.

	

Aspirin is more commonly used for prevention in lower-risk patients due to its cost-effectiveness and availability.




Co-Administration with Other Medications

	

Often co-administered with aspirin in dual antiplatelet therapy, especially post-stent placement.

	

Can be taken alone or with other cardiovascular medications.

 

Why CLOFRE 75MG TABLET Might Be Preferred in Certain Cases:
Gastrointestinal Safety: CLOFRE 75MG TABLETtends to cause less gastrointestinal irritation compared to Ecosprin, making it a better choice for individuals with a history of gastric ulcers, gastritis, or other GI concerns.
Bleeding Risk Management: CLOFRE 75MG TABLEThas a more targeted mechanism of action (via the P2Y12 receptor), and its bleeding risk is often more manageable compared to aspirin's broader impact on COX enzymes, which can also increase the risk of gastrointestinal bleeding.
Asthma or Respiratory Concerns: CLOFRE 75MG TABLETis preferred in patients with asthma, as aspirin can exacerbate respiratory symptoms in individuals with asthma or other allergic conditions.
Long-Term Therapy: For patients needing long-term antiplatelet therapy, CLOFRE 75MG TABLET might be preferred over aspirin due to its more specific action on platelets, leading to a lower risk of side effects like gastrointestinal bleeding.
b) CLOFRE 75MG TABLETVs Coumadin

Feature

	

CLOFRE 75MG TABLET(Clopidogrel)

	

Coumadin (Warfarin)




Drug Class

	

Antiplatelet (thienopyridine)

	

Anticoagulant (Vitamin K antagonist)




Mechanism of Action

	

Inhibits platelet aggregation by blocking ADP receptor

	

Inhibits synthesis of clotting factors (II, VII, IX, X) by interfering with Vitamin K




Primary Use

	

Prevents thrombosis (in patients with cardiovascular diseases like atherosclerosis, stents, etc.)

	

Prevents blood clot formation (for atrial fibrillation, deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, etc.)




Indications

	

- Acute coronary syndrome (ACS)

	

- Atrial fibrillation


 	

- Post-stent placement

	

- Deep vein thrombosis (DVT)


 	

- Stroke prevention (in patients with atherosclerosis)

introduction:
Introduction About ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET

ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET is a combination of Aspirin and Clopidogrel which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiplatelets. ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET is used in the management of early and long-term atherothrombotic events such as myocardial infarction (also known as heart attack), stroke (reduced blood supply to brain leading to brain death), cardiovascular death or refractory ischemia (chest pain due to inadequate blood supply to the heart) in patients having acute coronary syndrome with or without cardiac revascularization (including surgical or PCI, with or without stent insertion).

Acute coronary syndrome is a heart condition caused by plaque rupture or clot formation in the coronary arteries. Symptoms include heart attack, chest pressure or pain while at rest, shortness of breath and sweating.

Along management with ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during management with ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.

Do not stop taking ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET abruptly without consulting your doctor because premature discontinuation of this medicine may increase the risk of cardiovascular events. ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney or lung disease.

ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). Consult your doctor for an alternative therapy.

The most common side effects of taking ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

How ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET Works

ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET reduces the risk of heart problems, where clopidogrel acts by irreversibly inhibiting platelet aggregation in the coronary arteries and aspirin acts by blocking an enzyme called cyclo-oxygenase 1 which is believed to be responsible for catalyzing the synthesis of platelets, thus leading to the management of fatal cardiac outcomes.

ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having respiratory conditions such as asthma, nasal discharge (runny nose) or polyps (a type of growth in the nose). Consult your doctor before taking ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET.

Others

ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have coagulation disorders (Ex. hemophilia, thrombocytopenia)
Have bleeding in the brain (Ex. intracranial hemorrhage or cerebrovascular hemorrhage)
Have bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract
Have gout
Have menorrhagia (abnormally heavy or prolonged menstrual period)

Before taking ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET, inform your physician if you:

Have stomach ulcer or severe stomach pain
Had a recent serious injury
Are going to have any upcoming surgery (including dental procedures) or already had recently
Had a recent ischemic stroke (blot clot in the artery supplying the brain)
Have a history of asthma or other allergic diseases
Are alcoholic
Have G6PD deficiency (a genetic disorder causing destruction of red blood cells in response to certain stimuli)
Have active chickenpox or shingles infection

Use in pediatrics:

ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly). Consult your doctor before taking ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET inform to your doctor, if you are taking any of these medicines:

Other anticoagulant medicines used to manage blood clots (Ex. warfarin, heparin, coumarin) or dipyridamole
Medicines used to manage stomach ulcers such as antacids (Ex. aluminium hydroxide, magnesium hydroxide) and proton-pump inhibitors (Ex. omeprazole or esomeprazole)
Other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (Ex. ibuprofen, paracetamol)
Glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitors (used during percutaneous coronary intervention) Ex. abciximab, eptifibatide and tirofiban
Medicines used to manage heart problems or hypertension (Ex. captopril, enalapril, lisinopril)
Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (used to manage depression) Ex. fluoxetine, sertraline, paroxetine etc
Methotrexate (used to manage cancer and other auto immune diseases)
Diuretics (used to increase urine output) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide
Acetazolamide (used to manage or manage altitude sickness)
Digoxin (used to manage abnormal heart rate)
Lithium (used to manage metal illness)
Corticosteroids (used to manage pain and inflammation) Ex. prednisolone, dexamethasone
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. phenytoin, valproic acid)
Ciclosporin or tacrolimus (used to manage graft rejection or manage auto-immune disease)
Ticlopidine (an antiplatelet medicine used to manage heart problems)
Medicines used to manage gout (such as probenecid, sulfinpyrazone or benzbromarone)
Fluconazole or voriconazole (used to manage fungal infection)
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (Ex. efavirenz or tenofovir)
Varicella vaccine (used to manage chickenpox or shingles)
Moclobemide (a medicine used to manage depression)

Mifepristone (abortion pill)
Metoclopramide (used to manage vomiting)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else take too much of ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of ANZIOLET A 75MG TABLET might include increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, increased respiratory rate, hyperventilation, low blood sugar levels, low potassium and platelets levels in blood, increased body temperature, kidney failure, respiratory alkalosis, metabolic acidosis and pulmonary edema (non-cardiac related).

Introduction About PRADAXA 110MG CAPSULE

PRADAXA 110MG CAPSULE contains Dabigatran etexilate which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used to manage stroke, systemic embolism and reduction of vascular mortality in adult patients with atrial fibrillation and venous thromboembolic events in patients who have undergone orthopaedic surgery.

It is also used to manage acute deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and/or pulmonary embolism (PE) and manages recurrent deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and /or pulmonary embolism (PE). This medicine is also used in children to manage blood clots and to manage blood clots from reoccurring.

Avoid taking PRADAXA 110MG CAPSULE, if you currently have bleeding disorders, organ disease of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding such as stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, severely reduced kidney or liver function.

Before taking PRADAXA 110MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have increased bleeding risks such as s bone fracture, head injury or any injury requiring surgical management, lung or heart problems.

PRADAXA 110MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking PRADAXA 110MG CAPSULE.

Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your child’s age body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before taking PRADAXA 110MG CAPSULE.

The most common side effects of taking PRADAXA 110MG CAPSULE are stomachache, indigestion, frequent loose or liquid bowel movements and or nausea. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.

Introduction About ROSCAD CV 20 CAPSULE

ROSCAD CV 20 CAPSULE is a combination medicine used to lower bad cholesterol (LDL) and triglyceride levels and reduce the risk of heart-related complications like heart attack, angina (chest pain), and stroke. It also limits the formation of harmful blood clots within the blood vessels which reduce the risk of atherosclerosis and other blood vessel problems.

ROSCAD CV 20 CAPSULE can be taken with or without food, as directed by your doctor. For best results, take it consistently at the same time each day to maintain stable levels in your body. Follow the dosage and therapy duration as prescribed by your doctor, even if you start feeling better before completing the course. Incorporating lifestyle changes, such as a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can enhance the effectiveness of this medication.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, bleeding disorders, or if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. Additionally, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, as they may interact with this treatment.

While taking this medicine, avoid alcohol consumption as it may increase liver-related side effects.

ROSCAD CV 20 CAPSULE generally increases your tendency to bleed, and so if you cut or injure yourself, it may take a little longer for the bleeding to stop. Bleeding for minor injuries like small cuts or shaving is of no concern. 

However, if you experience excessive bleeding for a prolonged period, contact your doctor. The most common side effects of taking ROSCAD CV 20 CAPSULE are headache, dizziness, nausea, stomach pain, muscle pain or increased bleeding tendency. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

If you notice symptoms such as yellowing of the skin, muscle pain, or dark-colored urine, consult your doctor immediately. Regular liver function tests may also be recommended during treatment.

mechanismOfAction:
How ROSCAD CV 20 CAPSULE Works

ROSCAD CV 20 CAPSULE combines two active ingredients, Rosuvastatin and Clopidogrel, which work together to improve heart health and reduces the risk of blood clot formation. Rosuvastatin lowers "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and triglycerides while increasing "good" cholesterol (HDL), helping reduce cholesterol accumulation in the arteries. Clopidogrel is an antiplatelet agent that stops platelets from clumping together, minimizing the risk of blood clots. Together, they improve blood flow, reduce blockages, and lower the risk of heart attack and stroke.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug interactions:

1. Warfarin:

Combining ROSCAD CV 20 CAPSULE and warfarin (a blood thinner) can increase the risk of bleeding. The Clopidogrel present in the medicine reduces blood clot formation, while warfarin also interferes with clotting factors. Together, they may enhance each other's effects, leading to an increased risk of bruising, bleeding, and hemorrhage. Close monitoring of INR (International Normalized Ratio) levels is recommended for patients taking both warfarin and these drugs?

2. Cyclosporine:

Cyclosporine, an immunosuppressant used primarily in organ transplant patients, can significantly increase the blood levels of rosuvastatin. As a result, the risk of rosuvastatin-related side effects, such as muscle pain or myopathy, is heightened. Caution is advised when combining these medications, and dose adjustments may be necessary?

3. Antibiotics

Certain antibiotics, such as erythromycin and clarithromycin, can interfere with the metabolism of rosuvastatin, leading to higher blood levels of the statin. This can increase the risk of statin-associated muscle toxicity. Additionally, antibiotics like penicillin and cephalosporins may alter the effectiveness of clopidogrel by inhibiting its metabolism?.

4. Antifungals

Antifungal medications like ketoconazole and itraconazole can also raise rosuvastatin levels by inhibiting the liver enzymes involved in metabolizing the drug. This increases the risk of side effects like muscle aches, liver damage, and myopathy. It’s important to monitor the patient closely when combining rosuvastatin with these antifungals?

5. Other Lipid-Lowering Agents

When combining rosuvastatin with other lipid-lowering drugs like gemfibrozil, niacin, or other statins, the risk of side effects, especially muscle-related problems like rhabdomyolysis, is significantly increased. These agents can potentiate the effects of rosuvastatin, leading to an increased risk of adverse effects on muscles and kidneys?

6. HIV Protease Inhibitors (e.g., Ritonavir): These may increase the concentration of rosuvastatin in the blood, increasing the risk of adverse effects.

7. Antacids containing Aluminum or Magnesium: Can interfere with the absorption of rosuvastatin, reducing its effectiveness.

Drug-Food Interactions for ROSCAD CV 20 CAPSULE:
Grapefruit: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice may increase the levels of statins in the blood, leading to an increased risk of side effects, especially muscle problems.
Alcohol: Excessive alcohol consumption can increase the risk of liver damage when combined with rosuvastatin.
High-fat meals: High-fat meals can affect the absorption of rosuvastatin and may reduce its effectiveness.
Vitamin K-rich foods (e.g., leafy greens): While not directly interacting with Cardirose CV, it may alter the effectiveness of blood-thinning medications used concurrently (like warfarin).

Always consult a healthcare provider or pharmacist before starting new medications or making changes to your diet to avoid potential interactions.

Diet Tips to Enhance the Effectiveness of ROSCAD CV 20 CAPSULE:
A heart-healthy diet plays a crucial role in managing cholesterol and enhancing the effectiveness of ROSCAD CV 20 CAPSULE:

Increase Fiber Intake: Eat more fiber-rich foods like fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and legumes. Fiber helps lower LDL cholesterol and promotes digestive health.
Focus on Healthy Fats: Include omega-3 fatty acids (found in fish like salmon and mackerel) and monounsaturated fats (found in olive oil, avocados, and nuts) to help improve heart health.
Limit Saturated and Trans Fats: Avoid fatty cuts of meat, fried foods, and processed snacks that can raise bad cholesterol levels.
Reduce Salt Intake: Limit your consumption of high-sodium foods, such as processed foods, canned soups, and fast food, to support healthy blood pressure.
Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water to help your kidneys filter out waste products and support the absorption of nutrients.
Lifestyle Advice for Heart Health While Taking ROSCAD CV 20 CAPSULE:
 

Regular exercise, such as brisk walking, swimming, or cycling for at least 150 minutes per week, can improve cholesterol levels and promote overall heart health.
Quitting smoking is one of the most effective ways to lower the risk of heart disease, as smoking increases bad cholesterol and damages blood vessels.
Maintaining a healthy weight, achieved through a balanced diet and regular physical activity, can help reduce cholesterol levels.
Chronic stress has a negative impact on heart health, and relaxation techniques like meditation, deep breathing, or yoga may help manage stress.
Getting 7-8 hours of quality sleep each night is essential, as poor sleep can contribute to high cholesterol and other heart-related issues.

Incorporating these dietary and lifestyle changes, alongside the prescribed ROSCAD CV 20 CAPSULE, can enhance its effectiveness and support better heart health. It is always important to follow a healthcare provider's guidance to achieve optimal results.

introduction:
Introduction About RIVOLAS 15 TABLET

RIVOLAS 15 TABLET contains Rivaroxaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antithrombotic agents. It is used to manage deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and venous thromboembolism (VTE). It is also used to reduce the risk of stroke, systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, recurrence of DVT or PE, major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), and major thrombotic vascular events in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD). Venous thromboembolism is a condition that occurs due to clot formation in the venous circulation. It can also be used for THE management of DVT in patients undergoing knee or hip replacement surgery, VTE in acutely ill medical patients, and thrombosis in children (older than 2 years) with congenital heart disease post the Fontan procedure.

Before taking RIVOLAS 15 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or bleeding problems or antiphospholipid syndrome. RIVOLAS 15 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. RIVOLAS 15 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh less than 2.6 kg. RIVOLAS 15 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking RIVOLAS 15 TABLET are bleeding, pain and swelling in the limbs, fever, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, low blood pressure (feeling dizzy or fainting when standing up), weakness, tiredness, headache, dizziness, rash, and itchy skin. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How RIVOLAS 15 TABLET Works

RIVOLAS 15 TABLET works by competitively inhibiting factor Xa (a clotting factor) and managing the progression of the coagulation cascade through the final common pathway, thus managing thrombin generation.
usageDetails:
How to use RIVOLAS 15 TABLET

Take RIVOLAS 15 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking RIVOLAS 15 TABLET unless your doctor advise.

Have retinopathy (problem with the blood vessels in the back of your eyes)
Need to have an operation
Weigh less than 60 kg

name: TIGEMAC 90 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TIGEMAC 90 TABLET

TIGEMAC 90 TABLET contains ticagrelor which belongs to the group of medicines called antiplatelet agents. It is used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction. It also reduces the rate of stent thrombosis in patients who have been stented for management of ACS.

Ticagrelor stops clumping of blood cells called platelets, which is responsible for clot formation in diseased blood vessels of heart and brain and thus reduces the chances of a blood clot formation. It can be taken with or without food.

Avoid concomitant use of ticagrelor and other oral anticoagulants like heparin or warfarin, as it may increase the risk of side effects. Do not take this medicine if you are suffering from any bleeding disorders or liver problems. This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. The most common side effect of taking this medicine are bleeding and bruising.
uses: Used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction
usesDetails:
Uses Of TIGEMAC 90 TABLET
Used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction
mechanismOfAction:
How TIGEMAC 90 TABLET Works

Ticagrelor is a potent P2Y12 receptor antagonist. In diseased blood vessels, platelets can form thrombus (blood clot) by binding to the arterial surface. Activated platelets produces ADP3 which binds to P2Y12 receptor and propagates thrombus formation. Ticagrelor reversibly binds to P2Y12 receptor instead of ADP3 and prevents the signal transduction and platelet activation, that can lead to blood clot formation.
usageDetails:
How to use TIGEMAC 90 TABLET

Take this medicine as directed by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your condition. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Continue to take this medicine, as long as your doctor tells you to do so, to obtain better results.

introduction:
Introduction About ACMEROSE CV 10 CAPSULE

ACMEROSE CV 10 CAPSULE is a combination medicine used to lower bad cholesterol (LDL) and triglyceride levels and reduce the risk of heart-related complications like heart attack, angina (chest pain), and stroke. It also limits the formation of harmful blood clots within the blood vessels which reduce the risk of atherosclerosis and other blood vessel problems.

ACMEROSE CV 10 CAPSULE can be taken with or without food, as directed by your doctor. For best results, take it consistently at the same time each day to maintain stable levels in your body. Follow the dosage and therapy duration as prescribed by your doctor, even if you start feeling better before completing the course. Incorporating lifestyle changes, such as a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can enhance the effectiveness of this medication.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, bleeding disorders, or if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. Additionally, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, as they may interact with this treatment.

While taking this medicine, avoid alcohol consumption as it may increase liver-related side effects.

ACMEROSE CV 10 CAPSULE generally increases your tendency to bleed, and so if you cut or injure yourself, it may take a little longer for the bleeding to stop. Bleeding for minor injuries like small cuts or shaving is of no concern. 

However, if you experience excessive bleeding for a prolonged period, contact your doctor. The most common side effects of taking ACMEROSE CV 10 CAPSULE are headache, dizziness, nausea, stomach pain, muscle pain or increased bleeding tendency. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

If you notice symptoms such as yellowing of the skin, muscle pain, or dark-colored urine, consult your doctor immediately. Regular liver function tests may also be recommended during treatment.

mechanismOfAction:
How ACMEROSE CV 10 CAPSULE Works

ACMEROSE CV 10 CAPSULE combines two active ingredients, Rosuvastatin and Clopidogrel, which work together to improve heart health and reduces the risk of blood clot formation. Rosuvastatin lowers "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and triglycerides while increasing "good" cholesterol (HDL), helping reduce cholesterol accumulation in the arteries. Clopidogrel is an antiplatelet agent that stops platelets from clumping together, minimizing the risk of blood clots. Together, they improve blood flow, reduce blockages, and lower the risk of heart attack and stroke.

It can be taken with or without food, as directed by your healthcare provider.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The dosage will be determined by your doctor based on your medical condition, age, and response to treatment.
Follow the prescribed dosage schedule strictly. Do not alter the dose without consulting your doctor.

If you forgot to take a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it’s close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not take a double dose to make up for the missed one.

In case of accidental overdose, seek immediate medical attention. Symptoms of overdose may include dizziness, severe headache, or unusual bleeding. Always keep the medication out of reach of children to avoid accidental ingestion.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug interactions:

1. Warfarin:

Combining ACMEROSE CV 10 CAPSULE and warfarin (a blood thinner) can increase the risk of bleeding. The Clopidogrel present in the medicine reduces blood clot formation, while warfarin also interferes with clotting factors. Together, they may enhance each other's effects, leading to an increased risk of bruising, bleeding, and hemorrhage. Close monitoring of INR (International Normalized Ratio) levels is recommended for patients taking both warfarin and these drugs?

2. Cyclosporine:

Cyclosporine, an immunosuppressant used primarily in organ transplant patients, can significantly increase the blood levels of rosuvastatin. As a result, the risk of rosuvastatin-related side effects, such as muscle pain or myopathy, is heightened. Caution is advised when combining these medications, and dose adjustments may be necessary?

3. Antibiotics

Certain antibiotics, such as erythromycin and clarithromycin, can interfere with the metabolism of rosuvastatin, leading to higher blood levels of the statin. This can increase the risk of statin-associated muscle toxicity. Additionally, antibiotics like penicillin and cephalosporins may alter the effectiveness of clopidogrel by inhibiting its metabolism?.

4. Antifungals

Antifungal medications like ketoconazole and itraconazole can also raise rosuvastatin levels by inhibiting the liver enzymes involved in metabolizing the drug. This increases the risk of side effects like muscle aches, liver damage, and myopathy. It’s important to monitor the patient closely when combining rosuvastatin with these antifungals?

5. Other Lipid-Lowering Agents

When combining rosuvastatin with other lipid-lowering drugs like gemfibrozil, niacin, or other statins, the risk of side effects, especially muscle-related problems like rhabdomyolysis, is significantly increased. These agents can potentiate the effects of rosuvastatin, leading to an increased risk of adverse effects on muscles and kidneys?

6. HIV Protease Inhibitors (e.g., Ritonavir): These may increase the concentration of rosuvastatin in the blood, increasing the risk of adverse effects.

7. Antacids containing Aluminum or Magnesium: Can interfere with the absorption of rosuvastatin, reducing its effectiveness.

Drug-Food Interactions for ACMEROSE CV 10 CAPSULE:
Grapefruit: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice may increase the levels of statins in the blood, leading to an increased risk of side effects, especially muscle problems.
Alcohol: Excessive alcohol consumption can increase the risk of liver damage when combined with rosuvastatin.
High-fat meals: High-fat meals can affect the absorption of rosuvastatin and may reduce its effectiveness.
Vitamin K-rich foods (e.g., leafy greens): While not directly interacting with Cardirose CV, it may alter the effectiveness of blood-thinning medications used concurrently (like warfarin).

Always consult a healthcare provider or pharmacist before starting new medications or making changes to your diet to avoid potential interactions.

More Information
Diet Tips to Enhance the Effectiveness of ACMEROSE CV 10 CAPSULE:
A heart-healthy diet plays a crucial role in managing cholesterol and enhancing the effectiveness of ACMEROSE CV 10 CAPSULE:

Increase Fiber Intake: Eat more fiber-rich foods like fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and legumes. Fiber helps lower LDL cholesterol and promotes digestive health.
Focus on Healthy Fats: Include omega-3 fatty acids (found in fish like salmon and mackerel) and monounsaturated fats (found in olive oil, avocados, and nuts) to help improve heart health.
Limit Saturated and Trans Fats: Avoid fatty cuts of meat, fried foods, and processed snacks that can raise bad cholesterol levels.
Reduce Salt Intake: Limit your consumption of high-sodium foods, such as processed foods, canned soups, and fast food, to support healthy blood pressure.
Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water to help your kidneys filter out waste products and support the absorption of nutrients.
Lifestyle Advice for Heart Health While Taking ACMEROSE CV 10 CAPSULE:
 

Regular exercise, such as brisk walking, swimming, or cycling for at least 150 minutes per week, can improve cholesterol levels and promote overall heart health.
Quitting smoking is one of the most effective ways to lower the risk of heart disease, as smoking increases bad cholesterol and damages blood vessels.
Maintaining a healthy weight, achieved through a balanced diet and regular physical activity, can help reduce cholesterol levels.
Chronic stress has a negative impact on heart health, and relaxation techniques like meditation, deep breathing, or yoga may help manage stress.
Getting 7-8 hours of quality sleep each night is essential, as poor sleep can contribute to high cholesterol and other heart-related issues.

Incorporating these dietary and lifestyle changes, alongside the prescribed ACMEROSE CV 10 CAPSULE, can enhance its effectiveness and support better heart health. It is always important to follow a healthcare provider's guidance to achieve optimal results.

Along with UNISTAR GOLD 10/75MG CAPSULE management follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. introduction:
Introduction About CORPARIN 60MG INJECTION(PFS)

CORPARIN 60MG INJECTION(PFS) contains Enoxaparin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used to manage blood clot formation in the body.

CORPARIN 60MG INJECTION(PFS) works by stopping the blood clots formation. It also manages the existing blood clots from growing bigger in size. Due to this property, it is highly used as a prophylactic therapy for managing blood clot formation during risky conditions that involves clot formation such as before or after a surgery, during dialysis or after a heart attack or a severe chest pain (angina).

It can also be used to reduce the risk of blood clot formation caused due to prolong period of immobility or due to cancer therapy.

Before receiving CORPARIN 60MG INJECTION(PFS) inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure or a history of stomach ulcer.

CORPARIN 60MG INJECTION(PFS) is not recommended for use in patients who are bleeding heavily or have any pre-existing conditions (such as stomach ulcer or stroke) that can increase the risk of internal bleeding. It is also not suitable for use in patients scheduled for spinal anesthesia or lumbar puncture.

Inform your doctor before receiving CORPARIN 60MG INJECTION(PFS) if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of receiving CORPARIN 60MG INJECTION(PFS) are injection site reactions (such as pain or irritation), skin rashes, low platelet count, bleeding or bruising and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How CORPARIN 60MG INJECTION(PFS) Works

CORPARIN 60MG INJECTION(PFS) is an anticoagulant medicine. It inactivates certain proteins (such as coagulation factor II a and X a) in the blood that causes blood clotting. This reduces the chances of blood clot formation within the body which therefore manages blockage of blood vessels.
usageDetails:
How to use CORPARIN 60MG INJECTION(PFS)

CORPARIN 60MG INJECTION(PFS) will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or under the skin (subcutaneously).

It can also be self-administered by the patients if advised by the physician. Carefully, follow the instructions given by the doctor in case of self-administration.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: RIVAFLO 15 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About RIVAFLO 15 TABLET

RIVAFLO 15 TABLET contains Rivaroxaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antithrombotic agents. It is used to manage deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and venous thromboembolism (VTE). It is also used to reduce the risk of stroke, systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, recurrence of DVT or PE, major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), and major thrombotic vascular events in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD). Venous thromboembolism is a condition that occurs due to clot formation in the venous circulation. It can also be used for THE management of DVT in patients undergoing knee or hip replacement surgery, VTE in acutely ill medical patients, and thrombosis in children (older than 2 years) with congenital heart disease post the Fontan procedure.

Before taking RIVAFLO 15 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or bleeding problems or antiphospholipid syndrome. RIVAFLO 15 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. RIVAFLO 15 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh less than 2.6 kg. RIVAFLO 15 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking RIVAFLO 15 TABLET are bleeding, pain and swelling in the limbs, fever, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, low blood pressure (feeling dizzy or fainting when standing up), weakness, tiredness, headache, dizziness, rash, and itchy skin. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ROSUFIT CV 10 CAPSULE

ROSUFIT CV 10 CAPSULE is a combination medicine used to lower bad cholesterol (LDL) and triglyceride levels and reduce the risk of heart-related complications like heart attack, angina (chest pain), and stroke. It also limits the formation of harmful blood clots within the blood vessels which reduce the risk of atherosclerosis and other blood vessel problems.

ROSUFIT CV 10 CAPSULE can be taken with or without food, as directed by your doctor. For best results, take it consistently at the same time each day to maintain stable levels in your body. Follow the dosage and therapy duration as prescribed by your doctor, even if you start feeling better before completing the course. Incorporating lifestyle changes, such as a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can enhance the effectiveness of this medication.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, bleeding disorders, or if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. Additionally, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, as they may interact with this treatment.

While taking this medicine, avoid alcohol consumption as it may increase liver-related side effects.

ROSUFIT CV 10 CAPSULE generally increases your tendency to bleed, and so if you cut or injure yourself, it may take a little longer for the bleeding to stop. Bleeding for minor injuries like small cuts or shaving is of no concern. 

However, if you experience excessive bleeding for a prolonged period, contact your doctor. The most common side effects of taking ROSUFIT CV 10 CAPSULE are headache, dizziness, nausea, stomach pain, muscle pain or increased bleeding tendency. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

If you notice symptoms such as yellowing of the skin, muscle pain, or dark-colored urine, consult your doctor immediately. Regular liver function tests may also be recommended during treatment.

mechanismOfAction:
How ROSUFIT CV 10 CAPSULE Works

ROSUFIT CV 10 CAPSULE combines two active ingredients, Rosuvastatin and Clopidogrel, which work together to improve heart health and reduces the risk of blood clot formation. Rosuvastatin lowers "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and triglycerides while increasing "good" cholesterol (HDL), helping reduce cholesterol accumulation in the arteries. Clopidogrel is an antiplatelet agent that stops platelets from clumping together, minimizing the risk of blood clots. Together, they improve blood flow, reduce blockages, and lower the risk of heart attack and stroke.

It can be taken with or without food, as directed by your healthcare provider.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The dosage will be determined by your doctor based on your medical condition, age, and response to treatment.
Follow the prescribed dosage schedule strictly. Do not alter the dose without consulting your doctor.

If you forgot to take a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it’s close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not take a double dose to make up for the missed one.

In case of accidental overdose, seek immediate medical attention. Symptoms of overdose may include dizziness, severe headache, or unusual bleeding. Always keep the medication out of reach of children to avoid accidental ingestion.

Side Effects Of ROSUFIT CV 10 CAPSULE

Like all medicines, ROSUFIT CV 10 CAPSULE may cause certain side effects although not everybody gets them.

Some of the most common side effects of ROSUFIT CV 10 CAPSULE are:

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug interactions:

1. Warfarin:

Combining ROSUFIT CV 10 CAPSULE and warfarin (a blood thinner) can increase the risk of bleeding. The Clopidogrel present in the medicine reduces blood clot formation, while warfarin also interferes with clotting factors. Together, they may enhance each other's effects, leading to an increased risk of bruising, bleeding, and hemorrhage. Close monitoring of INR (International Normalized Ratio) levels is recommended for patients taking both warfarin and these drugs?

2. Cyclosporine:

Cyclosporine, an immunosuppressant used primarily in organ transplant patients, can significantly increase the blood levels of rosuvastatin. As a result, the risk of rosuvastatin-related side effects, such as muscle pain or myopathy, is heightened. Caution is advised when combining these medications, and dose adjustments may be necessary?

3. Antibiotics

Certain antibiotics, such as erythromycin and clarithromycin, can interfere with the metabolism of rosuvastatin, leading to higher blood levels of the statin. This can increase the risk of statin-associated muscle toxicity. Additionally, antibiotics like penicillin and cephalosporins may alter the effectiveness of clopidogrel by inhibiting its metabolism?.

4. Antifungals

Antifungal medications like ketoconazole and itraconazole can also raise rosuvastatin levels by inhibiting the liver enzymes involved in metabolizing the drug. This increases the risk of side effects like muscle aches, liver damage, and myopathy. It’s important to monitor the patient closely when combining rosuvastatin with these antifungals?

5. Other Lipid-Lowering Agents

When combining rosuvastatin with other lipid-lowering drugs like gemfibrozil, niacin, or other statins, the risk of side effects, especially muscle-related problems like rhabdomyolysis, is significantly increased. These agents can potentiate the effects of rosuvastatin, leading to an increased risk of adverse effects on muscles and kidneys?

6. HIV Protease Inhibitors (e.g., Ritonavir): These may increase the concentration of rosuvastatin in the blood, increasing the risk of adverse effects.

7. Antacids containing Aluminum or Magnesium: Can interfere with the absorption of rosuvastatin, reducing its effectiveness.

Drug-Food Interactions for ROSUFIT CV 10 CAPSULE:
Grapefruit: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice may increase the levels of statins in the blood, leading to an increased risk of side effects, especially muscle problems.
Alcohol: Excessive alcohol consumption can increase the risk of liver damage when combined with rosuvastatin.
High-fat meals: High-fat meals can affect the absorption of rosuvastatin and may reduce its effectiveness.
Vitamin K-rich foods (e.g., leafy greens): While not directly interacting with Cardirose CV, it may alter the effectiveness of blood-thinning medications used concurrently (like warfarin).

Always consult a healthcare provider or pharmacist before starting new medications or making changes to your diet to avoid potential interactions.

More Information
Diet Tips to Enhance the Effectiveness of ROSUFIT CV 10 CAPSULE:
A heart-healthy diet plays a crucial role in managing cholesterol and enhancing the effectiveness of ROSUFIT CV 10 CAPSULE:

Increase Fiber Intake: Eat more fiber-rich foods like fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and legumes. Fiber helps lower LDL cholesterol and promotes digestive health.
Focus on Healthy Fats: Include omega-3 fatty acids (found in fish like salmon and mackerel) and monounsaturated fats (found in olive oil, avocados, and nuts) to help improve heart health.
Limit Saturated and Trans Fats: Avoid fatty cuts of meat, fried foods, and processed snacks that can raise bad cholesterol levels.
Reduce Salt Intake: Limit your consumption of high-sodium foods, such as processed foods, canned soups, and fast food, to support healthy blood pressure.
Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water to help your kidneys filter out waste products and support the absorption of nutrients.
Lifestyle Advice for Heart Health While Taking ROSUFIT CV 10 CAPSULE:
 

Regular exercise, such as brisk walking, swimming, or cycling for at least 150 minutes per week, can improve cholesterol levels and promote overall heart health.
Quitting smoking is one of the most effective ways to lower the risk of heart disease, as smoking increases bad cholesterol and damages blood vessels.
Maintaining a healthy weight, achieved through a balanced diet and regular physical activity, can help reduce cholesterol levels.
Chronic stress has a negative impact on heart health, and relaxation techniques like meditation, deep breathing, or yoga may help manage stress.
Getting 7-8 hours of quality sleep each night is essential, as poor sleep can contribute to high cholesterol and other heart-related issues.

Incorporating these dietary and lifestyle changes, alongside the prescribed ROSUFIT CV 10 CAPSULE, can enhance its effectiveness and support better heart health. It is always important to follow a healthcare provider's guidance to achieve optimal results.

introduction:
Introduction About TIKLEEN 90 TABLET

TIKLEEN 90 TABLET contains ticagrelor which belongs to the group of medicines called antiplatelet agents. It is used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction. It also reduces the rate of stent thrombosis in patients who have been stented for management of ACS.

Ticagrelor stops clumping of blood cells called platelets, which is responsible for clot formation in diseased blood vessels of heart and brain and thus reduces the chances of a blood clot formation. It can be taken with or without food.

Avoid concomitant use of ticagrelor and other oral anticoagulants like heparin or warfarin, as it may increase the risk of side effects. Do not take this medicine if you are suffering from any bleeding disorders or liver problems. This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. The most common side effect of taking this medicine are bleeding and bruising.

How TIKLEEN 90 TABLET Works

Ticagrelor is a potent P2Y12 receptor antagonist. In diseased blood vessels, platelets can form thrombus (blood clot) by binding to the arterial surface. Activated platelets produces ADP3 which binds to P2Y12 receptor and propagates thrombus formation. Ticagrelor reversibly binds to P2Y12 receptor instead of ADP3 and prevents the signal transduction and platelet activation, that can lead to blood clot formation.
