introduction:
Introduction About ATORVA GOLD 40 CAPSULE

ATORVA GOLD 40 CAPSULE is a combination medicine used in the management of heart attack. It is commonly prescribed for patients with percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) and myocardial infarction to reduce the risks of further heart attacks.

Take ATORVA GOLD 40 CAPSULE with food, ideally at the same time every day, to maintain consistency and enhance its effectiveness. Follow your doctor's prescribed dosage and schedule, and do not discontinue use without medical advice, even if you feel better. Lifestyle modifications, such as following a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can significantly boost the effectiveness of this medication.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking ATORVA GOLD 40 CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.    

Before starting ATORVA GOLD 40 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney disease. If you are pregnant, planning to conceive, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before use. Additionally, disclose all other medications you are taking to avoid potential drug interactions.

The most common side effects of taking ATORVA GOLD 40 CAPSULE are abdominal pain, indigestion, bruising, and nosebleeds. Since this medication increases the risk of bleeding, take extra precautions while shaving, trimming nails, or handling sharp objects. Seek immediate medical attention if you notice symptoms like muscle pain or weakness, yellowing of the skin, or dark urine. Avoid consuming alcohol while on this medication, as it may amplify side effects.

mechanismOfAction:
How ATORVA GOLD 40 CAPSULE Works

ATORVA GOLD 40 CAPSULE contains a combination of three medicines, namely aspirin, atorvastatin, and clopidogrel which works synergistically to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events like heart attacks and strokes by targeting different aspects of blood clotting and cholesterol management:

Aspirin and Clopidogrel are antiplatelet medicines that prevents platelets from sticking together, further reducing the risk of clot formation and enhancing blood flow in the arteries. By reducing platelet clumping, this medicine helps maintain smooth blood flow and prevents clots in blood vessels.

Atorvastatin is a statin that inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, the enzyme involved in cholesterol synthesis in the liver. It lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while increasing HDL (good cholesterol), which reduces plaque buildup in arteries (atherosclerosis) and improves blood vessel health.

Together, this medicine offers comprehensive cardiovascular protection by reducing clot formation, improving lipid profiles, and reducing  the risk for narrowing of blood vessels, significantly lowering the risk of heart attacks and strokes.
usageDetails:
How to use ATORVA GOLD 40 CAPSULE

ATORVA GOLD 40 CAPSULE should be taken exactly as prescribed by your doctor for optimal results.

It is best to take this medicine with food to avoid stomach discomfort.

Take it at the same time every day to ensure consistent blood levels and maximum effectiveness.

Swallow the medicine whole with water; do not crush or chew it.

Follow your doctor’s recommended dosage schedule, and do not skip doses or stop the medication without consulting your healthcare provider.

For best results, combine this medication with a healthy lifestyle, including a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking. Always consult your doctor if you have any questions about its use.

Missed dosage instructions for ATORVA GOLD 40 CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose of ATORVA GOLD 40 CAPSULE, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double up on doses to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects. To avoid missing doses in the future, try taking the medication at the same time every day and consider setting reminders. If you are unsure about what to do, consult your doctor or pharmacist for advice.

Overdosage instructions for ATORVA GOLD 40 CAPSULE:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of ATORVA GOLD 40 CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of ATORVA GOLD 40 CAPSULE includes increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting (sometimes with blood), increased body temperature, low blood sugar levels, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, kidney failure, increased respiratory rate and hyperventilation.

introduction:
Introduction About DABITOR 150 CAPSULE

DABITOR 150 CAPSULE contains Dabigatran etexilate which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used to manage stroke, systemic embolism and reduction of vascular mortality in adult patients with atrial fibrillation and venous thromboembolic events in patients who have undergone orthopaedic surgery.

It is also used to manage acute deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and/or pulmonary embolism (PE) and manages recurrent deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and /or pulmonary embolism (PE). This medicine is also used in children to manage blood clots and to manage blood clots from reoccurring.

Avoid taking DABITOR 150 CAPSULE, if you currently have bleeding disorders, organ disease of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding such as stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, severely reduced kidney or liver function.

Before taking DABITOR 150 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have increased bleeding risks such as s bone fracture, head injury or any injury requiring surgical management, lung or heart problems.

DABITOR 150 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking DABITOR 150 CAPSULE.

Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your child’s age body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before taking DABITOR 150 CAPSULE.

The most common side effects of taking DABITOR 150 CAPSULE are stomachache, indigestion, frequent loose or liquid bowel movements and or nausea. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.

How DABITOR 150 CAPSULE Works

DABITOR 150 CAPSULE works by blocking thrombin (blood central clotting agent) that results in the management of blood clots thereby managing the occurrence of stroke, heart attack, deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism.

Take DABITOR 150 CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow DABITOR 150 CAPSULE with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Have symptoms of dehydration such as feeling thirsty and passing reduced amounts of dark-coloured (concentrated) or foaming urine

DABITOR 150 CAPSULE is recommended for use in children and adolescents (from 8 to 18 years of age) to manage and reduce the risk of recurrence of blood clot disorder. Use in geriatrics:

DABITOR 150 CAPSULE is used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years or above). Consult your doctor before taking DABITOR 150 CAPSULE.

introduction:
Introduction About XAPILIS 5 TABLET

XAPILIS 5 TABLET contains Apixaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used in adults to manage blood clots from forming after hip or knee replacement operations and to manage blood clots (clusters of blood) in patients with an irregular heartbeat (atrial fibrillation). It also helps in the management of blood clots in the legs (deep vein thrombosis) and the veins of the lungs (pulmonary embolism) and the management of their recurrence in either the legs or lungs.

GBNKEYWORD] is not recommended in patients who have liver disease, active bleeding, or a disease that can lead to active bleeding, such as an active ulcer or a recent bleed in the brain. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before taking XAPILIS 5 TABLET. Patients who have kidney disease should use XAPILIS 5 TABLET with caution. XAPILIS 5 TABLET is not recommended for children and adolescents (under the age of 18). XAPILIS 5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients over the age of 75.

The most common side effects of taking XAPILIS 5 TABLET are bleeding (eyes, nose, gums, urine, rectum, stomach, or bowel), bruising or swelling, anemia, low blood pressure, and a quickened heart rate. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor immediately.

introduction:
Introduction About XYGREL 90 TABLET

XYGREL 90 TABLET contains ticagrelor which belongs to the group of medicines called antiplatelet agents. It is used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction. It also reduces the rate of stent thrombosis in patients who have been stented for management of ACS.

Ticagrelor stops clumping of blood cells called platelets, which is responsible for clot formation in diseased blood vessels of heart and brain and thus reduces the chances of a blood clot formation. It can be taken with or without food.

Avoid concomitant use of ticagrelor and other oral anticoagulants like heparin or warfarin, as it may increase the risk of side effects. Do not take this medicine if you are suffering from any bleeding disorders or liver problems. This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. The most common side effect of taking this medicine are bleeding and bruising.
uses: Used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction
usesDetails:
Uses Of XYGREL 90 TABLET
Used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction
mechanismOfAction:
How XYGREL 90 TABLET Works

Ticagrelor is a potent P2Y12 receptor antagonist. In diseased blood vessels, platelets can form thrombus (blood clot) by binding to the arterial surface. Activated platelets produces ADP3 which binds to P2Y12 receptor and propagates thrombus formation. Ticagrelor reversibly binds to P2Y12 receptor instead of ADP3 and prevents the signal transduction and platelet activation, that can lead to blood clot formation.
usageDetails:
How to use XYGREL 90 TABLET

Take this medicine as directed by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your condition. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Continue to take this medicine, as long as your doctor tells you to do so, to obtain better results.

name: Cenorol 3mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About CENOROL 3MG TABLET

CENOROL 3MG TABLET contains Nicoumalone which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-coagulants. It is used to manage or prevent the formation of blood clots in the body. Blood clots (also known as thrombosis) are semi-solid masses of blood cells deposited within the blood vessels. It happens due to excessive clumping of platelets (blood cells) or other blood proteins within the blood vessels. As a result, it blocks them and reduce blood flow within them, leading to various complications such as deep vein thrombosis (blood clot in veins of legs), pulmonary embolism (blood clot in veins of lungs), heart attack, abnormal heart rate or stroke. CENOROL 3MG TABLET can also be used as an adjunct in the management of coronary occlusion (block in heart which reduces oxygen and blood supply leading to heart attack) and transient cerebral ischemic attacks (mini stroke, caused by blockage in the blood vessel supplying the brain).

Nicoumalone is a blood thinning medication. It works by preventing the formation of blood clots within the blood vessels. It blocks the actions of certain blood proteins and enzymes that forms blood clots in the body. As a result, it reduces the risk of heart attack and other serious complications such as stroke, deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism. CENOROL 3MG TABLET cannot not dissolve an existing blood clot, but it can prevent them from growing larger. During management with CENOROL 3MG TABLET, your doctor would regularly monitor your blood clotting time to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking CENOROL 3MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. Avoid drinking alcohol or cranberry juice while taking CENOROL 3MG TABLET. Inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any upcoming surgeries or if you had met with any accident recently. CENOROL 3MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women due to increased risk of bleeding at the time of childbirth. It should be used with caution in children and in elderly patients. The most common side effect of CENOROL 3MG TABLET is increased bleeding tendency (even after minor cuts or wounds). Consult your doctor if your bleeding becomes uncontrollable.

Used to manage the formation of blood clots
mechanismOfAction:
How CENOROL 3MG TABLET Works

CENOROL 3MG TABLET is a blood thinning medication. It works by preventing the formation of blood clots within the blood vessels. It blocks the actions of certain blood proteins and enzymes (such as vitamin k reductase, prothrombin, coagulation factors VII, IX, X and protein C) that forms blood clots in the body. As a result, it improves blood flow and oxygen supply through the blood vessels and reduce the symptoms of blood clotting disorders such as deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, heart attack, abnormal heart rate or stroke.

Have a habit of drinking excessive alcohol (alcohol abuse)

Are going to receive any injections in your muscles

Have ever had any stomach or intestinal ulcer
Have any recent wound or injury
Need any injections into spine or as part of a scan, x-ray or any dental surgeries

Introduction About CARDIOROSTIN GOLD CAPSULE

CARDIOROSTIN GOLD CAPSULE is used in the management of acute coronary syndrome, myocardial infarction, angina and stroke. It is a combination of Aspirin, Clopidogrel and Rosuvastatin which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs, Antiplatelets and HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors respectively.   

Along with CARDIOROSTIN GOLD CAPSULE management follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during the therapy, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract. It is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney, or heart disease.  

CARDIOROSTIN GOLD CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). The most common side effects are increased bleeding tendency, nausea, indigestion, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, muscle pain, dizziness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How CARDIOROSTIN GOLD CAPSULE Works

CARDIOROSTIN GOLD CAPSULE effectively improves cardiac function and reduces the risk of heart problems, where clopidogrel acts by inhibiting platelet aggregation in the coronary arteries, aspirin acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called cyclo-oxygenase which is believed to be responsible for catalyzing the synthesis of platelets and rosuvastatin acts by inhibiting the action of an enzyme called HMG-CoA reductase, which is required to catalyze the formation of cholesterol, thus managing clot or plaque formation in the coronary arteries leading to an uninterrupted supply of oxygen and blood to the heart.

CARDIOROSTIN GOLD CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having moderate-to-severe kidney disease. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.

CARDIOROSTIN GOLD CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease and active liver disease (including persistent elevations of serum transaminases exceeding three times the upper limit). It should be used with caution in patients with history of liver disease.
Do not take CARDIOROSTIN GOLD CAPSULE if you are allergic to Clopidogrel, Rosuvastatin, Aspirin or prostaglandin synthetase inhibitors (Ex. naproxen, ibuprofen, mefenamic acid, and indomethacin).
CARDIOROSTIN GOLD CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with interstitial lung disease or severe respiratory failure.
CARDIOROSTIN GOLD CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent ischemic stroke.

CARDIOROSTIN GOLD CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above) because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly).

Have gout
Have lactose intolerance
Have diabetes
Have dehydration
Have menorrhagia (abnormally heavy bleeding during menstruation)

Upcoming planned surgery (including dental surgery)

Before taking the medicine, inform to your doctor, if you are taking any of these medicines:

If you or anyone else take too much of CARDIOROSTIN GOLD CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms might include increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, convulsions, vomiting, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, increased respiratory rate and hyperventilation.

What is ATORNIZ 20 GOLD CAPSULE?

ATORNIZ 20 GOLD CAPSULE is a combination medication used for heart disease management, reducing blood clots, and improving blood circulation.

ATORNIZ 20 GOLD CAPSULE is used to manage heart attacks and strokes, reduces blood clot formation and improves heart health.

Take ATORNIZ 20 GOLD CAPSULE as prescribed by your doctor. It is usually taken once daily with water, preferably after a meal.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking ATORNIZ 20 GOLD CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.

mechanismOfAction:
How ATORNIZ 20 GOLD CAPSULE Works
How ATORNIZ 20 GOLD CAPSULE helps to manage Heart attack and Stroke:
1. Manage blood clots (Aspirin + Clopidogrel – Antiplatelet action)
Heart attacks and strokes occur due to blocked arteries, often caused by blood clots
Aspirin blocks thromboxane A2 production, managing platelets from clumping together
Clopidogrel inhibits P2Y12 receptors, further reducing platelet aggregation
Together, they ensure smoother blood flow and reduce the risk of clot formation in arteries supplying the heart and brain
2. Lowers cholesterol & manages arterial blockage (Atorvastatin – Statin Action):
Atorvastatin inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, reducing cholesterol production in the liver
Lowers LDL cholesterol levels, manages atherosclerosis (artery hardening)
Increases HDL (good cholesterol), helping to remove excess fat deposits
3. Reduces inflammation & improves blood vessel health:
Aspirin & Atorvastatin reduce inflammation in arteries, decreasing oxidative stress
Manages the rupture of plaques, a major cause of sudden heart attacks
Maintains healthy, flexible arteries, ensuring steady blood flow to the heart and brain

warnings.details: ATORNIZ 20 GOLD CAPSULE is not recommended during pregnancy unless absolutely necessary. Aspirin in low dose sometimes prescribed in pregnancy to manage pre-eclampsia and clot-related complications. However, high doses (like in ATORNIZ 20 GOLD CAPSULE) may cause fetal complications (bleeding risks, delayed labor). Atorvastatin classified as Pregnancy Category X by the FDA, meaning it is strictly contraindicated due to risks of birth defects. Clopidogrel have limited human studies, however, its use during pregnancy is only advised when the benefits outweigh the risks.

ATORNIZ 20 GOLD CAPSULE is generally avoided while breastfeeding due to potential risks for the baby. Aspirin may pass into breast milk in small amounts, possibly causing bleeding issues in the infant. Atorvastatin has no sufficient human studies, however, statins may interfere with infant development, so they are not recommended during breastfeeding. Clopidogrel have limited data on its presence in breast milk and safety is unclear.
ATORNIZ 20 GOLD CAPSULE does not impair your ability to drive or operate any machines.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ATORNIZ 20 GOLD CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of stomach bleeding and aggravate your existing condition.

Do not take ATORNIZ 20 GOLD CAPSULE if you have severe kidney disease requiring dialysis or acute kidney injury (AKI). Avoid long-term use in advanced kidney disease (e.g., Stage 4-5 CKD or dialysis patients). Kidney function (creatinine, GFR) should be monitored regularly. Dosage adjustments may be required based on kidney function.

ATORNIZ 20 GOLD CAPSULE is not recommended if you have severe liver impairment or active liver disease or have a history of alcohol-induced liver damage. Liver function tests (LFTs) should be monitored before and during treatment. Doctors may adjust the dose or switch to safer alternatives.
Do not take ATORNIZ 20 GOLD CAPSULE if you are allergic to Clopidogrel, Atorvastatin, Aspirin or any other ingredients of this medicine.

ATORNIZ 20 GOLD CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with interstitial lung disease or other respiratory problems such as hay fever, asthma or chronic respiratory diseases due to increased risk of bronchospasm and asthma attacks.
ATORNIZ 20 GOLD CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent ischemic stroke and should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure.
ATORNIZ 20 GOLD CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

ATORNIZ 20 GOLD CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above) because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly).

introduction:
Introduction About APIXAGRESS 2.5 TABLET

APIXAGRESS 2.5 TABLET contains Apixaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used in adults to manage blood clots from forming after hip or knee replacement operations and to manage blood clots (clusters of blood) in patients with an irregular heartbeat (atrial fibrillation). It also helps in the management of blood clots in the legs (deep vein thrombosis) and the veins of the lungs (pulmonary embolism) and the management of their recurrence in either the legs or lungs.

GBNKEYWORD] is not recommended in patients who have liver disease, active bleeding, or a disease that can lead to active bleeding, such as an active ulcer or a recent bleed in the brain. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before taking APIXAGRESS 2.5 TABLET. Patients who have kidney disease should use APIXAGRESS 2.5 TABLET with caution. APIXAGRESS 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for children and adolescents (under the age of 18). APIXAGRESS 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients over the age of 75.

The most common side effects of taking APIXAGRESS 2.5 TABLET are bleeding (eyes, nose, gums, urine, rectum, stomach, or bowel), bruising or swelling, anemia, low blood pressure, and a quickened heart rate. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor immediately.

introduction:
Introduction About VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE

VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE is combination medicine (Aspirin+Rosuvastatin) used in the management of high lipid levels (dyslipidemia) and helps reduce the risk of heart attack, stroke, atherosclerosis (fatty deposits in blood vessels), and peripheral vascular disease (blockage in blood vessels outside the heart). It works by lowering "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and triglycerides (fats) in the blood and reducing the risk of blood clot formation.

Take VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE with food to minimize stomach upset. Follow your doctor’s prescribed schedule and take it at evenly spaced intervals to ensure its effectiveness. Consistently taking it at the same time each day can help you remember your dose. The dosage and duration depend on your specific condition. Even if you feel better, complete the full course of treatment as directed. Adopting a healthy lifestyle, including a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can enhance the effectiveness of this medicine.

Before taking VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any kidney or heart problems.  You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure, family history of muscle disorders or if you are scheduled for any upcoming surgery.

If you are pregnant, planning a pregnancy, or breastfeeding, discuss this with your doctor. Additionally, let your healthcare provider know about all the medicines you are taking, as some may interact with VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE.

VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE may increase your blood sugar levels. Therefore, your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar levels while undergoing therapy with VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE as a precaution. It may also make you bleed more easily even after minor cuts or injuries, and so be cautions while you perform even minor activities that involves risk of cuts or injuries (like shaving, playing, or handling sharp objects).

The most common side effects of taking VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE are indigestion, constipation, muscle pain, increased bleeding tendency stomach pain, headache and nausea. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience stomach pain, dark urine or severe muscle pain or cramps especially if accompanied with fever and malaise after taking VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE.

Benefits of VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE in Dyslipidaemia:

VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE reduces the formation of blood clots by inhibiting platelet aggregation and lowers LDL cholesterol and triglycerides, reducing plaque buildup in arteries. This action significantly lowers the risk of heart attack and stroke by improving blood flow and reducing arterial blockages.

Benefits of VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE in reducing the risk for heart attack and stroke:

Aspirin prevents the formation of blood clots by inhibiting platelet aggregation, while rosuvastatin lowers LDL cholesterol and triglycerides, reducing plaque buildup in arteries. Together, they significantly lower the risk of heart attack and stroke by improving blood flow and reducing arterial blockages.

Benefits of VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE in reducing blood clots:

The Aspirin present in the medicine is a blood thinner, reducing the likelihood of clot formation in blood vessels. Rosuvastatin present in the medicine minimizes inflammation and plaque instability in arteries. This combination helps reduce the risk of life-threatening clots that can lead to heart attacks, strokes, or other cardiovascular events.

Benefits of VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE in angina and heart health:

By improving blood flow and reducing cholesterol, this medicine relieves chest pain (angina) caused by reduced oxygen supply to the heart. It also supports overall heart health by stabilizing arterial walls and preventing further damage from cholesterol deposits or clots.

Benefits of VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE in Vascular health:

This medicine improves vascular health by reducing plaque buildup and maintaining the elasticity of blood vessels. It reduces complications like peripheral vascular disease and atherosclerosis, ensuring better blood circulation and reducing the risk of vessel blockage.
mechanismOfAction:
How VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE Works

VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE contains two medicines namely, aspirin and Rosuvastatin. Aspirin is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug with antiplatelet effects. It manages the clumping of platelets (a type of blood cells that causes blood clot) in the blood vessels and improves blood flow in the body.

Rosuvastatin is an HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor. It reduces the levels of bad cholesterol (LDL) and triglycerides in the body. Collectively they act together to reduces clot or plaque formation in the blood vessels and improves blood flow to all parts of body.

warnings.details: VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE is considered not safe for use during pregnancy. Research studies on both pregnant women and animals have shown significant harmful effects to the developing baby. It is crucial to seek medical advice from your doctor before using this medication during pregnancy. Always weigh the potential risks and benefits with your healthcare provider to ensure the safety of both you and your baby.

There is no proper information regarding the use of Aspirin and Rosuvastatin in breastfeeding women. Limited animal studies indicate that these medicines can pass through breast milk to the nursing infant. A risk to the infants cannot be excluded. Therefore, VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE may be considered as unsafe for use during breastfeeding. However, clarify your doubts with your doctor before use.
Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness, sleepiness or vision problems after taking VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of side effects.

VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Dose adjustments are needed for such patients. In case of severe kidney damage conditions, VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE may not be suitable for use. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE if you are allergic to Aspirin or Rosuvastatin.
VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with asthma or respiratory failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other heart problems (such as coronary heart disease). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 16 years) unless prescribed by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

VASOHART ASP 10 CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or older). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients.

introduction:
Introduction About CLAVIX GOLD 40 CAPSULE

CLAVIX GOLD 40 CAPSULE is a combination medicine used in the management of heart attack. It is commonly prescribed for patients with percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) and myocardial infarction to reduce the risks of further heart attacks.

Take CLAVIX GOLD 40 CAPSULE with food, ideally at the same time every day, to maintain consistency and enhance its effectiveness. Follow your doctor's prescribed dosage and schedule, and do not discontinue use without medical advice, even if you feel better. Lifestyle modifications, such as following a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can significantly boost the effectiveness of this medication.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking CLAVIX GOLD 40 CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.    

Before starting CLAVIX GOLD 40 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney disease. If you are pregnant, planning to conceive, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before use. Additionally, disclose all other medications you are taking to avoid potential drug interactions.

The most common side effects of taking CLAVIX GOLD 40 CAPSULE are abdominal pain, indigestion, bruising, and nosebleeds. Since this medication increases the risk of bleeding, take extra precautions while shaving, trimming nails, or handling sharp objects. Seek immediate medical attention if you notice symptoms like muscle pain or weakness, yellowing of the skin, or dark urine. Avoid consuming alcohol while on this medication, as it may amplify side effects.

mechanismOfAction:
How CLAVIX GOLD 40 CAPSULE Works

CLAVIX GOLD 40 CAPSULE contains a combination of three medicines, namely aspirin, atorvastatin, and clopidogrel which works synergistically to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events like heart attacks and strokes by targeting different aspects of blood clotting and cholesterol management:

Aspirin and Clopidogrel are antiplatelet medicines that prevents platelets from sticking together, further reducing the risk of clot formation and enhancing blood flow in the arteries. By reducing platelet clumping, this medicine helps maintain smooth blood flow and prevents clots in blood vessels.

Atorvastatin is a statin that inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, the enzyme involved in cholesterol synthesis in the liver. It lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while increasing HDL (good cholesterol), which reduces plaque buildup in arteries (atherosclerosis) and improves blood vessel health.

Together, this medicine offers comprehensive cardiovascular protection by reducing clot formation, improving lipid profiles, and reducing  the risk for narrowing of blood vessels, significantly lowering the risk of heart attacks and strokes.
usageDetails:
How to use CLAVIX GOLD 40 CAPSULE

CLAVIX GOLD 40 CAPSULE should be taken exactly as prescribed by your doctor for optimal results.

It is best to take this medicine with food to avoid stomach discomfort.

Take it at the same time every day to ensure consistent blood levels and maximum effectiveness.

Swallow the medicine whole with water; do not crush or chew it.

Follow your doctor’s recommended dosage schedule, and do not skip doses or stop the medication without consulting your healthcare provider.

For best results, combine this medication with a healthy lifestyle, including a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking. Always consult your doctor if you have any questions about its use.

Missed dosage instructions for CLAVIX GOLD 40 CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose of CLAVIX GOLD 40 CAPSULE, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double up on doses to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects. To avoid missing doses in the future, try taking the medication at the same time every day and consider setting reminders. If you are unsure about what to do, consult your doctor or pharmacist for advice.

Overdosage instructions for CLAVIX GOLD 40 CAPSULE:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of CLAVIX GOLD 40 CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of CLAVIX GOLD 40 CAPSULE includes increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting (sometimes with blood), increased body temperature, low blood sugar levels, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, kidney failure, increased respiratory rate and hyperventilation.

Dehydration problem
Diabetes
Are alcoholic

introduction:
Introduction About TICAGOLD TABLET

TICAGOLD TABLET contains ticagrelor which belongs to the group of medicines called antiplatelet agents. It is used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction. It also reduces the rate of stent thrombosis in patients who have been stented for management of ACS.

Ticagrelor stops clumping of blood cells called platelets, which is responsible for clot formation in diseased blood vessels of heart and brain and thus reduces the chances of a blood clot formation. It can be taken with or without food.

Avoid concomitant use of ticagrelor and other oral anticoagulants like heparin or warfarin, as it may increase the risk of side effects. Do not take this medicine if you are suffering from any bleeding disorders or liver problems. This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. The most common side effect of taking this medicine are bleeding and bruising.

mechanismOfAction:
How TICAGOLD TABLET Works

Ticagrelor is a potent P2Y12 receptor antagonist. In diseased blood vessels, platelets can form thrombus (blood clot) by binding to the arterial surface. Activated platelets produces ADP3 which binds to P2Y12 receptor and propagates thrombus formation. Ticagrelor reversibly binds to P2Y12 receptor instead of ADP3 and prevents the signal transduction and platelet activation, that can lead to blood clot formation.

Take this medicine as directed by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your condition. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Continue to take this medicine, as long as your doctor tells you to do so, to obtain better results.

How ATROSURE AC 10/75 CAPSULE Works

ATROSURE AC 10/75 CAPSULE contains a combination of three medicines, namely aspirin, atorvastatin, and clopidogrel which works synergistically to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events like heart attacks and strokes by targeting different aspects of blood clotting and cholesterol management:

Atorvastatin is a statin that inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, the enzyme involved in cholesterol synthesis in the liver. It lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while increasing HDL (good cholesterol), which reduces plaque buildup in arteries (atherosclerosis) and improves blood vessel health.

Introduction About ROVASDAY AP 10/150 CAPSULE

ROVASDAY AP 10/150 CAPSULE is combination medicine (Aspirin+Rosuvastatin) used in the management of high lipid levels (dyslipidemia) and helps reduce the risk of heart attack, stroke, atherosclerosis (fatty deposits in blood vessels), and peripheral vascular disease (blockage in blood vessels outside the heart). It works by lowering "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and triglycerides (fats) in the blood and reducing the risk of blood clot formation.

Take ROVASDAY AP 10/150 CAPSULE with food to minimize stomach upset. Follow your doctor’s prescribed schedule and take it at evenly spaced intervals to ensure its effectiveness. Consistently taking it at the same time each day can help you remember your dose. The dosage and duration depend on your specific condition. Even if you feel better, complete the full course of treatment as directed. Adopting a healthy lifestyle, including a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can enhance the effectiveness of this medicine.

Before taking ROVASDAY AP 10/150 CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any kidney or heart problems.  You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure, family history of muscle disorders or if you are scheduled for any upcoming surgery.

If you are pregnant, planning a pregnancy, or breastfeeding, discuss this with your doctor. Additionally, let your healthcare provider know about all the medicines you are taking, as some may interact with ROVASDAY AP 10/150 CAPSULE.

ROVASDAY AP 10/150 CAPSULE may increase your blood sugar levels. Therefore, your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar levels while undergoing therapy with ROVASDAY AP 10/150 CAPSULE as a precaution. It may also make you bleed more easily even after minor cuts or injuries, and so be cautions while you perform even minor activities that involves risk of cuts or injuries (like shaving, playing, or handling sharp objects).

The most common side effects of taking ROVASDAY AP 10/150 CAPSULE are indigestion, constipation, muscle pain, increased bleeding tendency stomach pain, headache and nausea. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience stomach pain, dark urine or severe muscle pain or cramps especially if accompanied with fever and malaise after taking ROVASDAY AP 10/150 CAPSULE.

introduction:
Introduction About VASOGLOR 60 TABLET

VASOGLOR 60 TABLET contains ticagrelor which belongs to the group of medicines called antiplatelet agents. It is used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction. It also reduces the rate of stent thrombosis in patients who have been stented for management of ACS.

Ticagrelor stops clumping of blood cells called platelets, which is responsible for clot formation in diseased blood vessels of heart and brain and thus reduces the chances of a blood clot formation. It can be taken with or without food.

Avoid concomitant use of ticagrelor and other oral anticoagulants like heparin or warfarin, as it may increase the risk of side effects. Do not take this medicine if you are suffering from any bleeding disorders or liver problems. This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. The most common side effect of taking this medicine are bleeding and bruising.
uses: Used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction
usesDetails:
Uses Of VASOGLOR 60 TABLET
Used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction
mechanismOfAction:
How VASOGLOR 60 TABLET Works

Ticagrelor is a potent P2Y12 receptor antagonist. In diseased blood vessels, platelets can form thrombus (blood clot) by binding to the arterial surface. Activated platelets produces ADP3 which binds to P2Y12 receptor and propagates thrombus formation. Ticagrelor reversibly binds to P2Y12 receptor instead of ADP3 and prevents the signal transduction and platelet activation, that can lead to blood clot formation.
usageDetails:
How to use VASOGLOR 60 TABLET

Take this medicine as directed by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your condition. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Continue to take this medicine, as long as your doctor tells you to do so, to obtain better results.

name: Revostat Gold 10mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About REVOSTAT GOLD 10MG CAPSULE

REVOSTAT GOLD 10MG CAPSULE is used in the management of acute coronary syndrome, myocardial infarction, angina and stroke. It is a combination of Aspirin, Clopidogrel and Rosuvastatin which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs, Antiplatelets and HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors respectively.   

Along with REVOSTAT GOLD 10MG CAPSULE management follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during the therapy, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract. It is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney, or heart disease.  

REVOSTAT GOLD 10MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). The most common side effects are increased bleeding tendency, nausea, indigestion, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, muscle pain, dizziness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How REVOSTAT GOLD 10MG CAPSULE Works

REVOSTAT GOLD 10MG CAPSULE effectively improves cardiac function and reduces the risk of heart problems, where clopidogrel acts by inhibiting platelet aggregation in the coronary arteries, aspirin acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called cyclo-oxygenase which is believed to be responsible for catalyzing the synthesis of platelets and rosuvastatin acts by inhibiting the action of an enzyme called HMG-CoA reductase, which is required to catalyze the formation of cholesterol, thus managing clot or plaque formation in the coronary arteries leading to an uninterrupted supply of oxygen and blood to the heart.

warnings.details: REVOSTAT GOLD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use during pregnancy. Women of child-bearing potential should use suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while taking the medicine.
REVOSTAT GOLD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.
REVOSTAT GOLD 10MG CAPSULE does not affect your ability to drive or operate machines. However, if you experience dizziness during management with the medicine. Do not drive or operate any machines.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking REVOSTAT GOLD 10MG CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of stomach bleeding and aggravate your existing condition.
REVOSTAT GOLD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having moderate-to-severe kidney disease. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.

REVOSTAT GOLD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease and active liver disease (including persistent elevations of serum transaminases exceeding three times the upper limit). It should be used with caution in patients with history of liver disease.
Do not take REVOSTAT GOLD 10MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Clopidogrel, Rosuvastatin, Aspirin or prostaglandin synthetase inhibitors (Ex. naproxen, ibuprofen, mefenamic acid, and indomethacin).
REVOSTAT GOLD 10MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with interstitial lung disease or severe respiratory failure.
REVOSTAT GOLD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent ischemic stroke.
REVOSTAT GOLD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) unless prescribed by your physician due to increased risk of bleeding.

REVOSTAT GOLD 10MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above) because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly).

Have an underactive thyroid gland
Have gastrointestinal problems (such as peptic ulcer, or bleeding in the gut)

Have thrombocytopenia (decreased platelet count)
Have gout
Have lactose intolerance
Have diabetes
Have dehydration
Have menorrhagia (abnormally heavy bleeding during menstruation)

Upcoming planned surgery (including dental surgery)

name: Macparin 40mg Injection 0.4ml
introduction:
Introduction About MACPARIN 40MG INJECTION

MACPARIN 40MG INJECTION contains Enoxaparin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used to manage blood clot formation in the body.

MACPARIN 40MG INJECTION works by stopping the blood clots formation. It also manages the existing blood clots from growing bigger in size. Due to this property, it is highly used as a prophylactic therapy for managing blood clot formation during risky conditions that involves clot formation such as before or after a surgery, during dialysis or after a heart attack or a severe chest pain (angina).

It can also be used to reduce the risk of blood clot formation caused due to prolong period of immobility or due to cancer therapy.

Before receiving MACPARIN 40MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure or a history of stomach ulcer.

MACPARIN 40MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients who are bleeding heavily or have any pre-existing conditions (such as stomach ulcer or stroke) that can increase the risk of internal bleeding. It is also not suitable for use in patients scheduled for spinal anesthesia or lumbar puncture.

How MACPARIN 40MG INJECTION Works

MACPARIN 40MG INJECTION is an anticoagulant medicine. It inactivates certain proteins (such as coagulation factor II a and X a) in the blood that causes blood clotting. This reduces the chances of blood clot formation within the body which therefore manages blockage of blood vessels.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About RIVARED 15 TABLET

RIVARED 15 TABLET contains Rivaroxaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antithrombotic agents. It is used to manage deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and venous thromboembolism (VTE). It is also used to reduce the risk of stroke, systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, recurrence of DVT or PE, major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), and major thrombotic vascular events in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD). Venous thromboembolism is a condition that occurs due to clot formation in the venous circulation. It can also be used for THE management of DVT in patients undergoing knee or hip replacement surgery, VTE in acutely ill medical patients, and thrombosis in children (older than 2 years) with congenital heart disease post the Fontan procedure.

Before taking RIVARED 15 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or bleeding problems or antiphospholipid syndrome. RIVARED 15 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. RIVARED 15 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh less than 2.6 kg. RIVARED 15 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking RIVARED 15 TABLET are bleeding, pain and swelling in the limbs, fever, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, low blood pressure (feeling dizzy or fainting when standing up), weakness, tiredness, headache, dizziness, rash, and itchy skin. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

How RIVARED 15 TABLET Works

RIVARED 15 TABLET works by competitively inhibiting factor Xa (a clotting factor) and managing the progression of the coagulation cascade through the final common pathway, thus managing thrombin generation.
usageDetails:

Take RIVARED 15 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking RIVARED 15 TABLET unless your doctor advise.

RIVARED 15 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before taking RIVARED 15 TABLET.

Others

RIVARED 15 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are bleeding excessively
Have a disease or condition in an organ of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding (Ex. stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, recent operation of the brain or eyes)
Had stroke (previously had a bleeding or a blood clot in your brain)
Had lacunar stroke (blockage of the small arteries providing blood to the brain’s deep tissues) or ischemic, nonlacunar stroke (blood clot in your brain) in the previous month

Before taking RIVARED 15 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have or had bleeding problems
Have antiphospholipid syndrome (immunity disorder that causes an increased risk of blood clots)

Have retinopathy (problem with the blood vessels in the back of your eyes)
Need to have an operation
Weigh less than 60 kg

name: Afogatran 150mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About AFOGATRAN 150MG CAPSULE

AFOGATRAN 150MG CAPSULE contains Dabigatran etexilate which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used to manage stroke, systemic embolism and reduction of vascular mortality in adult patients with atrial fibrillation and venous thromboembolic events in patients who have undergone orthopaedic surgery.

It is also used to manage acute deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and/or pulmonary embolism (PE) and manages recurrent deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and /or pulmonary embolism (PE). This medicine is also used in children to manage blood clots and to manage blood clots from reoccurring.

Avoid taking AFOGATRAN 150MG CAPSULE, if you currently have bleeding disorders, organ disease of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding such as stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, severely reduced kidney or liver function.

Before taking AFOGATRAN 150MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have increased bleeding risks such as s bone fracture, head injury or any injury requiring surgical management, lung or heart problems.

AFOGATRAN 150MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking AFOGATRAN 150MG CAPSULE.

Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your child’s age body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before taking AFOGATRAN 150MG CAPSULE.

introduction:
Introduction About CUTENOX 60MG INJECTION

CUTENOX 60MG INJECTION contains Enoxaparin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used to manage blood clot formation in the body.

CUTENOX 60MG INJECTION works by stopping the blood clots formation. It also manages the existing blood clots from growing bigger in size. Due to this property, it is highly used as a prophylactic therapy for managing blood clot formation during risky conditions that involves clot formation such as before or after a surgery, during dialysis or after a heart attack or a severe chest pain (angina).

It can also be used to reduce the risk of blood clot formation caused due to prolong period of immobility or due to cancer therapy.

Before receiving CUTENOX 60MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure or a history of stomach ulcer.

CUTENOX 60MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients who are bleeding heavily or have any pre-existing conditions (such as stomach ulcer or stroke) that can increase the risk of internal bleeding. It is also not suitable for use in patients scheduled for spinal anesthesia or lumbar puncture.

Inform your doctor before receiving CUTENOX 60MG INJECTION if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of receiving CUTENOX 60MG INJECTION are injection site reactions (such as pain or irritation), skin rashes, low platelet count, bleeding or bruising and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How CUTENOX 60MG INJECTION Works

CUTENOX 60MG INJECTION is an anticoagulant medicine. It inactivates certain proteins (such as coagulation factor II a and X a) in the blood that causes blood clotting. This reduces the chances of blood clot formation within the body which therefore manages blockage of blood vessels.
usageDetails:
How to use CUTENOX 60MG INJECTION

CUTENOX 60MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or under the skin (subcutaneously).

It can also be self-administered by the patients if advised by the physician. Carefully, follow the instructions given by the doctor in case of self-administration.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Fragmin 2500IU Injection 0.2ml
introduction:
Introduction About FRAGMIN 2500IU INJECTION

FRAGMIN 2500IU INJECTION contains Dalteparin which belongs to a group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used to manage venous thromboembolism (blood clots) and its recurrence, deep vein thrombosis in bedridden patients and blood clot formation in the tubes of the equipment, in patients having haemodialysis or hemofiltration.

Venous thromboembolism is a condition where blood clots form in the legs (deep vein thrombosis causing swelling, redness, pain) or the lungs (pulmonary embolism causing sudden chest pain, increased heart rate and shortness of breath).

FRAGMIN 2500IU INJECTION is also used to manage solid tumours in patients with low platelet count and unstable coronary artery disease (reduced blood flow to the heart due to a clot formed on ruptured part of artery).

Along with this management, your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting smoking. Your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to monitor the effects of FRAGMIN 2500IU INJECTION.

FRAGMIN 2500IU INJECTION is not recommended for use in stomach or intestinal ulcer, brain hemorrhage, septic endocarditis or heparin-induced thrombocytopenia. Before receiving FRAGMIN 2500IU INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have conditions which make you more susceptible to bleeding (Ex. hemophilia, severe kidney or liver failure etc.).

FRAGMIN 2500IU INJECTION should be used with caution among pregnant or breastfeeding women. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose of FRAGMIN 2500IU INJECTION for your child depending on their age, body weight and disease condition.

The most common side effects of receiving FRAGMIN 2500IU INJECTION are decrease in the number of platelets (causing easy bruising), bleeding at any site, pain and reactions at the site of injection and hematoma (collection of blood under the skin). Call your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: PIXAFLO 5 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About PIXAFLO 5 TABLET

PIXAFLO 5 TABLET contains Apixaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used in adults to manage blood clots from forming after hip or knee replacement operations and to manage blood clots (clusters of blood) in patients with an irregular heartbeat (atrial fibrillation). It also helps in the management of blood clots in the legs (deep vein thrombosis) and the veins of the lungs (pulmonary embolism) and the management of their recurrence in either the legs or lungs.

GBNKEYWORD] is not recommended in patients who have liver disease, active bleeding, or a disease that can lead to active bleeding, such as an active ulcer or a recent bleed in the brain. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before taking PIXAFLO 5 TABLET. Patients who have kidney disease should use PIXAFLO 5 TABLET with caution. PIXAFLO 5 TABLET is not recommended for children and adolescents (under the age of 18). PIXAFLO 5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients over the age of 75.

The most common side effects of taking PIXAFLO 5 TABLET are bleeding (eyes, nose, gums, urine, rectum, stomach, or bowel), bruising or swelling, anemia, low blood pressure, and a quickened heart rate. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor immediately.

mechanismOfAction:
How PIXAFLO 5 TABLET Works

PIXAFLO 5 TABLET helps to manage the formation of blood clots by acting on the blood clotting mechanism of the body. It blocks clotting factor Xa which is an essential factor in the clotting mechanism.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Rozucor Gold 10 Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ROZUCOR GOLD 10 CAPSULE

ROZUCOR GOLD 10 CAPSULE is used in the management of acute coronary syndrome, myocardial infarction, angina and stroke. It is a combination of Aspirin, Clopidogrel and Rosuvastatin which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs, Antiplatelets and HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors respectively.   

Along with ROZUCOR GOLD 10 CAPSULE management follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during the therapy, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract. It is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney, or heart disease.  

ROZUCOR GOLD 10 CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). The most common side effects are increased bleeding tendency, nausea, indigestion, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, muscle pain, dizziness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ROZUCOR GOLD 10 CAPSULE Works

ROZUCOR GOLD 10 CAPSULE effectively improves cardiac function and reduces the risk of heart problems, where clopidogrel acts by inhibiting platelet aggregation in the coronary arteries, aspirin acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called cyclo-oxygenase which is believed to be responsible for catalyzing the synthesis of platelets and rosuvastatin acts by inhibiting the action of an enzyme called HMG-CoA reductase, which is required to catalyze the formation of cholesterol, thus managing clot or plaque formation in the coronary arteries leading to an uninterrupted supply of oxygen and blood to the heart.

warnings.details: ROZUCOR GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use during pregnancy. Women of child-bearing potential should use suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while taking the medicine.
ROZUCOR GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.
ROZUCOR GOLD 10 CAPSULE does not affect your ability to drive or operate machines. However, if you experience dizziness during management with the medicine. Do not drive or operate any machines.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ROZUCOR GOLD 10 CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of stomach bleeding and aggravate your existing condition.
ROZUCOR GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having moderate-to-severe kidney disease. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.

ROZUCOR GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease and active liver disease (including persistent elevations of serum transaminases exceeding three times the upper limit). It should be used with caution in patients with history of liver disease.
Do not take ROZUCOR GOLD 10 CAPSULE if you are allergic to Clopidogrel, Rosuvastatin, Aspirin or prostaglandin synthetase inhibitors (Ex. naproxen, ibuprofen, mefenamic acid, and indomethacin).
ROZUCOR GOLD 10 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with interstitial lung disease or severe respiratory failure.
ROZUCOR GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent ischemic stroke.
ROZUCOR GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) unless prescribed by your physician due to increased risk of bleeding.

ROZUCOR GOLD 10 CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above) because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly).

Others

It is not recommended for use if you:

Have or had any repeated or unexplained muscle pains
Have family history of hereditary muscular disorders
Have family history of muscle problems following management with cholesterol-lowering medicines
Have an underactive thyroid gland
Have gastrointestinal problems (such as peptic ulcer, or bleeding in the gut)
Have bleeding disorders (Ex. bleeding in the brain, hemophilia, or others)
Have thrombocytopenia (decreased platelet count)
Have gout
Have lactose intolerance
Have diabetes
Have dehydration
Have menorrhagia (abnormally heavy bleeding during menstruation)

Before taking ROZUCOR GOLD 10 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have:

Upcoming planned surgery (including dental surgery)

introduction:
Introduction About CENOROL 4MG TABLET

CENOROL 4MG TABLET contains Nicoumalone which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-coagulants. It is used to manage or prevent the formation of blood clots in the body. Blood clots (also known as thrombosis) are semi-solid masses of blood cells deposited within the blood vessels. It happens due to excessive clumping of platelets (blood cells) or other blood proteins within the blood vessels. As a result, it blocks them and reduce blood flow within them, leading to various complications such as deep vein thrombosis (blood clot in veins of legs), pulmonary embolism (blood clot in veins of lungs), heart attack, abnormal heart rate or stroke. CENOROL 4MG TABLET can also be used as an adjunct in the management of coronary occlusion (block in heart which reduces oxygen and blood supply leading to heart attack) and transient cerebral ischemic attacks (mini stroke, caused by blockage in the blood vessel supplying the brain).

Nicoumalone is a blood thinning medication. It works by preventing the formation of blood clots within the blood vessels. It blocks the actions of certain blood proteins and enzymes that forms blood clots in the body. As a result, it reduces the risk of heart attack and other serious complications such as stroke, deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism. CENOROL 4MG TABLET cannot not dissolve an existing blood clot, but it can prevent them from growing larger. During management with CENOROL 4MG TABLET, your doctor would regularly monitor your blood clotting time to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking CENOROL 4MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. Avoid drinking alcohol or cranberry juice while taking CENOROL 4MG TABLET. Inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any upcoming surgeries or if you had met with any accident recently. CENOROL 4MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women due to increased risk of bleeding at the time of childbirth. It should be used with caution in children and in elderly patients. The most common side effect of CENOROL 4MG TABLET is increased bleeding tendency (even after minor cuts or wounds). Consult your doctor if your bleeding becomes uncontrollable.

mechanismOfAction:
How CENOROL 4MG TABLET Works

CENOROL 4MG TABLET is a blood thinning medication. It works by preventing the formation of blood clots within the blood vessels. It blocks the actions of certain blood proteins and enzymes (such as vitamin k reductase, prothrombin, coagulation factors VII, IX, X and protein C) that forms blood clots in the body. As a result, it improves blood flow and oxygen supply through the blood vessels and reduce the symptoms of blood clotting disorders such as deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, heart attack, abnormal heart rate or stroke.

CENOROL 4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver diseases. It should be used with caution in patients having other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking.

CENOROL 4MG TABLET should be used in caution in children and adolescents below (18 years). Consult your doctor for advice before taking.

CENOROL 4MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Proper dose adjustments are required in such patients. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking.

Others

introduction:
Introduction About FAXAPIX 2.5 TABLET

FAXAPIX 2.5 TABLET contains Apixaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used in adults to manage blood clots from forming after hip or knee replacement operations and to manage blood clots (clusters of blood) in patients with an irregular heartbeat (atrial fibrillation). It also helps in the management of blood clots in the legs (deep vein thrombosis) and the veins of the lungs (pulmonary embolism) and the management of their recurrence in either the legs or lungs.

GBNKEYWORD] is not recommended in patients who have liver disease, active bleeding, or a disease that can lead to active bleeding, such as an active ulcer or a recent bleed in the brain. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before taking FAXAPIX 2.5 TABLET. Patients who have kidney disease should use FAXAPIX 2.5 TABLET with caution. FAXAPIX 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for children and adolescents (under the age of 18). FAXAPIX 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients over the age of 75.

The most common side effects of taking FAXAPIX 2.5 TABLET are bleeding (eyes, nose, gums, urine, rectum, stomach, or bowel), bruising or swelling, anemia, low blood pressure, and a quickened heart rate. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor immediately.

Introduction About ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE

ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE is a fixed-dose combination of Rosuvastatin, Aspirin, and Clopidogrel used to support cholesterol management and reduce the risk of blood clots in patients with heart-related concerns. By combining a statin with dual antiplatelet agents, this capsule helps maintain cholesterol balance, keeps blood vessels healthy, and lowers the risk of serious cardiovascular events. It is often prescribed for individuals who require both cholesterol control and clot protection, such as those with a history of heart attack, stroke, or stent placement.

ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE should be taken exactly as advised by your doctor, usually once a day, preferably after meals to reduce stomach irritation. Regular monitoring of cholesterol levels, liver function, and blood clotting parameters may be required during the course of therapy. Avoid excessive alcohol, smoking, and high-fat diets, as these can reduce the effectiveness of the medicine.

Certain precautions need to be followed while using this capsule. It should be used with caution in patients with a history of bleeding disorders, stomach ulcers, liver or kidney problems.

Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use, as safety data is limited.

Common side effects may include stomach pain, acidity, headache, muscle pain, nausea, or indigestion. If unusual bleeding, persistent muscle weakness, or allergic reactions occur, consult your doctor immediately.

mechanismOfAction:
How ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE Works
Mechanism of Action of ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE

ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE works through a multi-targeted mechanism because it combines medicines that support cholesterol control, blood vessel health, and clot management. The statin component helps in reducing cholesterol production in the liver, the antiplatelet agent reduces the stickiness of platelets to lower clot risk, and the antioxidant-rich vitamins support overall cardiovascular health. Together, these actions improve blood circulation and reduce the strain on the heart, making it useful in long-term heart care.

Cholesterol Lowering Mechanism

The cholesterol-lowering effect of ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE mainly comes from rosuvastatin, a statin medicine. It blocks an enzyme in the liver called HMG-CoA reductase, which is essential for cholesterol production. By reducing the formation of LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides, and increasing HDL (good cholesterol), it helps maintain healthier blood lipid levels. This mechanism plays a key role in slowing down plaque buildup inside arteries and supporting heart health.

Inhibition of Blood Clot Formation

Another important component of ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE is its antiplatelet action. It manages platelets from clumping together, which lowers the chance of harmful clot formation inside blood vessels. By keeping the blood flowing smoothly, it helps reduce the risk of blockages that can lead to heart attack or stroke. Doctors usually recommend regular monitoring since clot inhibition can sometimes increase bleeding risk.
usageInstructions: ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE should be taken exactly as advised by your doctor. It is usually swallowed whole with a glass of water, preferably at the same time each day to maintain steady levels in the body.
The capsule can be taken with or without food but taking it after a meal may reduce stomach discomfort.
Do not chew, crush, or break the capsule. Skipping doses or stopping suddenly without medical advice can reduce its effectiveness in supporting heart and cholesterol health.
The dosage of ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE depends on your medical condition, cholesterol levels, and overall cardiovascular risk
Doctors generally recommend one capsule daily, but the exact duration and strength may vary from person to person.

Regular check-ups and blood tests are usually advised to monitor cholesterol levels, liver function, and clotting profile. Never increase or decrease the dose on your own always follow your doctor’s guidance for safe and effective use.

warnings.details: ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use during pregnancy. Women of child-bearing potential should use suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while taking the medicine.
ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.
ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE does not affect your ability to drive or operate machines. However, if you experience dizziness during management with the medicine. Do not drive or operate any machines.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of stomach bleeding and aggravate your existing condition.
ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having moderate-to-severe kidney disease. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.

ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease and active liver disease (including persistent elevations of serum transaminases exceeding three times the upper limit). It should be used with caution in patients with history of liver disease.
Do not take ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE if you are allergic to Clopidogrel, Rosuvastatin, Aspirin or any other ingredients of this medicine.
ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with interstitial lung disease or severe respiratory failure.
ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent ischemic stroke.
ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) unless prescribed by your physician due to increased risk of bleeding.

ROZON GOLD 10 CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above) because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly).

name: Dablexa 75mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE

DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE contains Dabigatran etexilate which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used to manage stroke, systemic embolism and reduction of vascular mortality in adult patients with atrial fibrillation and venous thromboembolic events in patients who have undergone orthopaedic surgery.

It is also used to manage acute deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and/or pulmonary embolism (PE) and manages recurrent deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and /or pulmonary embolism (PE). This medicine is also used in children to manage blood clots and to manage blood clots from reoccurring.

Avoid taking DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE, if you currently have bleeding disorders, organ disease of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding such as stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, severely reduced kidney or liver function.

Before taking DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have increased bleeding risks such as s bone fracture, head injury or any injury requiring surgical management, lung or heart problems.

DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE.

Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your child’s age body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before taking DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE.

The most common side effects of taking DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE are stomachache, indigestion, frequent loose or liquid bowel movements and or nausea. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.

DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with lung problems such as pulmonary embolism (blood clot in lungs). Consult your doctor before taking DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE.

DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have received an artificial heart valve that requires permanent blood thinning. It should be used with caution in patients with heart problems such as heart attack, bacterial endocarditis (infection in the heart). Consult your doctor before taking DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE.

Others

DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have bleeding problems

Before taking DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Have increased bleeding risk such as surgical tissue removal (biopsy), serious injury (bone fracture, head injury or any injury requiring surgical management), inflammation of the gullet or stomach, reflux of gastric juice into the gullet
Have symptoms of dehydration such as feeling thirsty and passing reduced amounts of dark-coloured (concentrated) or foaming urine

Use in pediatrics:

DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE is recommended for use in children and adolescents (from 8 to 18 years of age) to manage and reduce the risk of recurrence of blood clot disorder. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before taking DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE.

Use in geriatrics:

DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE is used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years or above). Consult your doctor before taking DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Aspirin (medicines used to reduce fever and relieves mild to moderate pain)
Ibuprofen, naproxen, diclofenac (medicines used to reduce fever and relieve mild to moderate pain)
Warfarin, phenprocoumon, acenocoumarol, heparin, clopidogrel, prasugrel, ticagrelor, rivaroxaban, acetylsalicylic acid (medicines used to reduce blood clotting)
Medicines to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole, itraconazole)
Medicines to manage abnormal heart beats (Ex. amiodarone, dronedarone, quinidine, verapamil)
Medicines used to manage organ rejection after transplantation (Ex. tacrolimus, cyclosporine)
Glecaprevir and pibrentasvir (used to manage hepatitis C)
Citalopram, dapoxetine, escitalopram fluoxetine, St. John’s wort, desvenlafaxine, duloxetine, levomilnacipran (used for depression)
Rifampicin or clarithromycin (used for bacterial infection)
Ritonavir (used for AIDS)
Medicines used for epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine, phenytoin)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of DABLEXA 75MG CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital.
