Introduction About ROSTAKE GOLD CAPSULE

ROSTAKE GOLD CAPSULE is used in the management of acute coronary syndrome, myocardial infarction, angina and stroke. It is a combination of Aspirin, Clopidogrel and Rosuvastatin which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs, Antiplatelets and HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors respectively.   

Along with ROSTAKE GOLD CAPSULE management follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during the therapy, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract. It is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney, or heart disease.  

ROSTAKE GOLD CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). The most common side effects are increased bleeding tendency, nausea, indigestion, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, muscle pain, dizziness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About XYGREL AS COMBI KIT

XYGREL AS COMBI KIT is a combination of Aspirin and Ticagrelor which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiplatelet agents. It is used to manage blood clot formation in the body following an heart attack or stroke.

It is usually prescribed to manage the recurrence of heart attack, stroke or any other circulatory disorders caused due to blood clots in patients who have undergone any heart surgeries (Ex. cardiac stent or bypass surgery) or have heart problems and/or problems in blood circulation.

Before taking XYGREL AS COMBI KIT inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, hay fever, high blood pressure, dehydration, heavy menstrual periods or if you are scheduled for any surgery (including minor dental surgeries) in the upcoming days as a precaution.

XYGREL AS COMBI KIT is not recommended for use in patients with ulcers or bleeding from the stomach or intestines. Do not take XYGREL AS COMBI KIT if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

XYGREL AS COMBI KIT may make you bleed more easily even after minor cuts or injuries, and so be cautions while you perform even minor activities that involves such risks (like shaving, playing, or handling sharp objects).

The most common side effects of taking XYGREL AS COMBI KIT are indigestion, joint pain, nausea, stomach pain, constipation, nose bleeds, bleeding gums, headache and dizziness. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How XYGREL AS COMBI KIT Works

XYGREL AS COMBI KIT is an antiplatelet medication. It manages the clumping of platelets (a type of blood cells that causes blood clot) within the blood vessels. This reduces the risk of clot formation within the blood vessels and improves blood flow to all parts of body.
usageDetails:
How to use XYGREL AS COMBI KIT

Take XYGREL AS COMBI KIT as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It can be taken with or without meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking XYGREL AS COMBI KIT without consulting your doctor.

name: Lonopin 20mg Injection 0.2ml
introduction:
Introduction About LONOPIN 20MG INJECTION

LONOPIN 20MG INJECTION contains Enoxaparin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used to manage blood clot formation in the body.

LONOPIN 20MG INJECTION works by stopping the blood clots formation. It also manages the existing blood clots from growing bigger in size. Due to this property, it is highly used as a prophylactic therapy for managing blood clot formation during risky conditions that involves clot formation such as before or after a surgery, during dialysis or after a heart attack or a severe chest pain (angina).

It can also be used to reduce the risk of blood clot formation caused due to prolong period of immobility or due to cancer therapy.

Before receiving LONOPIN 20MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure or a history of stomach ulcer.

LONOPIN 20MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients who are bleeding heavily or have any pre-existing conditions (such as stomach ulcer or stroke) that can increase the risk of internal bleeding. It is also not suitable for use in patients scheduled for spinal anesthesia or lumbar puncture.

Inform your doctor before receiving LONOPIN 20MG INJECTION if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of receiving LONOPIN 20MG INJECTION are injection site reactions (such as pain or irritation), skin rashes, low platelet count, bleeding or bruising and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage and manages blood clots in the body
usesDetails:
Uses Of LONOPIN 20MG INJECTION
Manage and manages blood clots in the body
mechanismOfAction:
How LONOPIN 20MG INJECTION Works

LONOPIN 20MG INJECTION is an anticoagulant medicine. It inactivates certain proteins (such as coagulation factor II a and X a) in the blood that causes blood clotting. This reduces the chances of blood clot formation within the body which therefore manages blockage of blood vessels.
usageDetails:
How to use LONOPIN 20MG INJECTION

LONOPIN 20MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or under the skin (subcutaneously).

name: NORMALIP GOLD 10 Capsule 15's
introduction:
Introduction About NORMALIP GOLD 10 CAPSULE

NORMALIP GOLD 10 CAPSULE is used in the management of acute coronary syndrome, myocardial infarction, angina and stroke. It is a combination of Aspirin, Clopidogrel and Rosuvastatin which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs, Antiplatelets and HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors respectively.   

Along with NORMALIP GOLD 10 CAPSULE management follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during the therapy, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract. It is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney, or heart disease.  

NORMALIP GOLD 10 CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). The most common side effects are increased bleeding tendency, nausea, indigestion, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, muscle pain, dizziness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How NORMALIP GOLD 10 CAPSULE Works

NORMALIP GOLD 10 CAPSULE effectively improves cardiac function and reduces the risk of heart problems, where clopidogrel acts by inhibiting platelet aggregation in the coronary arteries, aspirin acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called cyclo-oxygenase which is believed to be responsible for catalyzing the synthesis of platelets and rosuvastatin acts by inhibiting the action of an enzyme called HMG-CoA reductase, which is required to catalyze the formation of cholesterol, thus managing clot or plaque formation in the coronary arteries leading to an uninterrupted supply of oxygen and blood to the heart.

warnings.details: NORMALIP GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use during pregnancy. Women of child-bearing potential should use suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while taking the medicine.
NORMALIP GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.
NORMALIP GOLD 10 CAPSULE does not affect your ability to drive or operate machines. However, if you experience dizziness during management with the medicine. Do not drive or operate any machines.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NORMALIP GOLD 10 CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of stomach bleeding and aggravate your existing condition.
NORMALIP GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having moderate-to-severe kidney disease. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.

NORMALIP GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease and active liver disease (including persistent elevations of serum transaminases exceeding three times the upper limit). It should be used with caution in patients with history of liver disease.
Do not take NORMALIP GOLD 10 CAPSULE if you are allergic to Clopidogrel, Rosuvastatin, Aspirin or prostaglandin synthetase inhibitors (Ex. naproxen, ibuprofen, mefenamic acid, and indomethacin).
NORMALIP GOLD 10 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with interstitial lung disease or severe respiratory failure.
NORMALIP GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent ischemic stroke.
NORMALIP GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) unless prescribed by your physician due to increased risk of bleeding.

NORMALIP GOLD 10 CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above) because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly).

Have thrombocytopenia (decreased platelet count)
Have gout
Have lactose intolerance
Have diabetes
Have dehydration
Have menorrhagia (abnormally heavy bleeding during menstruation)

Upcoming planned surgery (including dental surgery)

introduction:
Introduction About ACLOTIL 75MG TABLET

ACLOTIL 75MG TABLET contains Clopidogrel which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiplatelets. ACLOTIL 75MG TABLET is used to manage blood clots (thrombi) due to atherothrombosis which may lead to atherothrombotic events such as stroke or heart attack and atherosclerotic events (myocardial infraction) in patients with atherosclerosis. It is also used to manage in-stent restenosis in patients undergo percutaneous coronary Intervention (PCI).

Platelets are very small structures in the blood which clump together during blood clotting. By managing this clumping, antiplatelet medicinal products reduce the chances of blood clots forming (a process called thrombosis).

Atherothrombosis is an inflammatory process of the arteries that affects the coronary (heart), cerebral (brain) and peripheral circulation (blood circulation to arms, hands, legs and feet) by aberrant thickening of the blood vessel wall and reducing the blood flow to the tissue that triggers the occurrence of myocardial infarction, stroke and peripheral arterial disease.

Along with this management, your doctor may advise regular blood tests to check your blood clotting time.

Avoid taking ACLOTIL 75MG TABLET, if you are allergic to Clopidogrel or have a medical condition that is currently causing bleeding such as a stomach ulcer or bleeding within the brain, severe liver disease.

Before taking ACLOTIL 75MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are at a risk of internal bleeding, have or ever had a clot in artery of your brain (ischemic stroke) which might have occurred within the last seven days or have heart or kidney problems.

ACLOTIL 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking ACLOTIL 75MG TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking ACLOTIL 75MG TABLET are bleeding, diarrhea, abdominal pain, indigestion and heartburn. Consult your doctor if any of these above symptoms gets worse.

Introduction About SUPERCLOP 75MG TABLET

SUPERCLOP 75MG TABLET is a prescription medication containing Clopidogrel, primarily used as a blood thinner (antiplatelet) to reduce blood clots. It helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.

This medication can be taken with or without food and should be taken at the same time every day. It is crucial to continue taking it, even if you feel fine. Stopping the medication could increase your risk of having a heart attack or stroke.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, bleeding, bruising, stomach upset. Bleeding in the form of bruising, nose bleeds, blood in urine or stools (black-colored stools), or heavier periods than usual in women. If you cut or injure yourself, the bleeding may take longer than usual to stop. Typically, these bleeding episodes are mild and will resolve on their own. However, it is important to see a doctor immediately if the bleeding continues or if you are concerned.

This medication is not suitable for everyone. Avoid taking it if you are experiencing bleeding from any part of your body, such as a stomach ulcer or internal bleeding in the brain. Prior to using this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of blood clotting issues or if you have recently undergone a major injury or surgery. You may need to temporarily stop taking this medicine before any planned surgeries or dental procedures.

mechanismOfAction:
How SUPERCLOP 75MG TABLET Works

SUPERCLOP 75MG TABLET contains clopidogrel, an antiplatelet medication that works by inhibiting platelet aggregation. It does so by blocking the ADP (adenosine diphosphate) receptor on platelets, which is necessary for platelets to clump together and form blood clots. By preventing this process, SUPERCLOP 75MG TABLET reduces the risk of blood clots, thereby lowering the chances of stroke, heart attack, or other cardiovascular events in individuals with conditions like atherosclerosis, or those who have undergone procedures like stent placement.

01. Product Comparison
a) SUPERCLOP 75MG TABLET Vs Ecosprin

Primary Use

Prevents blood clots in cardiovascular conditions, such as heart attack, stroke, and in the prevention of clot formation in people with cardiovascular disease.

30 minutes to 1 hour

4-6 hours

Contraindications

- Hypersensitivity to aspirin

Higher bleeding risk (due to inhibition of platelet aggregation)

	

Higher risk of gastrointestinal bleeding, less platelet effect compared to Clopidogrel




Usage in Patients with GI Conditions

	

Preferred for patients with a history of GI issues (less GI irritation than aspirin)

	

May not be ideal for patients with active gastrointestinal ulcers or issues




Use in Patients with Asthma

	

Preferred (lower risk of asthma exacerbation)

	

Not preferred for patients with asthma (can exacerbate symptoms)




Clopidogrel vs Aspirin

	

Clopidogrel is often preferred for long-term antiplatelet therapy in patients with a high risk of bleeding or GI issues.

	

Aspirin is more commonly used for prevention in lower-risk patients due to its cost-effectiveness and availability.




Co-Administration with Other Medications

	

Often co-administered with aspirin in dual antiplatelet therapy, especially post-stent placement.

	

Can be taken alone or with other cardiovascular medications.

 

Why SUPERCLOP 75MG TABLET Might Be Preferred in Certain Cases:
Gastrointestinal Safety: SUPERCLOP 75MG TABLETtends to cause less gastrointestinal irritation compared to Ecosprin, making it a better choice for individuals with a history of gastric ulcers, gastritis, or other GI concerns.
Bleeding Risk Management: SUPERCLOP 75MG TABLEThas a more targeted mechanism of action (via the P2Y12 receptor), and its bleeding risk is often more manageable compared to aspirin's broader impact on COX enzymes, which can also increase the risk of gastrointestinal bleeding.
Asthma or Respiratory Concerns: SUPERCLOP 75MG TABLETis preferred in patients with asthma, as aspirin can exacerbate respiratory symptoms in individuals with asthma or other allergic conditions.
Long-Term Therapy: For patients needing long-term antiplatelet therapy, SUPERCLOP 75MG TABLET might be preferred over aspirin due to its more specific action on platelets, leading to a lower risk of side effects like gastrointestinal bleeding.

More Information
01.Product Comparison
a) TICACONIC 90 TABLET Vs Plavix

Aspect

	

TICACONIC 90 TABLET (Ticagrelor) 

	

Plavix (Clopidogrel)




Mechanism of Action

	

Reversible P2Y12 receptor inhibitor that prevents platelet aggregation.

	

Irreversible P2Y12 receptor inhibitor, reduces platelet aggregation.




Onset of Action

	

Faster onset (1-3 hours)

	

Slower onset (2-6 hours)




Duration of Action

	

Shorter duration (approximately 12 hours)

	

Longer duration (approximately 5-7 days)




Metabolism

	

Primarily metabolized in the liver by CYP3A4 and CYP3A5.

	

Metabolized in the liver by CYP2C19.




Effect on Platelet Function

	

More potent and consistent inhibition of platelet aggregation.

	

Less potent and may have variable effect due to genetic differences.




Indications

	

Acute coronary syndrome (ACS), following heart attacks or stenting.

	

ACS, stroke prevention, peripheral artery disease.




Common Side Effects

	

Shortness of breath, bleeding, bradycardia, elevated uric acid.

	

Bleeding, bruising, rash, diarrhea.




Risk of Bleeding

	

Moderate risk of bleeding, though less than some other anticoagulants.

	

Moderate risk of bleeding.




Required Dosing

	

Twice daily (typically 90mg twice a day)

	

Once daily (75mg dose)




Food and Drug Interactions

	

Interacts with CYP3A4 inhibitors, which may require dose adjustments.

	

Interactions with CYP2C19 inhibitors, may require dose adjustments.




Efficacy in ACS

	

Proven to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events in ACS.

	

Effective but may not be as potent in reducing cardiovascular events in ACS.




Reversibility

	

Reversible platelet inhibition, allowing a quicker return of normal platelet function.

	

Irreversible platelet inhibition, takes longer to recover normal platelet function.




Special Considerations

	

Not recommended in patients with severe liver disease or significant bleeding risk.

	

Lower efficacy in patients with poor CYP2C19 metabolism.

Why TICACONIC 90 TABLET(Ticagrelor)  stands out:

Faster Onset: TICACONIC 90 TABLET starts working faster, which is especially beneficial in acute situations like heart attacks.
Reversible Inhibition: TICACONIC 90 TABLET reversible action allows a faster return to normal platelet function compared to Plavix’s irreversible effect.
More Potent: TICACONIC 90 TABLET is generally more potent and consistent in preventing platelet aggregation, which leads to better clinical outcomes in some patients.
Lower Risk of Clopidogrel Resistance: TICACONIC 90 TABLET avoids the genetic variability of Clopidogrel, which may be less effective in some individuals due to their genetic makeup.
Dual Antiplatelet Therapy: TICACONIC 90 TABLET is preferred in certain dual antiplatelet therapy regimens post-ACS or stent placement due to its superior outcomes.

 

b) TICACONIC 90 TABLET Vs Ecotrin

Feature

	TICACONIC 90 TABLET	

Ecotrin (Aspirin)




Active Ingredient

	

Ticagrelor

	

Acetylsalicylic Acid (Aspirin)




Class of Drug

	

Antiplatelet agent (P2Y12 receptor inhibitor)

	

Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID)




Primary Indication

	

Prevents blood clots in patients with acute coronary syndrome or those with a history of heart attack

	

Reduces pain, inflammation, and prevents blood clots




Mechanism of Action

	

Inhibits platelet aggregation by blocking the P2Y12 receptor on platelets

	

Inhibits cyclooxygenase (COX), reducing thromboxane A2 production, thereby preventing platelet aggregation




Formulation

	

Oral tablet (90mg)

	

Oral tablet (various doses, typically 81mg, 325mg)




Onset of Action

	

Fast-acting, with peak effects within 1.5 hours

	

Slow onset, with effects occurring within 30-60 minutes




Duration of Effect

	

Longer duration of platelet inhibition (up to 5 days)

	

Effects last a few hours, depending on the dose




Efficacy in Cardiovascular Events

	

Highly effective in preventing heart attacks, strokes, and other cardiovascular events in high-risk patients

	

Effective for general clot prevention, but less potent in preventing recurrent cardiovascular events




Side Effects

	

Higher risk of bleeding, shortness of breath, headache, dizziness, bradycardia

	

GI irritation, ulcers, bleeding, tinnitus (with high doses)




Specific Indication for ACS

	

Indicated for acute coronary syndrome (ACS) patients (e.g., after heart attack or angioplasty)

	

Not specifically indicated for ACS; more general clot prevention




Patient Group

	

Used in high-risk cardiovascular patients, including those with ACS or a history of heart attack

	

Commonly used in general cardiovascular prevention and pain relief, suitable for a broader patient group




Bleeding Risk

	

Higher bleeding risk due to more potent platelet inhibition

	

Moderate bleeding risk, lower than TICACONIC 90 TABLET




Reversible Antiplatelet Effect

	

Yes, effect is reversible upon discontinuation within a short period

	

No, effect persists for the duration of platelet life (7-10 days)




Drug Interactions

	

Stronger drug interactions due to CYP3A4 metabolism (e.g., statins, antifungals)

	

Interactions with other blood thinners, certain antihypertensives, and alcohol




FDA Approval for Stroke Prevention

	

Yes, indicated for reducing the risk of stroke in high-risk patients

	

Not directly indicated for stroke prevention (primarily used for cardiovascular prevention)

Why TICACONIC 90 TABLET Stands Out:

More Potent Platelet Inhibition: TICACONIC 90 TABLET offers a more potent and sustained effect in preventing platelet aggregation, especially in high-risk cardiovascular patients, making it more effective in preventing heart attacks and strokes in acute coronary syndrome (ACS) patients.
Faster Action & Reversible Effect: TICACONIC 90 TABLET acts faster and its effects are reversible upon discontinuation, providing more flexibility in managing bleeding risks.
Specifically Tailored for ACS: TICACONIC 90 TABLET is specifically indicated for the prevention of recurrent cardiovascular events in ACS patients, whereas Ecotrin (aspirin) is more general-purpose in cardiovascular prevention and pain relief.

introduction:
Introduction About ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE

ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE is used in the management of acute coronary syndrome, myocardial infarction, angina and stroke. It is a combination of Aspirin, Clopidogrel and Rosuvastatin which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs, Antiplatelets and HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors respectively.   

Along with ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE management follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during the therapy, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract. It is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney, or heart disease.  

ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). The most common side effects are increased bleeding tendency, nausea, indigestion, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, muscle pain, dizziness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE Works

ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE effectively improves cardiac function and reduces the risk of heart problems, where clopidogrel acts by inhibiting platelet aggregation in the coronary arteries, aspirin acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called cyclo-oxygenase which is believed to be responsible for catalyzing the synthesis of platelets and rosuvastatin acts by inhibiting the action of an enzyme called HMG-CoA reductase, which is required to catalyze the formation of cholesterol, thus managing clot or plaque formation in the coronary arteries leading to an uninterrupted supply of oxygen and blood to the heart.

Side Effects Of ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE
Common side effects of ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE:
Indigestion, diarrhea, stomach pain, nausea, constipation
Dizziness, headache
Muscle cramps or pain
Tingling or numbness sensation

Stop taking ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe allergic reactions (skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, throat and neck, difficulty in breathing or swallowing)
Symptoms of pancreatitis (severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, fever, rapid heart rate)
Jaundice (yellowing of eyes, skin, and urine with fever)
Flu-like symptoms (fever, cough, sore throat, headache and extreme tiredness)
Hemorrhagic vasculitis (inflammation of the blood vessels with bleeding)

warnings.details: ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use during pregnancy. Women of child-bearing potential should use suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while taking the medicine.
ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.
ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE does not affect your ability to drive or operate machines. However, if you experience dizziness during management with the medicine. Do not drive or operate any machines.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of stomach bleeding and aggravate your existing condition.
ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having moderate-to-severe kidney disease. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.

ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease and active liver disease (including persistent elevations of serum transaminases exceeding three times the upper limit). It should be used with caution in patients with history of liver disease.
Do not take ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Clopidogrel, Rosuvastatin, Aspirin or prostaglandin synthetase inhibitors (Ex. naproxen, ibuprofen, mefenamic acid, and indomethacin).
ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with interstitial lung disease or severe respiratory failure.
ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent ischemic stroke.
ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) unless prescribed by your physician due to increased risk of bleeding.

ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above) because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly).

Others

It is not recommended for use if you:

Have or had any repeated or unexplained muscle pains
Have family history of hereditary muscular disorders
Have family history of muscle problems following management with cholesterol-lowering medicines
Have an underactive thyroid gland
Have gastrointestinal problems (such as peptic ulcer, or bleeding in the gut)
Have bleeding disorders (Ex. bleeding in the brain, hemophilia, or others)
Have thrombocytopenia (decreased platelet count)
Have gout
Have lactose intolerance
Have diabetes
Have dehydration
Have menorrhagia (abnormally heavy bleeding during menstruation)

Before taking ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have:

Upcoming planned surgery (including dental surgery)

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking the medicine, inform to your doctor, if you are taking any of these medicines:

Anticoagulants (Ex. warfarin, coumarin, heparin, phenindione)
Anti-lipidemic agents (Ex. clofibrate, gemfibrozil, fenofibrate, ezetimibe)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (Ex. ibuprofen, paracetamol)
Anti-viral agents (Ex. ritonavir with lopinavir and/or atazanavir or sofosbuvir with velpatasvir and voxilaprevir)
Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (Ex. fluoxetine, sertraline, paroxetine, or fluvoxamine)
Antacids (Ex. aluminium hydroxide, magnesium hydroxide)
Proton-pump inhibitors (Ex. omeprazole or esomeprazole)
Medicines used during percutaneous coronary intervention (Ex. abciximab, eptifibatide, and tirofiban)
Antibiotics (Ex. azithromycin, erythromycin, roxithromycin, and clarithromycin, fusidic acid)
Anticonvulsants (Ex. phenytoin, valproic acid)
Anti-diabetic agents (Ex. insulin, glipizide, glimepiride)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. ciclosporin or tacrolimus, methotrexate)
Nicotinic acid  
Antifungal agents (Ex. clotrimazole, fluconazole)
Cardiac glycosides (Ex. digoxin)
Anti-cancer agents (Ex. darolutamide, regorafenib)
Anti-gout agents (Ex. probenecid or sulfinpyrazone)
Antiplatelet agents (Ex. dipyridamole)
Anti-maniac agents (Ex. lithium)
Corticosteroids (Ex. prednisolone, dexamethasone)
Acetazolamide  
Contraceptive (Ex. mifepristone)
Anti-emetic agents (Ex. metoclopramide)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else take too much of ROSAVE GOLD 20MG CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms might include increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, convulsions, vomiting, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, increased respiratory rate and hyperventilation.

sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of ROSUNOVA PLUS CAPSULE
Common side effects of ROSUNOVA PLUS CAPSULE:
Indigestion, diarrhea, stomach pain, nausea, constipation
Dizziness, headache
Muscle cramps or pain
Tingling or numbness sensation

Stop taking ROSUNOVA PLUS CAPSULE and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe allergic reactions (skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, throat and neck, difficulty in breathing or swallowing)
Symptoms of pancreatitis (severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, fever, rapid heart rate)
Jaundice (yellowing of eyes, skin, and urine with fever)
Flu-like symptoms (fever, cough, sore throat, headache and extreme tiredness)
Hemorrhagic vasculitis (inflammation of the blood vessels with bleeding)

warnings.details: ROSUNOVA PLUS CAPSULE is not recommended for use during pregnancy. Women of child-bearing potential should use suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while taking the medicine.
ROSUNOVA PLUS CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.
ROSUNOVA PLUS CAPSULE does not affect your ability to drive or operate machines. However, if you experience dizziness during management with the medicine. Do not drive or operate any machines.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ROSUNOVA PLUS CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of stomach bleeding and aggravate your existing condition.
ROSUNOVA PLUS CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having moderate-to-severe kidney disease. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.

ROSUNOVA PLUS CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease and active liver disease (including persistent elevations of serum transaminases exceeding three times the upper limit). It should be used with caution in patients with history of liver disease.
Do not take ROSUNOVA PLUS CAPSULE if you are allergic to Clopidogrel, Rosuvastatin, Aspirin or prostaglandin synthetase inhibitors (Ex. naproxen, ibuprofen, mefenamic acid, and indomethacin).
ROSUNOVA PLUS CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with interstitial lung disease or severe respiratory failure.
ROSUNOVA PLUS CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent ischemic stroke.
ROSUNOVA PLUS CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) unless prescribed by your physician due to increased risk of bleeding.

ROSUNOVA PLUS CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above) because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly).

Others

It is not recommended for use if you:

Have or had any repeated or unexplained muscle pains
Have family history of hereditary muscular disorders
Have family history of muscle problems following management with cholesterol-lowering medicines
Have an underactive thyroid gland
Have gastrointestinal problems (such as peptic ulcer, or bleeding in the gut)
Have bleeding disorders (Ex. bleeding in the brain, hemophilia, or others)
Have thrombocytopenia (decreased platelet count)
Have gout
Have lactose intolerance
Have diabetes
Have dehydration
Have menorrhagia (abnormally heavy bleeding during menstruation)

Before taking ROSUNOVA PLUS CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have:

Upcoming planned surgery (including dental surgery)

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking the medicine, inform to your doctor, if you are taking any of these medicines:

Anticoagulants (Ex. warfarin, coumarin, heparin, phenindione)
Anti-lipidemic agents (Ex. clofibrate, gemfibrozil, fenofibrate, ezetimibe)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (Ex. ibuprofen, paracetamol)
Anti-viral agents (Ex. ritonavir with lopinavir and/or atazanavir or sofosbuvir with velpatasvir and voxilaprevir)
Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (Ex. fluoxetine, sertraline, paroxetine, or fluvoxamine)
Antacids (Ex. aluminium hydroxide, magnesium hydroxide)
Proton-pump inhibitors (Ex. omeprazole or esomeprazole)
Medicines used during percutaneous coronary intervention (Ex. abciximab, eptifibatide, and tirofiban)
Antibiotics (Ex. azithromycin, erythromycin, roxithromycin, and clarithromycin, fusidic acid)
Anticonvulsants (Ex. phenytoin, valproic acid)
Anti-diabetic agents (Ex. insulin, glipizide, glimepiride)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. ciclosporin or tacrolimus, methotrexate)
Nicotinic acid  
Antifungal agents (Ex. clotrimazole, fluconazole)
Cardiac glycosides (Ex. digoxin)
Anti-cancer agents (Ex. darolutamide, regorafenib)
Anti-gout agents (Ex. probenecid or sulfinpyrazone)
Antiplatelet agents (Ex. dipyridamole)
Anti-maniac agents (Ex. lithium)
Corticosteroids (Ex. prednisolone, dexamethasone)
Acetazolamide  
Contraceptive (Ex. mifepristone)
Anti-emetic agents (Ex. metoclopramide)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else take too much of ROSUNOVA PLUS CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms might include increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, convulsions, vomiting, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, increased respiratory rate and hyperventilation.

introduction:
Introduction About CLODREL FORTE TABLET

CLODREL FORTE TABLET is a combination of Aspirin and Clopidogrel which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiplatelets. CLODREL FORTE TABLET is used in the management of early and long-term atherothrombotic events such as myocardial infarction (also known as heart attack), stroke (reduced blood supply to brain leading to brain death), cardiovascular death or refractory ischemia (chest pain due to inadequate blood supply to the heart) in patients having acute coronary syndrome with or without cardiac revascularization (including surgical or PCI, with or without stent insertion).

Acute coronary syndrome is a heart condition caused by plaque rupture or clot formation in the coronary arteries. Symptoms include heart attack, chest pressure or pain while at rest, shortness of breath and sweating.

Along management with CLODREL FORTE TABLET follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during management with CLODREL FORTE TABLET, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.

Do not stop taking CLODREL FORTE TABLET abruptly without consulting your doctor because premature discontinuation of this medicine may increase the risk of cardiovascular events. CLODREL FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney or lung disease.

CLODREL FORTE TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). Consult your doctor for an alternative therapy.

The most common side effects of taking CLODREL FORTE TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How CLODREL FORTE TABLET Works

CLODREL FORTE TABLET reduces the risk of heart problems, where clopidogrel acts by irreversibly inhibiting platelet aggregation in the coronary arteries and aspirin acts by blocking an enzyme called cyclo-oxygenase 1 which is believed to be responsible for catalyzing the synthesis of platelets, thus leading to the management of fatal cardiac outcomes.

Others

Have bleeding in the brain (Ex. intracranial hemorrhage or cerebrovascular hemorrhage)
Have bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract
Have gout

Have stomach ulcer or severe stomach pain
Had a recent serious injury
Are going to have any upcoming surgery (including dental procedures) or already had recently
Had a recent ischemic stroke (blot clot in the artery supplying the brain)
Have a history of asthma or other allergic diseases
Are alcoholic
Have G6PD deficiency (a genetic disorder causing destruction of red blood cells in response to certain stimuli)
Have active chickenpox or shingles infection

CLODREL FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor for advice.

CLODREL FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly). interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking CLODREL FORTE TABLET inform to your doctor, if you are taking any of these medicines:

Other anticoagulant medicines used to manage blood clots (Ex. warfarin, heparin, coumarin) or dipyridamole
Medicines used to manage stomach ulcers such as antacids (Ex. aluminium hydroxide, magnesium hydroxide) and proton-pump inhibitors (Ex. omeprazole or esomeprazole)
Other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (Ex. ibuprofen, paracetamol)
Glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitors (used during percutaneous coronary intervention) Ex. abciximab, eptifibatide and tirofiban
Medicines used to manage heart problems or hypertension (Ex. captopril, enalapril, lisinopril)
Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (used to manage depression) Ex. fluoxetine, sertraline, paroxetine etc
Methotrexate (used to manage cancer and other auto immune diseases)
Diuretics (used to increase urine output) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide
Acetazolamide (used to manage or manage altitude sickness)
Digoxin (used to manage abnormal heart rate)
Lithium (used to manage metal illness)
Corticosteroids (used to manage pain and inflammation) Ex. prednisolone, dexamethasone
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. phenytoin, valproic acid)
Ciclosporin or tacrolimus (used to manage graft rejection or manage auto-immune disease)
Ticlopidine (an antiplatelet medicine used to manage heart problems)
Medicines used to manage gout (such as probenecid, sulfinpyrazone or benzbromarone)
Fluconazole or voriconazole (used to manage fungal infection)
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (Ex. efavirenz or tenofovir)
Varicella vaccine (used to manage chickenpox or shingles)
Moclobemide (a medicine used to manage depression)
Medicines used to control blood glucose level (Ex. glipizide, gliclazide, glimepiride, repaglinide)
Paclitaxel (used to manage certain forms of cancer)
Nicorandil (used to manage chest pain)
Mifepristone (abortion pill)
Metoclopramide (used to manage vomiting)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else take too much of CLODREL FORTE TABLET, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of CLODREL FORTE TABLET might include increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, increased respiratory rate, hyperventilation, low blood sugar levels, low potassium and platelets levels in blood, increased body temperature, kidney failure, respiratory alkalosis, metabolic acidosis and pulmonary edema (non-cardiac related).

introduction:
Introduction About IXAROLA 2.5MG TABLET

IXAROLA 2.5MG TABLET contains Rivaroxaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antithrombotic agents. It is used to manage deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and venous thromboembolism (VTE). It is also used to reduce the risk of stroke, systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, recurrence of DVT or PE, major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), and major thrombotic vascular events in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD). Venous thromboembolism is a condition that occurs due to clot formation in the venous circulation. It can also be used for THE management of DVT in patients undergoing knee or hip replacement surgery, VTE in acutely ill medical patients, and thrombosis in children (older than 2 years) with congenital heart disease post the Fontan procedure.

Before taking IXAROLA 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or bleeding problems or antiphospholipid syndrome. IXAROLA 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. IXAROLA 2.5MG TABLET is not studied and is not recommended in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh less than 2.6 kg. IXAROLA 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking IXAROLA 2.5MG TABLET are bleeding, pain and swelling in the limbs, fever, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, low blood pressure (feeling dizzy or fainting when standing up), weakness, tiredness, headache, dizziness, rash, and itchy skin. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

How IXAROLA 2.5MG TABLET Works

IXAROLA 2.5MG TABLET works by competitively inhibiting factor Xa (a clotting factor) and managing the progression of the coagulation cascade through the final common pathway, thus managing thrombin generation.

Take IXAROLA 2.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking IXAROLA 2.5MG TABLET unless your doctor advise.

IXAROLA 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before taking IXAROLA 2.5MG TABLET.

Others

IXAROLA 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are bleeding excessively
Have a disease or condition in an organ of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding (Ex. stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, recent operation of the brain or eyes)
Had stroke (previously had a bleeding or a blood clot in your brain)
Had lacunar stroke (blockage of the small arteries providing blood to the brain’s deep tissues) or ischemic, nonlacunar stroke (blood clot in your brain) in the previous month

Before taking IXAROLA 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have or had bleeding problems
Have antiphospholipid syndrome (immunity disorder that causes an increased risk of blood clots)
Have diseases of your stomach or bowel that might result in bleeding (Ex. inflammation of the bowels, stomach, or food pipe) or tumours in the stomach, bowels, genital tract, or urinary tract)
Have retinopathy (problem with the blood vessels in the back of your eyes)
Need to have an operation
Weigh less than 60 kg

introduction:
Introduction About TICABID 60 TABLET

TICABID 60 TABLET contains ticagrelor which belongs to the group of medicines called antiplatelet agents. It is used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction. It also reduces the rate of stent thrombosis in patients who have been stented for management of ACS.

Ticagrelor stops clumping of blood cells called platelets, which is responsible for clot formation in diseased blood vessels of heart and brain and thus reduces the chances of a blood clot formation. It can be taken with or without food.

Avoid concomitant use of ticagrelor and other oral anticoagulants like heparin or warfarin, as it may increase the risk of side effects. Do not take this medicine if you are suffering from any bleeding disorders or liver problems. This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. The most common side effect of taking this medicine are bleeding and bruising.
uses: Used to reduce the rate of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or a history of myocardial infarction
usesDetails:
Uses Of TICABID 60 TABLET

mechanismOfAction:
How TICABID 60 TABLET Works

Ticagrelor is a potent P2Y12 receptor antagonist. In diseased blood vessels, platelets can form thrombus (blood clot) by binding to the arterial surface. Activated platelets produces ADP3 which binds to P2Y12 receptor and propagates thrombus formation. Ticagrelor reversibly binds to P2Y12 receptor instead of ADP3 and prevents the signal transduction and platelet activation, that can lead to blood clot formation.
usageDetails:
How to use TICABID 60 TABLET

Take this medicine as directed by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your condition. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Continue to take this medicine, as long as your doctor tells you to do so, to obtain better results.

name: Lupenox 60mg Injection 0.6ml
introduction:
Introduction About LUPENOX 60MG INJECTION

LUPENOX 60MG INJECTION contains Enoxaparin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticoagulants. It is used to manage blood clot formation in the body.

LUPENOX 60MG INJECTION works by stopping the blood clots formation. It also manages the existing blood clots from growing bigger in size. Due to this property, it is highly used as a prophylactic therapy for managing blood clot formation during risky conditions that involves clot formation such as before or after a surgery, during dialysis or after a heart attack or a severe chest pain (angina).

It can also be used to reduce the risk of blood clot formation caused due to prolong period of immobility or due to cancer therapy.

Before receiving LUPENOX 60MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure or a history of stomach ulcer.

LUPENOX 60MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients who are bleeding heavily or have any pre-existing conditions (such as stomach ulcer or stroke) that can increase the risk of internal bleeding. It is also not suitable for use in patients scheduled for spinal anesthesia or lumbar puncture.

Inform your doctor before receiving LUPENOX 60MG INJECTION if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of receiving LUPENOX 60MG INJECTION are injection site reactions (such as pain or irritation), skin rashes, low platelet count, bleeding or bruising and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage and manages blood clots in the body
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUPENOX 60MG INJECTION
Manage and manages blood clots in the body
mechanismOfAction:
How LUPENOX 60MG INJECTION Works

LUPENOX 60MG INJECTION is an anticoagulant medicine. It inactivates certain proteins (such as coagulation factor II a and X a) in the blood that causes blood clotting. This reduces the chances of blood clot formation within the body which therefore manages blockage of blood vessels.
usageDetails:
How to use LUPENOX 60MG INJECTION

LUPENOX 60MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or under the skin (subcutaneously).

It can also be self-administered by the patients if advised by the physician. Carefully, follow the instructions given by the doctor in case of self-administration.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ROVOR 15 TABLET

ROVOR 15 TABLET contains Rivaroxaban, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antithrombotic agents. It is used to manage deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and venous thromboembolism (VTE). It is also used to reduce the risk of stroke, systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, recurrence of DVT or PE, major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), and major thrombotic vascular events in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD). Venous thromboembolism is a condition that occurs due to clot formation in the venous circulation. It can also be used for THE management of DVT in patients undergoing knee or hip replacement surgery, VTE in acutely ill medical patients, and thrombosis in children (older than 2 years) with congenital heart disease post the Fontan procedure.

Before taking ROVOR 15 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or bleeding problems or antiphospholipid syndrome. ROVOR 15 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. ROVOR 15 TABLET is not studied and is not recommended in children less than 6 months of age who were less than 37 weeks of growth at birth, had less than 10 days of oral feeding, or weigh less than 2.6 kg. ROVOR 15 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking ROVOR 15 TABLET are bleeding, pain and swelling in the limbs, fever, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, low blood pressure (feeling dizzy or fainting when standing up), weakness, tiredness, headache, dizziness, rash, and itchy skin. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

How ROVOR 15 TABLET Works

ROVOR 15 TABLET works by competitively inhibiting factor Xa (a clotting factor) and managing the progression of the coagulation cascade through the final common pathway, thus managing thrombin generation.
usageDetails:
How to use ROVOR 15 TABLET

Take ROVOR 15 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking ROVOR 15 TABLET unless your doctor advise.

ROVOR 15 TABLET should be taken with caution in adults with severe kidney disease and children with moderate or severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking ROVOR 15 TABLET.
ROVOR 15 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease which leads to an increased risk of bleeding. Consult your doctor before taking ROVOR 15 TABLET.

ROVOR 15 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with very high or unstable blood pressure which is not controlled by medicines, prosthetic heart valve, or coronary artery disease with severe symptomatic heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking ROVOR 15 TABLET.

ROVOR 15 TABLET is not recommended for use in children with moderate to severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking ROVOR 15 TABLET.
ROVOR 15 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before taking ROVOR 15 TABLET.

Others

ROVOR 15 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are bleeding excessively
Have a disease or condition in an organ of the body that increases the risk of serious bleeding (Ex. stomach ulcer, injury or bleeding in the brain, recent operation of the brain or eyes)
Had stroke (previously had a bleeding or a blood clot in your brain)
Had lacunar stroke (blockage of the small arteries providing blood to the brain’s deep tissues) or ischemic, nonlacunar stroke (blood clot in your brain) in the previous month

Before taking ROVOR 15 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have or had bleeding problems
Have antiphospholipid syndrome (immunity disorder that causes an increased risk of blood clots)
Have diseases of your stomach or bowel that might result in bleeding (Ex. inflammation of the bowels, stomach, or food pipe) or tumours in the stomach, bowels, genital tract, or urinary tract)
Have retinopathy (problem with the blood vessels in the back of your eyes)
Need to have an operation
Weigh less than 60 kg

name: ROSCAD CV 10 Capsule 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ROSCAD CV 10 CAPSULE

ROSCAD CV 10 CAPSULE is a combination medicine used to lower bad cholesterol (LDL) and triglyceride levels and reduce the risk of heart-related complications like heart attack, angina (chest pain), and stroke. It also limits the formation of harmful blood clots within the blood vessels which reduce the risk of atherosclerosis and other blood vessel problems.

ROSCAD CV 10 CAPSULE can be taken with or without food, as directed by your doctor. For best results, take it consistently at the same time each day to maintain stable levels in your body. Follow the dosage and therapy duration as prescribed by your doctor, even if you start feeling better before completing the course. Incorporating lifestyle changes, such as a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can enhance the effectiveness of this medication.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, bleeding disorders, or if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. Additionally, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, as they may interact with this treatment.

While taking this medicine, avoid alcohol consumption as it may increase liver-related side effects.

ROSCAD CV 10 CAPSULE generally increases your tendency to bleed, and so if you cut or injure yourself, it may take a little longer for the bleeding to stop. Bleeding for minor injuries like small cuts or shaving is of no concern. 

However, if you experience excessive bleeding for a prolonged period, contact your doctor. The most common side effects of taking ROSCAD CV 10 CAPSULE are headache, dizziness, nausea, stomach pain, muscle pain or increased bleeding tendency. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

If you notice symptoms such as yellowing of the skin, muscle pain, or dark-colored urine, consult your doctor immediately. Regular liver function tests may also be recommended during treatment.

mechanismOfAction:
How ROSCAD CV 10 CAPSULE Works

ROSCAD CV 10 CAPSULE combines two active ingredients, Rosuvastatin and Clopidogrel, which work together to improve heart health and reduces the risk of blood clot formation. Rosuvastatin lowers "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and triglycerides while increasing "good" cholesterol (HDL), helping reduce cholesterol accumulation in the arteries. Clopidogrel is an antiplatelet agent that stops platelets from clumping together, minimizing the risk of blood clots. Together, they improve blood flow, reduce blockages, and lower the risk of heart attack and stroke.
usageInstructions: Take ROSCAD CV 10 CAPSULE as prescribed by your doctor, preferably at a fixed time each day, to maintain consistent levels in the body.
It can be taken with or without food, as directed by your healthcare provider.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The dosage will be determined by your doctor based on your medical condition, age, and response to treatment.
Follow the prescribed dosage schedule strictly. Do not alter the dose without consulting your doctor.

If you forgot to take a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it’s close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not take a double dose to make up for the missed one.

In case of accidental overdose, seek immediate medical attention. Symptoms of overdose may include dizziness, severe headache, or unusual bleeding. Always keep the medication out of reach of children to avoid accidental ingestion.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug interactions:

1. Warfarin:

Combining ROSCAD CV 10 CAPSULE and warfarin (a blood thinner) can increase the risk of bleeding. The Clopidogrel present in the medicine reduces blood clot formation, while warfarin also interferes with clotting factors. Together, they may enhance each other's effects, leading to an increased risk of bruising, bleeding, and hemorrhage. Close monitoring of INR (International Normalized Ratio) levels is recommended for patients taking both warfarin and these drugs?

2. Cyclosporine:

Cyclosporine, an immunosuppressant used primarily in organ transplant patients, can significantly increase the blood levels of rosuvastatin. As a result, the risk of rosuvastatin-related side effects, such as muscle pain or myopathy, is heightened. Caution is advised when combining these medications, and dose adjustments may be necessary?

3. Antibiotics

Certain antibiotics, such as erythromycin and clarithromycin, can interfere with the metabolism of rosuvastatin, leading to higher blood levels of the statin. This can increase the risk of statin-associated muscle toxicity. Additionally, antibiotics like penicillin and cephalosporins may alter the effectiveness of clopidogrel by inhibiting its metabolism?.

4. Antifungals

Antifungal medications like ketoconazole and itraconazole can also raise rosuvastatin levels by inhibiting the liver enzymes involved in metabolizing the drug. This increases the risk of side effects like muscle aches, liver damage, and myopathy. It’s important to monitor the patient closely when combining rosuvastatin with these antifungals?

5. Other Lipid-Lowering Agents

When combining rosuvastatin with other lipid-lowering drugs like gemfibrozil, niacin, or other statins, the risk of side effects, especially muscle-related problems like rhabdomyolysis, is significantly increased. These agents can potentiate the effects of rosuvastatin, leading to an increased risk of adverse effects on muscles and kidneys?

6. HIV Protease Inhibitors (e.g., Ritonavir): These may increase the concentration of rosuvastatin in the blood, increasing the risk of adverse effects.

7. Antacids containing Aluminum or Magnesium: Can interfere with the absorption of rosuvastatin, reducing its effectiveness.

Drug-Food Interactions for ROSCAD CV 10 CAPSULE:
Grapefruit: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice may increase the levels of statins in the blood, leading to an increased risk of side effects, especially muscle problems.
Alcohol: Excessive alcohol consumption can increase the risk of liver damage when combined with rosuvastatin.
High-fat meals: High-fat meals can affect the absorption of rosuvastatin and may reduce its effectiveness.
Vitamin K-rich foods (e.g., leafy greens): While not directly interacting with Cardirose CV, it may alter the effectiveness of blood-thinning medications used concurrently (like warfarin).

Always consult a healthcare provider or pharmacist before starting new medications or making changes to your diet to avoid potential interactions.

Diet Tips to Enhance the Effectiveness of ROSCAD CV 10 CAPSULE:
A heart-healthy diet plays a crucial role in managing cholesterol and enhancing the effectiveness of ROSCAD CV 10 CAPSULE:

Increase Fiber Intake: Eat more fiber-rich foods like fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and legumes. Fiber helps lower LDL cholesterol and promotes digestive health.
Focus on Healthy Fats: Include omega-3 fatty acids (found in fish like salmon and mackerel) and monounsaturated fats (found in olive oil, avocados, and nuts) to help improve heart health.
Limit Saturated and Trans Fats: Avoid fatty cuts of meat, fried foods, and processed snacks that can raise bad cholesterol levels.
Reduce Salt Intake: Limit your consumption of high-sodium foods, such as processed foods, canned soups, and fast food, to support healthy blood pressure.
Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water to help your kidneys filter out waste products and support the absorption of nutrients.
Lifestyle Advice for Heart Health While Taking ROSCAD CV 10 CAPSULE:
 

Regular exercise, such as brisk walking, swimming, or cycling for at least 150 minutes per week, can improve cholesterol levels and promote overall heart health.
Quitting smoking is one of the most effective ways to lower the risk of heart disease, as smoking increases bad cholesterol and damages blood vessels.
Maintaining a healthy weight, achieved through a balanced diet and regular physical activity, can help reduce cholesterol levels.
Chronic stress has a negative impact on heart health, and relaxation techniques like meditation, deep breathing, or yoga may help manage stress.
Getting 7-8 hours of quality sleep each night is essential, as poor sleep can contribute to high cholesterol and other heart-related issues.

Incorporating these dietary and lifestyle changes, alongside the prescribed ROSCAD CV 10 CAPSULE, can enhance its effectiveness and support better heart health. It is always important to follow a healthcare provider's guidance to achieve optimal results.

introduction:
Introduction About VAST R GOLD CAPSULE

VAST R GOLD CAPSULE is used in the management of acute coronary syndrome, myocardial infarction, angina and stroke. It is a combination of Aspirin, Clopidogrel and Rosuvastatin which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs, Antiplatelets and HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors respectively.   

Along with VAST R GOLD CAPSULE management follow a healthy low-fat diet as advised by doctor to achieve better results. Avoid drinking alcohol during the therapy, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract. It is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney, or heart disease.  

VAST R GOLD CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (below 18 years). The most common side effects are increased bleeding tendency, nausea, indigestion, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, muscle pain, dizziness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How VAST R GOLD CAPSULE Works

VAST R GOLD CAPSULE effectively improves cardiac function and reduces the risk of heart problems, where clopidogrel acts by inhibiting platelet aggregation in the coronary arteries, aspirin acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called cyclo-oxygenase which is believed to be responsible for catalyzing the synthesis of platelets and rosuvastatin acts by inhibiting the action of an enzyme called HMG-CoA reductase, which is required to catalyze the formation of cholesterol, thus managing clot or plaque formation in the coronary arteries leading to an uninterrupted supply of oxygen and blood to the heart.

introduction:
Introduction About ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE

ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE is a combination medicine used in the management of heart attack. It is commonly prescribed for patients with percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) and myocardial infarction to reduce the risks of further heart attacks.

Take ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE with food, ideally at the same time every day, to maintain consistency and enhance its effectiveness. Follow your doctor's prescribed dosage and schedule, and do not discontinue use without medical advice, even if you feel better. Lifestyle modifications, such as following a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can significantly boost the effectiveness of this medication.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE, as it could increase the risk of bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract.    

Before starting ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney disease. If you are pregnant, planning to conceive, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before use. Additionally, disclose all other medications you are taking to avoid potential drug interactions.

The most common side effects of taking ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE are abdominal pain, indigestion, bruising, and nosebleeds. Since this medication increases the risk of bleeding, take extra precautions while shaving, trimming nails, or handling sharp objects. Seek immediate medical attention if you notice symptoms like muscle pain or weakness, yellowing of the skin, or dark urine. Avoid consuming alcohol while on this medication, as it may amplify side effects.
uses: Heart Attack
ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE is a powerful medication designed to lower the risk of heart attacks by combining antiplatelet and cholesterol-lowering agents.
It prevents blood clots by stopping platelets from sticking together, ensuring smooth blood flow and reducing the risk of blockages in arteries.
Additionally, it lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while boosting HDL (good cholesterol), promoting better cardiovascular health.

By reducing the chances for atherosclerosis (hardening of arteries) and reducing the recurrence of heart attacks, this medication offers comprehensive heart protection. When combined with a healthy lifestyle, such as a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE significantly enhances heart health.

mechanismOfAction:
How ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE Works

ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE contains a combination of three medicines, namely aspirin, atorvastatin, and clopidogrel which works synergistically to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events like heart attacks and strokes by targeting different aspects of blood clotting and cholesterol management:

Aspirin and Clopidogrel are antiplatelet medicines that prevents platelets from sticking together, further reducing the risk of clot formation and enhancing blood flow in the arteries. By reducing platelet clumping, this medicine helps maintain smooth blood flow and prevents clots in blood vessels.

Atorvastatin is a statin that inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, the enzyme involved in cholesterol synthesis in the liver. It lowers LDL (bad cholesterol) and triglycerides while increasing HDL (good cholesterol), which reduces plaque buildup in arteries (atherosclerosis) and improves blood vessel health.

Together, this medicine offers comprehensive cardiovascular protection by reducing clot formation, improving lipid profiles, and reducing  the risk for narrowing of blood vessels, significantly lowering the risk of heart attacks and strokes.
usageDetails:
How to use ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE

ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE should be taken exactly as prescribed by your doctor for optimal results.

It is best to take this medicine with food to avoid stomach discomfort.

Take it at the same time every day to ensure consistent blood levels and maximum effectiveness.

Swallow the medicine whole with water; do not crush or chew it.

Follow your doctor’s recommended dosage schedule, and do not skip doses or stop the medication without consulting your healthcare provider.

For best results, combine this medication with a healthy lifestyle, including a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking. Always consult your doctor if you have any questions about its use.

Missed dosage instructions for ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose of ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double up on doses to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects. To avoid missing doses in the future, try taking the medication at the same time every day and consider setting reminders. If you are unsure about what to do, consult your doctor or pharmacist for advice.

Overdosage instructions for ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Overdosage symptoms of ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE includes increased bleeding, confusion, disorientation, coma, convulsions, vomiting (sometimes with blood), increased body temperature, low blood sugar levels, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), vertigo (spinning sensation), sweating, warm extremities with bounding pulses, kidney failure, increased respiratory rate and hyperventilation.

ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver impairment and active liver disease (including persistent elevations of serum transaminases exceeding three times the upper limit) and should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment. ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with interstitial lung disease or other respiratory problems such as hay fever, asthma or chronic respiratory diseases due to increased risk of bronchospasm and asthma attacks. Consult your doctor before taking ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE.

ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent ischemic stroke and should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above) because of increased risk of gastro-intestinal bleeding and perforation when used for prolonged duration (if prolonged therapy is essential, patients should be reviewed regularly). Consult your doctor before taking ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE.

Others

ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have active or recurrent peptic ulcer with or without gastrointestinal bleeding
Have bleeding disorders (Ex. bleeding in the brain, hemophilia or others)
Have thrombocytopenia (decreased platelet count)
Have gout
Have menorrhagia (abnormally heavy bleeding during menstruation)

Before taking ATOREC GOLD 10 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Have an underactive thyroid gland
Have family history of hereditary muscular disorders
Have family history of muscle problems following management with cholesterol-lowering medicines
Upcoming planned surgery (including dental surgery)
Dehydration problem
Diabetes
Are alcoholic

introduction:
Introduction About ROVAPURE CV CAPSULE

ROVAPURE CV CAPSULE is a combination medicine used to lower bad cholesterol (LDL) and triglyceride levels and reduce the risk of heart-related complications like heart attack, angina (chest pain), and stroke. It also limits the formation of harmful blood clots within the blood vessels which reduce the risk of atherosclerosis and other blood vessel problems.

ROVAPURE CV CAPSULE can be taken with or without food, as directed by your doctor. For best results, take it consistently at the same time each day to maintain stable levels in your body. Follow the dosage and therapy duration as prescribed by your doctor, even if you start feeling better before completing the course. Incorporating lifestyle changes, such as a low-fat diet, regular exercise, and avoiding smoking, can enhance the effectiveness of this medication.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, bleeding disorders, or if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. Additionally, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, as they may interact with this treatment.

While taking this medicine, avoid alcohol consumption as it may increase liver-related side effects.

ROVAPURE CV CAPSULE generally increases your tendency to bleed, and so if you cut or injure yourself, it may take a little longer for the bleeding to stop. Bleeding for minor injuries like small cuts or shaving is of no concern.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug interactions:

1. Warfarin:

Combining ROVAPURE CV CAPSULE and warfarin (a blood thinner) can increase the risk of bleeding. The Clopidogrel present in the medicine reduces blood clot formation, while warfarin also interferes with clotting factors. Together, they may enhance each other's effects, leading to an increased risk of bruising, bleeding, and hemorrhage. Close monitoring of INR (International Normalized Ratio) levels is recommended for patients taking both warfarin and these drugs?

2. Cyclosporine:

Cyclosporine, an immunosuppressant used primarily in organ transplant patients, can significantly increase the blood levels of rosuvastatin. As a result, the risk of rosuvastatin-related side effects, such as muscle pain or myopathy, is heightened. Caution is advised when combining these medications, and dose adjustments may be necessary?

3. Antibiotics

Certain antibiotics, such as erythromycin and clarithromycin, can interfere with the metabolism of rosuvastatin, leading to higher blood levels of the statin. This can increase the risk of statin-associated muscle toxicity. Additionally, antibiotics like penicillin and cephalosporins may alter the effectiveness of clopidogrel by inhibiting its metabolism?.

4. Antifungals

Antifungal medications like ketoconazole and itraconazole can also raise rosuvastatin levels by inhibiting the liver enzymes involved in metabolizing the drug. This increases the risk of side effects like muscle aches, liver damage, and myopathy. It’s important to monitor the patient closely when combining rosuvastatin with these antifungals?

5. Other Lipid-Lowering Agents

When combining rosuvastatin with other lipid-lowering drugs like gemfibrozil, niacin, or other statins, the risk of side effects, especially muscle-related problems like rhabdomyolysis, is significantly increased. These agents can potentiate the effects of rosuvastatin, leading to an increased risk of adverse effects on muscles and kidneys?

6. HIV Protease Inhibitors (e.g., Ritonavir): These may increase the concentration of rosuvastatin in the blood, increasing the risk of adverse effects.

7. Antacids containing Aluminum or Magnesium: Can interfere with the absorption of rosuvastatin, reducing its effectiveness.

Drug-Food Interactions for ROVAPURE CV CAPSULE:
Grapefruit: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice may increase the levels of statins in the blood, leading to an increased risk of side effects, especially muscle problems.
Alcohol: Excessive alcohol consumption can increase the risk of liver damage when combined with rosuvastatin.
High-fat meals: High-fat meals can affect the absorption of rosuvastatin and may reduce its effectiveness.
Vitamin K-rich foods (e.g., leafy greens): While not directly interacting with Cardirose CV, it may alter the effectiveness of blood-thinning medications used concurrently (like warfarin).

Always consult a healthcare provider or pharmacist before starting new medications or making changes to your diet to avoid potential interactions.

Diet Tips to Enhance the Effectiveness of ROVAPURE CV CAPSULE:
A heart-healthy diet plays a crucial role in managing cholesterol and enhancing the effectiveness of ROVAPURE CV CAPSULE:

Increase Fiber Intake: Eat more fiber-rich foods like fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and legumes. Fiber helps lower LDL cholesterol and promotes digestive health.
Focus on Healthy Fats: Include omega-3 fatty acids (found in fish like salmon and mackerel) and monounsaturated fats (found in olive oil, avocados, and nuts) to help improve heart health.
Limit Saturated and Trans Fats: Avoid fatty cuts of meat, fried foods, and processed snacks that can raise bad cholesterol levels.
Reduce Salt Intake: Limit your consumption of high-sodium foods, such as processed foods, canned soups, and fast food, to support healthy blood pressure.
Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water to help your kidneys filter out waste products and support the absorption of nutrients.
Lifestyle Advice for Heart Health While Taking ROVAPURE CV CAPSULE:
 

Regular exercise, such as brisk walking, swimming, or cycling for at least 150 minutes per week, can improve cholesterol levels and promote overall heart health.
Quitting smoking is one of the most effective ways to lower the risk of heart disease, as smoking increases bad cholesterol and damages blood vessels.
Maintaining a healthy weight, achieved through a balanced diet and regular physical activity, can help reduce cholesterol levels.
Chronic stress has a negative impact on heart health, and relaxation techniques like meditation, deep breathing, or yoga may help manage stress.
Getting 7-8 hours of quality sleep each night is essential, as poor sleep can contribute to high cholesterol and other heart-related issues.

Incorporating these dietary and lifestyle changes, alongside the prescribed ROVAPURE CV CAPSULE, can enhance its effectiveness and support better heart health. It is always important to follow a healthcare provider's guidance to achieve optimal results.

Introduction About CLOPIHENZ 75MG TABLET

CLOPIHENZ 75MG TABLET is a prescription medication containing Clopidogrel, primarily used as a blood thinner (antiplatelet) to reduce blood clots. It helps in reducing the risk of stroke, heart attack, and other cardiovascular conditions.

This medication can be taken with or without food and should be taken at the same time every day. It is crucial to continue taking it, even if you feel fine. Stopping the medication could increase your risk of having a heart attack or stroke.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, bleeding, bruising, stomach upset. Bleeding in the form of bruising, nose bleeds, blood in urine or stools (black-colored stools), or heavier periods than usual in women. If you cut or injure yourself, the bleeding may take longer than usual to stop. Typically, these bleeding episodes are mild and will resolve on their own. However, it is important to see a doctor immediately if the bleeding continues or if you are concerned.

This medication is not suitable for everyone. Avoid taking it if you are experiencing bleeding from any part of your body, such as a stomach ulcer or internal bleeding in the brain. Prior to using this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of blood clotting issues or if you have recently undergone a major injury or surgery. You may need to temporarily stop taking this medicine before any planned surgeries or dental procedures.

mechanismOfAction:
How CLOPIHENZ 75MG TABLET Works

CLOPIHENZ 75MG TABLET contains clopidogrel, an antiplatelet medication that works by inhibiting platelet aggregation. It does so by blocking the ADP (adenosine diphosphate) receptor on platelets, which is necessary for platelets to clump together and form blood clots. By preventing this process, CLOPIHENZ 75MG TABLET reduces the risk of blood clots, thereby lowering the chances of stroke, heart attack, or other cardiovascular events in individuals with conditions like atherosclerosis, or those who have undergone procedures like stent placement.
